chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Fadalah from Rifa’ah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about a man who forgets to bow until he prostrates and stands up again. Imam (a.s) said: "He must begin the prayer anew."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَنْسَى أَنْ يَرْكَعَ حَتَّى يَسْجُدَ وَ يَقُومَ قَالَ« يَسْتَقْبِلُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Fadalah from Rifa’ah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about a man who forgets to bow until he prostrates and stands up again. Imam (a.s) said: "He must begin the prayer anew."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 157

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Rifa’ah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who forgot to bow until he prostrated and then stood up. Imam (a.s) said: "He must begin the prayer anew."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ حَتَّى يَسْجُدَ وَ يَقُومَ قَالَ« يَسْتَقْبِلُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Rifa’ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who forgot to bow until he prostrated and then stood up. Imam (a.s) said: "He must begin the prayer anew."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 157

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Safwan from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
I asked Abu Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who forgets to bow. Imam (a.s) said: "He must begin the prayer anew until he places everything in its proper place."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى أَنْ يَرْكَعَ قَالَ« يَسْتَقْبِلُ حَتَّى يَضَعَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ مِنْ ذَلِكَ مَوْضِعَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Safwan from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who forgets to bow. Imam (a.s) said: "He must begin the prayer anew until he places everything in its proper place."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 158

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Ja’far (a.s) about a man who forgot to bow. Imam (a.s) said: "He must repeat (the prayer)."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ قَالَ« عَلَيْهِ اَلْإِعَادَةُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Ja’far (a.s) about a man who forgot to bow. Imam (a.s) said: "He must repeat (the prayer)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 158

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’d ibn Abdullah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hakam ibn Miskin from al-’Alaʾ from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja’far (a.s) (was asked) regarding a man who, after prostrating, doubts whether he bowed. Imam (a.s) said: "If he becomes certain, then let him disregard the two prostrations that have no bowing associated with them, and let him continue his prayer to completion. But if he only becomes certain after he has finished and exited the prayer, then let him stand and pray one rak’ah and two prostrations, and there is nothing upon him."
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ شَكَّ بَعْدَ مَا سَجَدَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَرْكَعْ قَالَ« فَإِنِ اِسْتَيْقَنَ فَلْيُلْقِ اَلسَّجْدَتَيْنِ اَللَّتَيْنِ لاَ رَكْعَةَ لَهُمَا فَيَبْنِي عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ عَلَى اَلتَّمَامِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ لَمْ يَسْتَيْقِنْ إِلاَّ بَعْدَ مَا فَرَغَ وَ اِنْصَرَفَ فَلْيَقُمْ فَلْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَةً وَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَ لاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’d ibn Abdullah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hakam ibn Miskin from al-’Alaʾ from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja’far (a.s) (was asked) regarding a man who, after prostrating, doubts whether he bowed. Imam (a.s) said: "If he becomes certain, then let him disregard the two prostrations that have no bowing associated with them, and let him continue his prayer to completion. But if he only becomes certain after he has finished and exited the prayer, then let him stand and pray one rak’ah and two prostrations, and there is nothing upon him."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 158

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Safwan ibn Yahya from al-’Is ibn al-Qasim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who forgot a rak’ah from his prayer until he finished it, then remembered that he had not bowed. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him stand, perform the bowing, and prostrate, and then perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sujud al-sahw)."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْهَا ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَرْكَعْ قَالَ« يَقُومُ فَيَرْكَعُ وَ يَسْجُدُ سَجْدَتَيِ اَلسَّهْوِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Safwan ibn Yahya from al-’Is ibn al-Qasim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who forgot a rak’ah from his prayer until he finished it, then remembered that he had not bowed. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him stand, perform the bowing, and prostrate, and then perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sujud al-sahw)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 159

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Safwan from Mansur from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "If a man is certain that he left out a rak’ah from the prayer, and he had already performed two prostrations but omitted the bowing, then he must begin the prayer anew."
arabicText: فأما ما رواه الحسين بن سعيد عن صفوان عن منصور عن أبي بصير عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام قال إذا ايقن الرجل أنه ترك ركعة من الصلاة وقد سجد سجدتين وترك الركوع استأنف الصلاة
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Safwan from Mansur from Abu Basir:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "If a man is certain that he left out a rak’ah from the prayer, and he had already performed two prostrations but omitted the bowing, then he must begin the prayer anew."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 159

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
What was narrated by Sa’d from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Hammad ibn Uthman from Hakam ibn Hukaym, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who forgets a rak’ah, or a prostration, or something from his prayer, and then remembers afterward. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him make up exactly that which he missed." So I asked: "Should he repeat the entire prayer?" Imam (a.s) said: "No."
arabicText: مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ حَكَمِ بْنِ حُكَيْمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَنْسَى مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ رَكْعَةً أَوْ سَجْدَةً أَوْ شَيْئاً مِنْهَا ثُمَّ يَذْكُرُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ« يَقْضِي ذَلِكَ بِعَيْنِهِ» فَقُلْتُ أَ يُعِيدُ اَلصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَ« لاَ»
thaqalaynSanad: What was narrated by Sa’d from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Hammad ibn Uthman from Hakam ibn Hukaym, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who forgets a rak’ah, or a prostration, or something from his prayer, and then remembers afterward. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him make up exactly that which he missed." So I asked: "Should he repeat the entire prayer?" Imam (a.s) said: "No."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 159

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Hammad from ‘Imran al-Halabi, who said:
I said to Him (a.s): "A man doubts while he is standing and does not know whether he has bowed or not." Imam (a.s) said: "Then let him bow."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَشُكُّ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ فَلاَ يَدْرِي أَ رَكَعَ أَمْ لاَ قَالَ« فَلْيَرْكَعْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Hammad from ‘Imran al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Him (a.s): "A man doubts while he is standing and does not know whether he has bowed or not." Imam (a.s) said: "Then let him bow."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 159

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan, and Fadalah from Husayn from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who doubts while he is standing and does not know whether he has bowed or not. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him bow and prostrate."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ شَكَّ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ فَلاَ يَدْرِي أَ رَكَعَ أَمْ لَمْ يَرْكَعْ قَالَ« يَرْكَعُ وَ يَسْجُدُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan, and Fadalah from Husayn from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who doubts while he is standing and does not know whether he has bowed or not. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him bow and prostrate."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 160

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Fadalah from Husayn from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir and al-Halabi:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) concerning a man who does not know whether he has bowed or not. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him bow."
arabicText: فَضَالَةُ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ لاَ يَدْرِي أَ رَكَعَ أَمْ لَمْ يَرْكَعْ قَالَ« يَرْكَعُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Fadalah from Husayn from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir and al-Halabi:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) concerning a man who does not know whether he has bowed or not. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him bow."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 160

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Aban from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): "I complete my standing but do not know whether I have bowed or not." Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, you have bowed, so continue with your prayer, for that is only from Shaytan."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْتَتِمُّ قَائِماً فَلاَ أَدْرِي رَكَعْتُ أَمْ لاَ قَالَ« بَلَى قَدْ رَكَعْتَ فَامْضِ فِي صَلاَتِكَ فَإِنَّمَا ذَلِكَ مِنَ اَلشَّيْطَانِ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Aban from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): "I complete my standing but do not know whether I have bowed or not." Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, you have bowed, so continue with your prayer, for that is only from Shaytan."

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
What was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): "I am in prostration and I doubt, did I bow or not?" Imam (a.s) said: "Continue (with your prayer)."
arabicText: مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَشُكُّ وَ أَنَا سَاجِدٌ فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَ رَكَعْتُ أَمْ لاَ قَالَ« اِمْضِ»
thaqalaynSanad: What was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): "I am in prostration and I doubt, did I bow or not?" Imam (a.s) said: "Continue (with your prayer)."

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Safwan from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): "I experience doubt while I am in prostration, and I do not know whether I have performed the rak‘ah or not." Imam (a.s) said: "You have performed the rak‘ah, continue on."
arabicText: وعنه عن صفوان عن حماد بن عثمان قال قلت لابي عبد الله عليه السلام أشك وانا ساجد فلا أدري ركعت أم لا فقال قد ركعت امضه
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Safwan from Hammad ibn Uthman, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): "I experience doubt while I am in prostration, and I do not know whether I have performed the rak‘ah or not." Imam (a.s) said: "You have performed the rak‘ah, continue on."

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’d from Abu Ja’far from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from al-’Alaʾ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about a man who, after prostrating, doubts whether he had bowed. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him continue with his prayer."
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ شَكَّ بَعْدَ مَا سَجَدَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَرْكَعْ قَالَ« يَمْضِي فِي صَلاَتِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’d from Abu Ja’far from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from al-’Alaʾ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about a man who, after prostrating, doubts whether he had bowed. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him continue with his prayer."

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Him from Abu Ja’far from Ahmad ibn Abi Nasr from Aban ibn Uthman from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): "A man moves down toward prostration and does not know whether he bowed or not." Imam (a.s) said: "He has bowed."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ أَهْوَى إِلَى اَلسُّجُودِ فَلَمْ يَدْرِ أَ رَكَعَ أَمْ لَمْ يَرْكَعْ قَالَ« قَدْ رَكَعَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Him from Abu Ja’far from Ahmad ibn Abi Nasr from Aban ibn Uthman from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): "A man moves down toward prostration and does not know whether he bowed or not." Imam (a.s) said: "He has bowed."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 160

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: Zurarah narrated from Abu Ja’far (a.s) that Imam (a.s) said: "Prayer is not repeated except for five things: purification, time, direction of the Qiblah, bowing, and prostration." Then Imam (a.s) said: "Recitation is Sunnah, and tashahhud is Sunnah, so the Sunnah does not invalidate the obligation."
arabicText: رَوَى زُرَارَةُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« لاَ تُعَادُ اَلصَّلاَةُ إِلاَّ مِنْ خَمْسَةٍ اَلطَّهُورِ وَاَلْوَقْتِ وَاَلْقِبْلَةِ وَاَلرُّكُوعِ وَ اَلسُّجُودِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ« اَلْقِرَاءَةُ سُنَّةٌ وَ اَلتَّشَهُّدُ سُنَّةٌ فَلاَ تَنْقُضُ اَلسُّنَّةُ اَلْفَرِيضَةَ»
thaqalaynMatn: Zurarah narrated from Abu Ja’far (a.s) that Imam (a.s) said: "Prayer is not repeated except for five things: purification, time, direction of the Qiblah, bowing, and prostration." Then Imam (a.s) said: "Recitation is Sunnah, and tashahhud is Sunnah, so the Sunnah does not invalidate the obligation."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 161

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about someone who forgets to perform one prostration and remembers it while standing. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him perform the prostration when he remembers it, as long as he has not yet bowed. But if he has already bowed, then let him continue with his prayer, and when he finishes, he should make it up, and there is no prostration of forgetfulness (sajdat al-sahw) upon him."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَمَّنْ نَسِيَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ سَجْدَةً وَاحِدَةً فَذَكَرَهَا وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ قَالَ« يَسْجُدُهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا مَا لَمْ يَرْكَعْ فَإِنْ كَانَ قَدْ رَكَعَ فَلْيَمْضِ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ وَ إِذَا اِنْصَرَفَ قَضَاهَا وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ سَهْوٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about someone who forgets to perform one prostration and remembers it while standing. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him perform the prostration when he remembers it, as long as he has not yet bowed. But if he has already bowed, then let him continue with his prayer, and when he finishes, he should make it up, and there is no prostration of forgetfulness (sajdat al-sahw) upon him."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 161

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya’qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) was asked about a man who was forgetful and did not know whether he had performed one prostration or two. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him perform another prostration, and after the completion of the prayer, there is no obligation upon him to perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdata al-sahw)."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ سَهَا فَلَمْ يَدْرِ سَجْدَةً سَجَدَ أَمِ اِثْنَتَيْنِ قَالَ« يَسْجُدُ أُخْرَى وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ بَعْدَ اِنْقِضَاءِ اَلصَّلاَةِ سَجْدَتَا اَلسَّهْوِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya’qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) was asked about a man who was forgetful and did not know whether he had performed one prostration or two. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him perform another prostration, and after the completion of the prayer, there is no obligation upon him to perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdata al-sahw)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 161

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who doubts and does not know whether he has prostrated once or twice. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him prostrate until he is certain."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ شَكَّ فَلَمْ يَدْرِ سَجَدَ سَجْدَةً أَمْ سَجْدَتَيْنِ قَالَ« يَسْجُدُ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِنَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who doubts and does not know whether he has prostrated once or twice. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him prostrate until he is certain."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 161

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Amr ibn Uthman al-Khazzaz, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Zayd al-Shahham:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man over whom it became unclear, and he did not know whether he had performed one prostration or two. Imam (a.s) said: "Then let him perform another prostration."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ اَلْخَزَّازِ عَنِ اَلْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ زَيْدٍ اَلشَّحَّامِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ شُبِّهَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَدْرِ وَاحِدَةً سَجَدَ أَوِ اِثْنَتَيْنِ قَالَ« فَلْيَسْجُدْ أُخْرَى»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Amr ibn Uthman al-Khazzaz, from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Zayd al-Shahham:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man over whom it became unclear, and he did not know whether he had performed one prostration or two. Imam (a.s) said: "Then let him perform another prostration."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 162

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Isma'il ibn Jabir:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who forgot to perform the second prostration until he stood up, then while standing he remembered that he had not prostrated. Imam (a.s) said: "Then let him perform the prostration, as long as he has not yet bowed (for ruku’). But if he rises and then remembers after his ruku’ that he did not prostrate, then let him proceed with his prayer until he completes it with the salam, then he should perform the prostration, for it is a makeup (qadahʾ)." And he (narrator) said: “Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If he doubts regarding the ruku’ after having prostrated, then let him proceed. And if he doubts regarding the prostration after having stood up, then let him proceed. Everything in which there is doubt, after it has passed and one has entered into something else, then let him continue with it."
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ سَجْدَةَ اَلثَّانِيَةِ حَتَّى قَامَ فَذَكَرَ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَسْجُدْ قَالَ« فَلْيَسْجُدْ مَا لَمْ يَرْكَعْ فَإِذَا رَفَعَ فَذَكَرَ بَعْدَ رُكُوعِهِ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَسْجُدْ فَلْيَمْضِ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ حَتَّى يُسَلِّمَ ثُمَّ يَسْجُدُهَا فَإِنَّهَا قَضَاءٌ» وَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« إِنْ شَكَّ فِي اَلرُّكُوعِ بَعْدَ مَا سَجَدَ فَلْيَمْضِ وَ إِنْ شَكَّ فِي اَلسُّجُودِ بَعْدَ مَا قَامَ فَلْيَمْضِ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ شَكَّ فِيهِ مِمَّا قَدْ جَاوَزَهُ وَ دَخَلَ فِي غَيْرِهِ فَلْيَمْضِ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Isma'il ibn Jabir:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who forgot to perform the second prostration until he stood up, then while standing he remembered that he had not prostrated. Imam (a.s) said: "Then let him perform the prostration, as long as he has not yet bowed (for ruku’). But if he rises and then remembers after his ruku’ that he did not prostrate, then let him proceed with his prayer until he completes it with the salam, then he should perform the prostration, for it is a makeup (qadahʾ)." And he (narrator) said: “Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If he doubts regarding the ruku’ after having prostrated, then let him proceed. And if he doubts regarding the prostration after having stood up, then let him proceed. Everything in which there is doubt, after it has passed and one has entered into something else, then let him continue with it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 162

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abdur Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man raised his head from prostration and doubted before he became fully seated, not knowing whether he had prostrated or not.” Imam (a.s) said: "He should prostrate." I asked: “And a man who rose from his prostration and doubted before he became fully standing, not knowing whether he had prostrated or not.” Imam (a.s) said: "He should prostrate."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ اَلسُّجُودِ فَشَكَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَسْتَوِيَ جَالِساً فَلَمْ يَدْرِ أَ سَجَدَ أَمْ لَمْ يَسْجُدْ قَالَ «يَسْجُدُ» قُلْتُ فَرَجُلٌ نَهَضَ مِنْ سُجُودِهِ فَشَكَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَسْتَوِيَ قَائِماً فَلَمْ يَدْرِ أَ سَجَدَ أَمْ لَمْ يَسْجُدْ قَالَ« يَسْجُدُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abdur Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man raised his head from prostration and doubted before he became fully seated, not knowing whether he had prostrated or not.” Imam (a.s) said: "He should prostrate." I asked: “And a man who rose from his prostration and doubted before he became fully standing, not knowing whether he had prostrated or not.” Imam (a.s) said: "He should prostrate."

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) (was asked) regarding the man upon whom frequent doubt occurs in prayer, so he doubts in the bowing and does not know whether he bowed or not, and he doubts in the prostration and does not know whether he prostrated or not. Imam (a.s) said: "He should neither prostrate nor bow, and he should continue in his prayer until he is certain with certainty." And (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding the man who forgets a prostration and remembers it after he has stood and bowed. Imam (a.s) said: "He should continue in his prayer and not prostrate until he completes it with the salam. Then when he has given the salam, he should perform a prostration like that which he missed." I asked: “What if he does not remember except after that?” Imam (a.s) said: "He should make up what he missed whenever he remembers it."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَكْثُرُ عَلَيْهِ اَلْوَهْمُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَيَشُكُّ فِي اَلرُّكُوعِ فَلاَ يَدْرِي أَ رَكَعَ أَمْ لاَ وَ يَشُكُّ فِي اَلسُّجُودِ فَلاَ يَدْرِي أَ سَجَدَ أَمْ لاَ فَقَالَ« لاَ يَسْجُدُ وَ لاَ يَرْكَعُ وَ يَمْضِي فِي صَلاَتِهِ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِنَ يَقِيناً» وَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى سَجْدَةً فَذَكَرَهَا بَعْدَ مَا قَامَ وَ رَكَعَ قَالَ« يَمْضِي فِي صَلاَتِهِ وَ لاَ يَسْجُدُ حَتَّى يُسَلِّمَ فَإِذَا سَلَّمَ سَجَدَ مِثْلَ مَا فَاتَهُ» قُلْتُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ إِلاَّ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ« يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) (was asked) regarding the man upon whom frequent doubt occurs in prayer, so he doubts in the bowing and does not know whether he bowed or not, and he doubts in the prostration and does not know whether he prostrated or not. Imam (a.s) said: "He should neither prostrate nor bow, and he should continue in his prayer until he is certain with certainty." And (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding the man who forgets a prostration and remembers it after he has stood and bowed. Imam (a.s) said: "He should continue in his prayer and not prostrate until he completes it with the salam. Then when he has given the salam, he should perform a prostration like that which he missed." I asked: “What if he does not remember except after that?” Imam (a.s) said: "He should make up what he missed whenever he remembers it."

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I asked Abul Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who performs two rak‘ahs of prayer, then remembers in the second rak‘ah while in the state of bowing that he had left out a prostration in the first. He (Imam al-Ridha (a.s)) said: “Abul Hasan (Imam al-Kadhim (a.s)), used to say: "If you left out a prostration in the first rak‘ah and did not know whether it was one or two, then you must start over until two prostrations are certain for you. But if it is in the third or fourth rak‘ah and you left a prostration after having already preserved the bowing (ruku‘), then you repeat the prostration."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يُصَلِّي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ فِي اَلثَّانِيَةِ وَ هُوَ رَاكِعٌ أَنَّهُ تَرَكَ سَجْدَةً فِي اَلْأُولَى قَالَ كَانَ أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ« إِذَا تَرَكْتَ اَلسَّجْدَةَ فِي اَلرَّكْعَةِ اَلْأُولَى فَلَمْ تَدْرِ وَاحِدَةً أَوِ اِثْنَتَيْنِ اِسْتَقْبَلْتَ حَتَّى يَصِحَّ لَكَ ثِنْتَانِ فَإِذَا كَانَ فِي اَلثَّالِثَةِ وَ اَلرَّابِعَةِ فَتَرَكْتَ سَجْدَةً بَعْدَ أَنْ تَكُونَ قَدْ حَفِظْتَ اَلرُّكُوعَ أَعَدْتَ اَلسُّجُودَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abul Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who performs two rak‘ahs of prayer, then remembers in the second rak‘ah while in the state of bowing that he had left out a prostration in the first. He (Imam al-Ridha (a.s)) said: “Abul Hasan (Imam al-Kadhim (a.s)), used to say: "If you left out a prostration in the first rak‘ah and did not know whether it was one or two, then you must start over until two prostrations are certain for you. But if it is in the third or fourth rak‘ah and you left a prostration after having already preserved the bowing (ruku‘), then you repeat the prostration."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 162

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ali ibn Isma'il, from a man, from Mu‘alla ibn Khunays:
I asked Abul Hasan al-Madi (a.s) about a man who forgets a prostration in his prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "If he remembers it before his bowing, he should perform it and continue with his prayer, then perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) after completing the prayer. But if he remembers it after his bowing, he must repeat the prayer. Forgetting a prostration in the first two rak‘ahs and the last two rak‘ahs is the same."
arabicText: مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ خُنَيْسٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْمَاضِيَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى اَلسَّجْدَةَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ قَالَ« إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا قَبْلَ رُكُوعِهِ سَجَدَهَا وَ بَنَى عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيِ اَلسَّهْوِ بَعْدَ اِنْصِرَافِهِ وَإِنْ ذَكَرَهَا بَعْدَ رُكُوعِهِ أَعَادَ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَنِسْيَانُ اَلسَّجْدَةِ فِي اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ وَ اَلْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ سَوَاءٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ali ibn Isma'il, from a man, from Mu‘alla ibn Khunays:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abul Hasan al-Madi (a.s) about a man who forgets a prostration in his prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "If he remembers it before his bowing, he should perform it and continue with his prayer, then perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) after completing the prayer. But if he remembers it after his bowing, he must repeat the prayer. Forgetting a prostration in the first two rak‘ahs and the last two rak‘ahs is the same."

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Ahmad, from Musa ibn Umar, from Muhammad ibn Mansur, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about one who forgets the second prostration of the second rak‘ah or doubts about it. Imam (a.s) said: "If you fear that you may have only placed your face once (in prostration), then when you finish the prayer with the salam, perform one prostration, and place your face once. And there is no (obligation of) prostration for forgetfulness (sahw) upon you."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلَّذِي يَنْسَى اَلسَّجْدَةَ اَلثَّانِيَةَ مِنَ اَلرَّكْعَةِ اَلثَّانِيَةِ أَوْ شَكَّ فِيهَا فَقَالَ« إِذَا خِفْتَ أَنْ لاَ تَكُونَ وَضَعْتَ وَجْهَكَ إِلاَّ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا سَلَّمْتَ سَجَدْتَ سَجْدَةً وَاحِدَةً وَ تَضَعُ وَجْهَكَ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ سَهْوٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn Ahmad, from Musa ibn Umar, from Muhammad ibn Mansur, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about one who forgets the second prostration of the second rak‘ah or doubts about it. Imam (a.s) said: "If you fear that you may have only placed your face once (in prostration), then when you finish the prayer with the salam, perform one prostration, and place your face once. And there is no (obligation of) prostration for forgetfulness (sahw) upon you."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 164

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: What was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from some of our companions, from Sufyan ibn al-Simt: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "You perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) for every addition or deficiency that occurs to you. And whoever leaves out a prostration has certainly committed a deficiency."
arabicText: مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ اَلسِّمْطِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« تَسْجُدُ سَجْدَتَيِ اَلسَّهْوِ فِي كُلِّ زِيَادَةٍ تَدْخُلُ عَلَيْكَ أَوْ نُقْصَانٍ وَ مَنْ تَرَكَ سَجْدَةً فَقَدْ نَقَصَ»
thaqalaynMatn: What was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from some of our companions, from Sufyan ibn al-Simt: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "You perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) for every addition or deficiency that occurs to you. And whoever leaves out a prostration has certainly committed a deficiency."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 164

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Safwan, from Mansur, from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If a man forgets a prostration and is certain that he has left it out, then let him perform it after he sits, before he gives the salam. And if he is in doubt, then let him give the salam and then perform the prostration, and let him recite a light tashahhud, and let him not call it a 'pecking,' for the 'pecking' is the pecking of a crow."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا نَسِيَ اَلرَّجُلُ سَجْدَةً وَ أَيْقَنَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ تَرَكَهَا فَلْيَسْجُدْهَا بَعْدَ مَا يَقْعُدُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ شَاكّاً فَلْيُسَلِّمْ ثُمَّ لْيَسْجُدْهَا وَ لْيَتَشَهَّدْ تَشَهُّداً خَفِيفاً وَ لاَ يُسَمِّيهَا نَقْرَةً فَإِنَّ اَلنَّقْرَةَ نَقْرَةُ اَلْغُرَابِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Safwan, from Mansur, from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If a man forgets a prostration and is certain that he has left it out, then let him perform it after he sits, before he gives the salam. And if he is in doubt, then let him give the salam and then perform the prostration, and let him recite a light tashahhud, and let him not call it a 'pecking,' for the 'pecking' is the pecking of a crow."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 165

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa‘d ibn Abdullah, from Abu Ja‘far, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about a man who prayed and then remembered that he had added an extra prostration. Imam (a.s) said: "He does not repeat the prayer because of a (mistaken) prostration, but he does repeat it because of a (mistaken) rak‘ah."
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ زَادَ سَجْدَةً قَالَ« لاَ يُعِيدُ صَلاَةً مِنْ سَجْدَةٍ وَ يُعِيدُهَا مِنْ رَكْعَةٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa‘d ibn Abdullah, from Abu Ja‘far, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about a man who prayed and then remembered that he had added an extra prostration. Imam (a.s) said: "He does not repeat the prayer because of a (mistaken) prostration, but he does repeat it because of a (mistaken) rak‘ah."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 166

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa‘d, from Abu Ja‘far, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Marwan ibn Muslim, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who doubted and did not know whether he had prostrated twice or once, so he performed another prostration, and then became certain that he had added a prostration. Imam (a.s) said: "No, by Allah (swt), an extra prostration does not invalidate the prayer." And Imam (a.s) said: "He does not repeat his prayer because of a prostration, but he does repeat it because of a rak‘ah."
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ شَكَّ فَلَمْ يَدْرِ أَ سَجَدَ ثِنْتَيْنِ أَمْ وَاحِدَةً فَسَجَدَ أُخْرَى ثُمَّ اِسْتَيْقَنَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ زَادَ سَجْدَةً فَقَالَ« لاَ وَ اَللَّهِ لاَ تُفْسِدُ اَلصَّلاَةَ زِيَادَةُ سَجْدَةٍ» وَ قَالَ« لاَ يُعِيدُ صَلاَتَهُ مِنْ سَجْدَةٍ وَ يُعِيدُهَا مِنْ رَكْعَةٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa‘d, from Abu Ja‘far, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Marwan ibn Muslim, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who doubted and did not know whether he had prostrated twice or once, so he performed another prostration, and then became certain that he had added a prostration. Imam (a.s) said: "No, by Allah (swt), an extra prostration does not invalidate the prayer." And Imam (a.s) said: "He does not repeat his prayer because of a prostration, but he does repeat it because of a rak‘ah."

Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah al-Qaddah, from Ja‘far, from his father (Imam al Sadiq (a.s)), peace be upon them:
(Imam al Sadiq (a.s) said): “(Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about a man who bowed but did not recite the tasbih due to forgetfulness. He (Imam Ali (a.s)) said: "His prayer is complete."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْقَدَّاحِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ رَكَعَ وَ لَمْ يُسَبِّحْ نَاسِياً قَالَ« تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ»»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah al-Qaddah, from Ja‘far, from his father (Imam al Sadiq (a.s)), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam al Sadiq (a.s) said): “(Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about a man who bowed but did not recite the tasbih due to forgetfulness. He (Imam Ali (a.s)) said: "His prayer is complete."

And from him, from Abdullah al-Qaddah, from Ja‘far, from his father (Imam al Sadiq (a.s)), peace be upon him):
(Imam al Sadiq (a.s) said): “(Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about a man who bowed but did not recite the tasbih due to forgetfulness. Imam (a.s) said: "His prayer is complete."

And from him, from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abul Hasan al-Awwal (peace be upon him) about a man who forgot the tasbih in his bowing and prostration. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in that."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ تَسْبِيحَةً فِي رُكُوعِهِ وَ سُجُودِهِ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abul Hasan al-Awwal (peace be upon him) about a man who forgot the tasbih in his bowing and prostration. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in that."

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Uthman ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, who said:
Abu Ja‘far (a.s) said: "Do you know what defines the bowing and the prostration?" I (al-Hadrami) said: “No.” Imam (a.s) said: "Say in the bowing three times: ‘Subhana rabbiyal-‘azim wa bihamdih’, and in the prostration: ‘Subhana rabbiyal-a‘la wa bihamdih’ three times. Whoever leaves out one (recitation) has left out one-third of his prayer, and whoever leaves out two has left out two-thirds of his prayer, and whoever does not recite the tasbih at all, he has no prayer."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« تَدْرِي أَيُّ شَيْءٍ حَدُّ اَلرُّكُوعِ وَ اَلسُّجُودِ» فَقُلْتُ لاَ قَالَ« سَبِّحْ فِي اَلرُّكُوعِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ اَلْعَظِيمِ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ وَ فِي اَلسُّجُودِ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ اَلْأَعْلَى وَ بِحَمْدِهِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَمَنْ نَقَصَ وَاحِدَةً نَقَصَ ثُلُثَ صَلاَتِهِ وَ مَنْ نَقَصَ ثِنْتَيْنِ نَقَصَ ثُلُثَيْ صَلاَتِهِ وَ مَنْ لاَ يُسَبِّحْ فَلاَ صَلاَةَ لَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Uthman ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja‘far (a.s) said: "Do you know what defines the bowing and the prostration?" I (al-Hadrami) said: “No.” Imam (a.s) said: "Say in the bowing three times: ‘Subhana rabbiyal-‘azim wa bihamdih’, and in the prostration: ‘Subhana rabbiyal-a‘la wa bihamdih’ three times. Whoever leaves out one (recitation) has left out one-third of his prayer, and whoever leaves out two has left out two-thirds of his prayer, and whoever does not recite the tasbih at all, he has no prayer."

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-‘Ala’, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who performs the two rak‘ahs of the obligatory prayer but does not sit between them until he bows in the third (rak‘ah). Imam (a.s) said: "Let him complete his prayer, then give the salam, and perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) while he is seated, before he speaks."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ مِنَ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةِ لاَ يَجْلِسُ بَيْنَهُمَا حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ فِي اَلثَّالِثَةِ قَالَ« فَلْيُتِمَّ صَلاَتَهُ ثُمَّ لْيُسَلِّمْ وَ يَسْجُدُ سَجْدَتَيِ اَلسَّهْوِ وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-‘Ala’, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who performs the two rak‘ahs of the obligatory prayer but does not sit between them until he bows in the third (rak‘ah). Imam (a.s) said: "Let him complete his prayer, then give the salam, and perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) while he is seated, before he speaks."

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah and Safwan, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding a man who finishes his prayer and has forgotten the tashahhud until he departs. Imam (a.s) said: "If he is near (to the place of prayer), let him return to his place and recite the tashahhud; otherwise, let him find a clean place and recite the tashahhud there." And Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed, the tashahhud is a sunnah (recommended act) within the prayer."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ وَ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَفْرُغُ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ وَ قَدْ نَسِيَ اَلتَّشَهُّدَ حَتَّى يَنْصَرِفَ فَقَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ قَرِيباً رَجَعَ إِلَى مَكَانِهِ فَتَشَهَّدَ وَ إِلاَّ طَلَبَ مَكَاناً نَظِيفاً فَتَشَهَّدَ فِيهِ» وَ قَالَ« إِنَّمَا اَلتَّشَهُّدُ سُنَّةٌ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah and Safwan, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) regarding a man who finishes his prayer and has forgotten the tashahhud until he departs. Imam (a.s) said: "If he is near (to the place of prayer), let him return to his place and recite the tashahhud; otherwise, let him find a clean place and recite the tashahhud there." And Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed, the tashahhud is a sunnah (recommended act) within the prayer."

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who forgot to sit after the first two rak‘ahs. Imam (a.s) said: "If he remembers before he bows, let him sit; but if he does not remember until after he bows, then let him complete the prayer, and when he finishes, let him give the salam and perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw)."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ« إِنْ ذَكَرَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ فَلْيَجْلِسْ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ فَلْيُتِمَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ فَلْيُسَلِّمْ وَ لْيَسْجُدْ سَجْدَتَيِ اَلسَّهْوِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who forgot to sit after the first two rak‘ahs. Imam (a.s) said: "If he remembers before he bows, let him sit; but if he does not remember until after he bows, then let him complete the prayer, and when he finishes, let him give the salam and perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw)."

And from him, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-‘Ala’, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about a man who performs the two rak‘ahs of the obligatory prayer but does not sit until he bows in the third (rak‘ah). Imam (a.s) said: "He should complete his prayer and perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) while he is seated, before he speaks."
arabicText: وَعَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ [اَ لْ حُ سَ يْ نِ خ ل] بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيِ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةِ فَلاَ يَجْلِسُ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ فِي اَلثَّالِثَةِ قَالَ« يُتِمُّ صَلاَتَهُ وَ يَسْجُدُ سَجْدَتَيِ اَلسَّهْوِ وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ»

Imam (a.s) said: "He should complete his prayer and perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) while he is seated, before he speaks."

And from him, from Fadalah, from al-‘Ala’, from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who performs the two rak‘ahs of the obligatory prayer and does not sit in them until he bows (in the third rak‘ah). Imam (a.s) said: "He should complete his prayer, then give the salam, and perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) while he is seated, before he speaks."
arabicText: وعنه عن فضالة عن العلا عن ابن أبي يعفور قال سألت أبا عبد الله عليه السلام عن الرجل يصلي الركعتين من المكتوبة فلا يجلس فيهما حتى يركع فقال يتم صلاته ثم يسلم ويسجد سجدتي السهو وهو جالس قبل أن يتكلم
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Fadalah, from al-‘Ala’, from Ibn Abi Ya‘fur, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who performs the two rak‘ahs of the obligatory prayer and does not sit in them until he bows (in the third rak‘ah). Imam (a.s) said: "He should complete his prayer, then give the salam, and perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness (sajdatay al-sahw) while he is seated, before he speaks."
