chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’d, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Mu’awiyah ibn Maysarah:
That he (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s) say, or He (a.s) was asked: “Whether a man may pray while sitting cross-legged (‘mutarabbi’an’) or with his legs stretched out.” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ أَوْ سُئِلَ أَ يُصَلِّي اَلرَّجُلُ وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ مُتَرَبِّعاً وَ مَبْسُوطَ اَلرِّجْلَيْنِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’d, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Mu’awiyah ibn Maysarah:
thaqalaynMatn: That he (narrator) heard Abu Abdillah (a.s) say, or He (a.s) was asked: “Whether a man may pray while sitting cross-legged (‘mutarabbi’an’) or with his legs stretched out.” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 181

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, from Humran ibn A’yan, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, who said:
(Imam (a.s) said) "My father, when He (a.s) prayed sitting, would sit cross-legged (‘tarrabba’a’), and when He (a.s) bowed, he would fold his legs."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ حُمْرَانَ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« كَانَ أَبِي إِذَا صَلَّى جَالِساً تَرَبَّعَ فَإِذَا رَكَعَ ثَنَى رِجْلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, from Humran ibn A’yan, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) said) "My father, when He (a.s) prayed sitting, would sit cross-legged (‘tarrabba’a’), and when He (a.s) bowed, he would fold his legs."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 181

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Tatari, from Ibn Ziyad, from Hammad, from Nu’man al-Razi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who missed some prayers and then remembered them at sunrise or at sunset. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him pray as soon as he remembers."
arabicText: اَلطَّاطَرِيُّ عَنِ اِبْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ نُعْمَانَ اَلرَّازِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ فَاتَهُ شَيْءٌ مِنَ اَلصَّلَوَاتِ فَذَكَرَ عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِهَا قَالَ« فَلْيُصَلِّ حِينَ ذَكَرَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Tatari, from Ibn Ziyad, from Hammad, from Nu’man al-Razi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who missed some prayers and then remembered them at sunrise or at sunset. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him pray as soon as he remembers."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 181

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ibn Ziyad, from Zurarah and others, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), who said:
He (a.s) was asked about a man who prayed without ‘taharah’ (ritual purity), or who forgot prayers and did not perform them, or who slept through them. Imam (a.s) said: "He should perform them whenever he remembers them, at whatever hour he remembers, whether night or day."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى بِغَيْرِ طَهُورٍ أَوْ نَسِيَ صَلَوَاتٍُ لَمْ يُصَلِّهَا أَوْ نَامَ عَنْهَا قَالَ« يُصَلِّيهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا فِي أَيَّةِ سَاعَةٍ ذَكَرَهَا لَيْلاً أَوْ نَهَاراً»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ibn Ziyad, from Zurarah and others, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: He (a.s) was asked about a man who prayed without ‘taharah’ (ritual purity), or who forgot prayers and did not perform them, or who slept through them. Imam (a.s) said: "He should perform them whenever he remembers them, at whatever hour he remembers, whether night or day."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 182

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya’qub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Yunus, from Hashim ibn Abi Sa’id al-Makkari, from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "There are five prayers which you may perform at any time: the prayer of the eclipse (‘salat al-kusuf’), the funeral prayer (‘salat al-mayyit’), the prayer of ‘ihram’, a missed prayer that was not performed (‘salat allati tafut’), and the circumambulation prayer (‘salat al-tawaf’). All of these may be performed from Fajr until sunrise, and after ‘Asr until night."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ هَاشِمِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ اَلْمُكَارِي عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« خَمْسُ صَلَوَاتٍُ تُصَلِّيهِنَّ فِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ صَلاَةُ اَلْكُسُوفِ وَ اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ وَ صَلاَةُ اَلْإِحْرَامِ وَ اَلصَّلاَةُ اَلَّتِي تَفُوتُ وَ صَلاَةُ اَلطَّوَافِ مِنَ اَلْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ إِلَى اَللَّيْلِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya’qub, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Yunus, from Hashim ibn Abi Sa’id al-Makkari, from Abu Basir:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "There are five prayers which you may perform at any time: the prayer of the eclipse (‘salat al-kusuf’), the funeral prayer (‘salat al-mayyit’), the prayer of ‘ihram’, a missed prayer that was not performed (‘salat allati tafut’), and the circumambulation prayer (‘salat al-tawaf’). All of these may be performed from Fajr until sunrise, and after ‘Asr until night."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 182

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isma’il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan and Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, all from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Mu’awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s) say: "There are five prayers that are never to be abandoned under any circumstance: when you perform ‘tawaf’ of the House (Ka’bah), when you intend to enter into ‘ihram’, the prayer of the eclipse (‘salat al-kusuf’), when you forget a prayer, then pray it when you remember, and the funeral prayer (‘salat al-janazah’)."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ وَ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« خَمْسُ صَلَوَاتٍُ لاَ تُتْرَكُ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ إِذَا طُفْتَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَ إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تُحْرِمَ وَ صَلاَةُ اَلْكُسُوفِ وَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ فَصَلِّ إِذَا ذَكَرْتَ وَ اَلْجِنَازَةُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isma’il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan and Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, all from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Mu’awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s) say: "There are five prayers that are never to be abandoned under any circumstance: when you perform ‘tawaf’ of the House (Ka’bah), when you intend to enter into ‘ihram’, the prayer of the eclipse (‘salat al-kusuf’), when you forget a prayer, then pray it when you remember, and the funeral prayer (‘salat al-janazah’)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 182

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya’qub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about a man who forgets the Dhuhr prayer until the time of ‘Asr enters. Imam (a.s) said: "He begins with Dhuhr, and likewise with the (other) prayers, begin with the one you forgot, unless you fear that the time of the current prayer will end. In that case, begin with the one whose time you are in, and then make up the one you forgot."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ نَسِيَ اَلظُّهْرَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ وَقْتُ اَلْعَصْرِ قَالَ« يَبْدَأُ بِالظُّهْرِ وَ كَذَلِكَ اَلصَّلَوَاتُ تَبْدَأُ بِالَّتِي نَسِيتَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَخَافَ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ وَقْتُ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَتَبْدَأُ بِالَّتِي أَنْتَ فِي وَقْتِهَا ثُمَّ تَقْضِي اَلَّتِي نَسِيتَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya’qub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about a man who forgets the Dhuhr prayer until the time of ‘Asr enters. Imam (a.s) said: "He begins with Dhuhr, and likewise with the (other) prayers, begin with the one you forgot, unless you fear that the time of the current prayer will end. In that case, begin with the one whose time you are in, and then make up the one you forgot."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 182

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s):
He (a.s) was asked about a man who prayed without ritual purification (‘tahur’), or forgot a prayer and did not perform it, or slept through it. Imam (a.s) said: "He should make it up whenever he remembers it, at whatever hour he remembers, by night or by day. But if the time of another prayer enters and he has not yet completed the missed one, then let him continue, as long as he does not fear that the time for the present prayer will expire. If he fears that, then this current prayer takes precedence, so let him pray it. Then, once he has prayed it, he should make up the missed prayer afterwards. And he must not perform any supererogatory (‘nafl’) rak’ah until he has made up all of the obligatory (‘faridah’) prayers."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى بِغَيْرِ طَهُورٍ أَوْ نَسِيَ صَلاَةً لَمْ يُصَلِّهَا أَوْ نَامَ عَنْهَا فَقَالَ« يَقْضِيهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا فِي أَيِّ سَاعَةٍ ذَكَرَهَا مِنْ لَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ فَإِذَا دَخَلَ وَقْتُ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ لَمْ يُتِمَّ مَا قَدْ فَاتَهُ فَلْيَمْضِ مَا لَمْ يَتَخَوَّفْ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ وَقْتُ هَذِهِ اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلَّتِي قَدْ حَضَرَتْ وَ هَذِهِ أَحَقُّ بِوَقْتِهَا فَلْيُصَلِّهَا فَإِذَا قَضَاهَا فَلْيُصَلِّ مَا فَاتَهُ فِيمَا قَدْ مَضَى وَ لاَ يَتَطَوَّعْ بِرَكْعَةٍ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ اَلْفَرِيضَةَ كُلَّهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja’far (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: He (a.s) was asked about a man who prayed without ritual purification (‘tahur’), or forgot a prayer and did not perform it, or slept through it. Imam (a.s) said: "He should make it up whenever he remembers it, at whatever hour he remembers, by night or by day. But if the time of another prayer enters and he has not yet completed the missed one, then let him continue, as long as he does not fear that the time for the present prayer will expire. If he fears that, then this current prayer takes precedence, so let him pray it. Then, once he has prayed it, he should make up the missed prayer afterwards. And he must not perform any supererogatory (‘nafl’) rak’ah until he has made up all of the obligatory (‘faridah’) prayers."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 182

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from al-Qasim ibn ‘Urwah, from ‘Ubayd, from Zurarah:
Abu Ja’far (a.s) said: "If you miss a prayer and then remember it during the time of another prayer, and you know that if you perform the one you missed first, you will still be within the time for the current prayer, then begin with the one you missed. For Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, says: ‘And establish the prayer for My remembrance’ (Surah Taha 20:14). But if you know that by praying the one you missed first, you will miss the current one, then begin with the one whose time you are in, and make up the other afterwards."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا فَاتَتْكَ صَلاَةٌ فَذَكَرْتَهَا فِي وَقْتِ أُخْرَى فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ اَلَّتِي فَاتَتْكَ كُنْتَ مِنَ اَلْأُخْرَى فِي وَقْتٍ فَابْدَأْ بِالَّتِي فَاتَتْكَ فَإِنَّ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ« وَ أَقِمِ اَلصَّلاٰةَ لِذِكْرِي» وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ إِذَا صَلَّيْتَ اَلَّتِي فَاتَتْكَ فَاتَتْكَ اَلَّتِي بَعْدَهَا فَابْدَأْ بِالَّتِي أَنْتَ فِي وَقْتِهَا وَ اِقْضِ اَلْأُخْرَى»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from al-Qasim ibn ‘Urwah, from ‘Ubayd, from Zurarah:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja’far (a.s) said: "If you miss a prayer and then remember it during the time of another prayer, and you know that if you perform the one you missed first, you will still be within the time for the current prayer, then begin with the one you missed. For Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, says: ‘And establish the prayer for My remembrance’ (Surah Taha 20:14). But if you know that by praying the one you missed first, you will miss the current one, then begin with the one whose time you are in, and make up the other afterwards."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 183

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’d ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn Buzay’ al-’Adawi, from Abu al-Hasan Abdullah ibn ‘Awn al-Shami, who said Abdullah ibn Abi Ya’fur narrated to me:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) (was asked) regarding making up the night prayer (‘salat al-layl’) and ‘witr’ that a man misses, may he make it up after the morning prayer and after ‘Asr? Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in that."
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ اَلْعَدَوِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَوْنٍ اَلشَّامِيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اَللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي قَضَاءِ صَلاَةِ اَللَّيْلِ وَ اَلْوَتْرِ تَفُوتُ اَلرَّجُلَ أَ يَقْضِيهَا بَعْدَ صَلاَةِ اَلْفَجْرِ وَ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’d ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn Buzay’ al-’Adawi, from Abu al-Hasan Abdullah ibn ‘Awn al-Shami, who said Abdullah ibn Abi Ya’fur narrated to me:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) (was asked) regarding making up the night prayer (‘salat al-layl’) and ‘witr’ that a man misses, may he make it up after the morning prayer and after ‘Asr? Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in that."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 183

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Musa ibn Ja’far ibn Abi Ja’far, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Maymun, from Muhammad ibn Faraj, who said:
I wrote to the Righteous Servant (al Abd al-Salih (a.s)) asking Him (a.s) about certain issues. Imam (a.s) wrote back to me: "Pray as many ‘nafilah’ (supererogatory) prayers as you wish after ‘Asr, and pray as many ‘nafilah’ prayers as you wish after the morning (‘al-ghadah’) prayer."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ فَرَجٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى اَلْعَبْدِ اَلصَّالِحِ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ مَسَائِلَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ« وَ صَلِّ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ مِنَ اَلنَّوَافِلِ مَا شِئْتَ وَ صَلِّ بَعْدَ اَلْغَدَاةِ مِنَ اَلنَّوَافِلِ مَا شِئْتَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Musa ibn Ja’far ibn Abi Ja’far, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Maymun, from Muhammad ibn Faraj, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to the Righteous Servant (al Abd al-Salih (a.s)) asking Him (a.s) about certain issues. Imam (a.s) wrote back to me: "Pray as many ‘nafilah’ (supererogatory) prayers as you wish after ‘Asr, and pray as many ‘nafilah’ prayers as you wish after the morning (‘al-ghadah’) prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 183

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn ‘Umar al-Zayyat, from Jamil ibn Darraj, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him, about making up the night prayer (‘salat al-layl’) after Fajr until the sun rises. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, and also after ‘Asr until night. This is from the concealed secrets of the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُمَرَ اَلزَّيَّاتِ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْأَوَّلَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ قَضَاءِ صَلاَةِ اَللَّيْلِ بَعْدَ اَلْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ اَلشَّمْسِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ إِلَى اَللَّيْلِ فَهُوَ مِنْ سِرِّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ اَلْمَخْزُونِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn ‘Umar al-Zayyat, from Jamil ibn Darraj, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (a.s) (the First), peace be upon him, about making up the night prayer (‘salat al-layl’) after Fajr until the sun rises. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, and also after ‘Asr until night. This is from the concealed secrets of the family of Muhammad (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 184

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn ‘Umayrah, from Sulayman ibn Harun, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about making up prayers after ‘Asr. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, they are merely ‘nawafil’ (supererogatory prayers), so make them up whenever you wish."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ هَارُونَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ قَضَاءِ اَلصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ إِنَّمَا هِيَ اَلنَّوَافِلُ فَاقْضِهَا مَتَى مَا شِئْتَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn ‘Umayrah, from Sulayman ibn Harun, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about making up prayers after ‘Asr. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, they are merely ‘nawafil’ (supererogatory prayers), so make them up whenever you wish."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 184

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub and al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-’Alaʾ:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "Make up the daytime prayer at whatever hour you wish, by night or by day, all of it is the same."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ وَ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اِقْضِ صَلاَةَ اَلنَّهَارِ أَيَّ سَاعَةٍ شِئْتَ مِنْ لَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ كُلُّ ذَلِكَ سَوَاءٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub and al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-’Alaʾ:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "Make up the daytime prayer at whatever hour you wish, by night or by day, all of it is the same."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 184

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Ibn Uthman, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Ibn Abi Ya’fur, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s) say: "The daytime prayer may be made up at whatever hour you wish, whether by night or by day."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« صَلاَةُ اَلنَّهَارِ يَجُوزُ قَضَاؤُهَا أَيَّ سَاعَةٍ شِئْتَ مِنْ لَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Fadalah, from Ibn Uthman, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from Ibn Abi Ya’fur, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s) say: "The daytime prayer may be made up at whatever hour you wish, whether by night or by day."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 184

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr and Ahmad ibn Abi Nasr in one of their chains of transmission, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) was asked about making up prayers (‘qadah’) before sunrise and after ‘Asr. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, make it up, for this is from the secret knowledge of the Family of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلنَّضْرِ وَ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ فِي بَعْضِ أَسَانِيدِهِمَا قَالَ: سُئِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْقَضَاءِ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ فَاقْضِهِ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ سِرِّ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr and Ahmad ibn Abi Nasr in one of their chains of transmission, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) was asked about making up prayers (‘qadah’) before sunrise and after ‘Asr. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, make it up, for this is from the secret knowledge of the Family of Muhammad (saws), peace be upon them."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 184

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Tatari, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah and Ali ibn Ribat, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "There is no prayer after Fajr until the sun rises. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘The sun rises between the horns of Satan and sets between the horns of Satan.’ And Imam (a.s) said: “There is no prayer after ‘Asr until Maghrib is performed.”
arabicText: اَلطَّاطَرِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِبَاطٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَ اَلْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ اَلشَّمْسُ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ قَالَ« إِنَّ اَلشَّمْسَ تَطْلُعُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَيْ شَيْطَانٍ وَ تَغْرُبُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَيْ شَيْطَانٍ» وَ قَالَ« لاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تُصَلَّى اَلْمَغْرِبُ»»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Tatari, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah and Ali ibn Ribat, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad ibn al-Halabi:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "There is no prayer after Fajr until the sun rises. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘The sun rises between the horns of Satan and sets between the horns of Satan.’ And Imam (a.s) said: “There is no prayer after ‘Asr until Maghrib is performed.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 184

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Sukayn, from Mu’awiyah ibn ‘Ammar:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "There is no prayer after ‘Asr until Maghrib, and no prayer after Fajr until the sun rises."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُكَيْنٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَ اَلْعَصْرِ حَتَّى اَلْمَغْرِبِ وَ لاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَ اَلْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ اَلشَّمْسُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Sukayn, from Mu’awiyah ibn ‘Ammar:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "There is no prayer after ‘Asr until Maghrib, and no prayer after Fajr until the sun rises."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 185

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Bilal, who said:
I wrote to Him (a.s) regarding making up supererogatory prayers (‘nafilah’) from the rising of Fajr until sunrise, and from after ‘Asr until sunset. He (a.s) wrote back: "That is not permissible except for one who is making up missed prayers (‘al-muqtadi’); as for anyone else, it is not."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ فِي قَضَاءِ اَلنَّافِلَةِ مِنْ طُلُوعِ اَلْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ مِنْ بَعْدِ اَلْعَصْرِ إِلَى أَنْ تَغِيبَ اَلشَّمْسُ فَكَتَبَ« لاَ يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ لِلْمُقْتَضِي فَأَمَّا لِغَيْرِهِ فَلاَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Bilal, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to Him (a.s) regarding making up supererogatory prayers (‘nafilah’) from the rising of Fajr until sunrise, and from after ‘Asr until sunset. He (a.s) wrote back: "That is not permissible except for one who is making up missed prayers (‘al-muqtadi’); as for anyone else, it is not."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 185

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn Ali narrated: A group of our elders narrated to me (narrator) from Abu al-Hasan Muhammad ibn Ja’far al-Asadi, may Allah (swt) be pleased with him, that among the responses received to his questions from Muhammad ibn Uthman al-’Amri, may Allah (swt) sanctify his soul, regarding the questions he had sent, was: "As for what you asked about, prayer at the time of sunrise and at the time of sunset, even if people say that the sun rises between the horns of Satan and sets between the horns of Satan, then there is nothing by which the nose of Satan is more forcefully rubbed in humiliation than prayer. So perform the prayer and humiliate Satan."
arabicText: رَوَى أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ رَوَى لِي جَمَاعَةٌ مِنْ مَشَايِخِنَا عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ اَلْأَسَدِيِّ رَضِيَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُ: أَنَّهُ وَرَدَ عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا وَرَدَ مِنْ جَوَابِ مَسَائِلِهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ اَلْعَمْرِيِّ قَدَّسَ اَللَّهُ رُوحَهُ« وَأَمَّا مَا سَأَلْتَ عَنْهُ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِهَا فَلَئِنْ كَانَ يَقُولُ اَلنَّاسُ إِنَّ اَلشَّمْسَ تَطْلُعُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَيْ شَيْطَانٍ وَ تَغْرُبُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَيْ شَيْطَانٍ فَمَا أُرْغِمَ أَنْفُ اَلشَّيْطَانِ بِشَيْءٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَصَلِّهَا وَ أَرْغِمِ اَلشَّيْطَانَ»
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn Ali narrated: A group of our elders narrated to me (narrator) from Abu al-Hasan Muhammad ibn Ja’far al-Asadi, may Allah (swt) be pleased with him, that among the responses received to his questions from Muhammad ibn Uthman al-’Amri, may Allah (swt) sanctify his soul, regarding the questions he had sent, was: "As for what you asked about, prayer at the time of sunrise and at the time of sunset, even if people say that the sun rises between the horns of Satan and sets between the horns of Satan, then there is nothing by which the nose of Satan is more forcefully rubbed in humiliation than prayer. So perform the prayer and humiliate Satan."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 185

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
‘Amir ibn Abdillah ibn Juda’ah narrated:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "There is no servant who recites the end of Surat al-Kahf when he goes to sleep except that he will wake up at the hour he desires."
arabicText: رَوَى عَامِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جُذَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يَقْرَأُ آخِرَ اَلْكَهْفِ حِينَ يَنَامُ إِلاَّ اِسْتَيْقَظَ فِي اَلسَّاعَةِ اَلَّتِي يُرِيدُ»
thaqalaynSanad: ‘Amir ibn Abdillah ibn Juda’ah narrated:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "There is no servant who recites the end of Surat al-Kahf when he goes to sleep except that he will wake up at the hour he desires."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 186

chapter: Chapter on the Detailed Explanation of Prayer, Including the Obligatory and Recommended, and What is Permissible and Not Permissible.
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: And it has been narrated from the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, that He (saws) said: "Whoever recites this verse at the time of sleep: ‘Say: I am only a human being like you. It is revealed to me that your God (azj) is One God (azj). So whoever hopes to meet his Lord (azj), let him do righteous work and not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord (azj)’ (Surah Kahf 18:110). (Thus) a light will shine for him extending to the Sacred Mosque (‘al-Masjid al-Haram’), and within that light will be angels seeking forgiveness for him until morning."
arabicText: وَ رُوِيَ عَنِ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« مَنْ قَرَأَ هَذِهِ اَلْآيَةَ عِنْدَ مَنَامِهِ« قُلْ إِنَّمٰا أَنَا بَشَرٌ مِثْلُكُمْ يُوحىٰ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمٰا إِلٰهُكُمْ إِلٰهٌ وٰاحِدٌ فَمَنْ كٰانَ يَرْجُوا لِقٰاءَ رَبِّهِ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلاً صٰالِحاً وَ لاٰ يُشْرِكْ بِعِبٰادَةِ رَبِّهِ أَحَداً» سَطَعَ لَهُ نُورٌ إِلَى اَلْمَسْجِدِ اَلْحَرَامِ حَشْوُ ذَلِكَ اَلنُّورِ مَلاَئِكَةٌ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لَهُ حَتَّى يُصْبِحَ»
thaqalaynMatn: And it has been narrated from the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, that He (saws) said: "Whoever recites this verse at the time of sleep: ‘Say: I am only a human being like you. It is revealed to me that your God (azj) is One God (azj). So whoever hopes to meet his Lord (azj), let him do righteous work and not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord (azj)’ (Surah Kahf 18:110). (Thus) a light will shine for him extending to the Sacred Mosque (‘al-Masjid al-Haram’), and within that light will be angels seeking forgiveness for him until morning."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 186

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
What was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from al-Nadr, from ‘Asim, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Ja’far (a.s) about a man who has doubt in the first rak’ah. Imam (a.s) said: "He must start over."
arabicText: مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ شَكَّ فِي اَلرَّكْعَةِ اَلْأُولَى قَالَ« يَسْتَأْنِفُ»
thaqalaynSanad: What was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa’id, from al-Nadr, from ‘Asim, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Ja’far (a.s) about a man who has doubt in the first rak’ah. Imam (a.s) said: "He must start over."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 186

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad bin Sinan, from Ibn Maskan and Fadalah, from Husayn bin Uthman, from Ibn Maskan, from Anbasah bin Mus'ab, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: "If you are doubtful regarding the first two rak‘ahs, then repeat (the prayer)."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ عَنْبَسَةَ بْنِ مُصْعَبٍ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِذَا شَكَكْتَ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ فَأَعِدْ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad bin Sinan, from Ibn Maskan and Fadalah, from Husayn bin Uthman, from Ibn Maskan, from Anbasah bin Mus'ab, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: "If you are doubtful regarding the first two rak‘ahs, then repeat (the prayer)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 186

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ahmad al-Qarawi, from Aban, from Isma'il al-Ju'fi and Ibn Abi Ya'fur:
Abu Ja'far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, they said: "If you do not know whether you prayed one rak‘ah or two, then start over."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ اَلْقَرَوِيِّ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ اَلْجُعْفِيِّ وَ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ:« إِذَا لَمْ تَدْرِ أَ وَاحِدَةً صَلَّيْتَ أَمْ ثِنْتَيْنِ فَاسْتَقْبِلْ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ahmad al-Qarawi, from Aban, from Isma'il al-Ju'fi and Ibn Abi Ya'fur:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja'far (a.s) and Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon them both, they said: "If you do not know whether you prayed one rak‘ah or two, then start over."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 187

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Musa bin Bakr, who said:
Al-Fudayl asked Him (a.s) about forgetfulness (in prayer). Imam (a.s) said: "If you are doubtful about first two (rak‘ahs), then repeat (the prayer)."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلَهُ اَلْفُضَيْلُ عَنِ اَلسَّهْوِ فَقَالَ« إِذَا شَكَكْتَ فِي اَلْأُولَيَيْنِ فَأَعِدْ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Nadr, from Musa bin Bakr, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Al-Fudayl asked Him (a.s) about forgetfulness (in prayer). Imam (a.s) said: "If you are doubtful about first two (rak‘ahs), then repeat (the prayer)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 187

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Hasan, from Zur‘ah, from Sama‘ah, who said:
Imam (a.s) said: "If a man is forgetful in the first two rak‘ahs of the Dhuhr and ‘Asr prayers and does not know whether he prayed one or two, then it is obligatory upon him to repeat the prayer."
arabicText: اَلْحَسَنُ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ قَالَ:« إِذَا سَهَا اَلرَّجُلُ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ مِنَ اَلظُّهْرِ وَاَلْعَصْرِ وَلَمْ يَدْرِ وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى أَمْ ثِنْتَيْنِ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُعِيدَ اَلصَّلاَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Hasan, from Zur‘ah, from Sama‘ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "If a man is forgetful in the first two rak‘ahs of the Dhuhr and ‘Asr prayers and does not know whether he prayed one or two, then it is obligatory upon him to repeat the prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 187

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Fadalah, from Rifa‘ah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who does not know whether he prayed one rak‘ah or two. Imam (a.s) said: "He should repeat (the prayer)."
arabicText: فَضَالَةُ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ لاَ يَدْرِي أَ رَكْعَةً صَلَّى أَمْ ثِنْتَيْنِ قَالَ« يُعِيدُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Fadalah, from Rifa‘ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who does not know whether he prayed one rak‘ah or two. Imam (a.s) said: "He should repeat (the prayer)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 187

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Husayn bin Uthman, from Harun bin Kharijah, from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If you are forgetful in the first two rak‘ahs, then repeat them until you establish them firmly."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا سَهَوْتَ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ فَأَعِدْهُمَا حَتَّى تُثْبِتَهُمَا»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Fadalah, from Husayn bin Uthman, from Harun bin Kharijah, from Abu Basir:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If you are forgetful in the first two rak‘ahs, then repeat them until you establish them firmly."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 187

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Hammad, from al-Fadl bin Abd al-Malik, who said:
Imam (a.s) said to me: "If you do not remember the first two rak‘ahs, then repeat your prayer."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ قَالَ قَالَ لِي:« إِذَا لَمْ تَحْفَظِ اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ فَأَعِدْ صَلاَتَكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Fadalah, from Hammad, from al-Fadl bin Abd al-Malik, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said to me: "If you do not remember the first two rak‘ahs, then repeat your prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 187

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad bin Ya‘qub, from Muhammad bin Isma‘il, from al-Fadl bin Shadhan, and Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, all from Hammad bin ‘Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from one of them (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them both, who said:
I said to Him (a.s): “A man does not know whether he prayed one rak‘ah or two.” Imam (a.s) said: "He should repeat (the prayer)."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلٌ لاَ يَدْرِي أَ وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى أَمْ ثِنْتَيْنِ قَالَ «يُعِيدُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad bin Ya‘qub, from Muhammad bin Isma‘il, from al-Fadl bin Shadhan, and Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, all from Hammad bin ‘Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from one of them (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them both, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Him (a.s): “A man does not know whether he prayed one rak‘ah or two.” Imam (a.s) said: "He should repeat (the prayer)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 187

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad bin Yahya, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from al-Hasan bin Ali al-Washa’ and al-Husayn bin Muhammad, from Mu‘alla bin Muhammad, from al-Washa’, who said:
Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: "Repetition is for the first two rak‘ahs, and forgetfulness is for the last two rak‘ahs."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْوَشَّاءِ وَ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْوَشَّاءِ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« اَلْإِعَادَةُ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ وَ اَلسَّهْوُ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad bin Yahya, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from al-Hasan bin Ali al-Washa’ and al-Husayn bin Muhammad, from Mu‘alla bin Muhammad, from al-Washa’, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: "Repetition is for the first two rak‘ahs, and forgetfulness is for the last two rak‘ahs."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 188

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad bin Muhammad bin ‘Isa, from Ali bin al-Hakam, from al-Husayn bin Abi al-‘Ala’, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who does not know whether he prayed two rak‘ahs or one. Imam (a.s) said: "He should complete (the prayer)."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ لاَ يَدْرِي أَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ صَلَّى أَمْ وَاحِدَةً قَالَ« يُتِمُّ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Ahmad bin Muhammad bin ‘Isa, from Ali bin al-Hakam, from al-Husayn bin Abi al-‘Ala’, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who does not know whether he prayed two rak‘ahs or one. Imam (a.s) said: "He should complete (the prayer)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 188

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And what was narrated by Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya, from al-Sindi bin al-Rabi‘, from al-Hasan bin Mahbub, from Abd al-Rahman bin al-Hajjaj:
Abu Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, said regarding a man who does not know whether he prayed one rak‘ah or two. Imam (a.s) said: "He builds upon the one rak‘ah."
arabicText: وَ مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ بْنِ اَلرَّبِيعِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ عَنْ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ لاَ يَدْرِي رَكْعَةً صَلَّى أَمِ اِثْنَتَيْنِ قَالَ« يَبْنِي عَلَى اَلرَّكْعَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And what was narrated by Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya, from al-Sindi bin al-Rabi‘, from al-Hasan bin Mahbub, from Abd al-Rahman bin al-Hajjaj:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, said regarding a man who does not know whether he prayed one rak‘ah or two. Imam (a.s) said: "He builds upon the one rak‘ah."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 188

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And what was narrated by Sa‘d bin Abdillah, from Muhammad bin al-Husayn, from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr, from Abd al-Karim bin ‘Amr, from Abdillah bin Abi Ya‘fur, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who does not know whether he prayed two rak‘ahs or one. Imam (a.s) said: "He completes (the prayer) with one rak‘ah."
arabicText: وما رواه سعد بن عبد الله عن محمد بن الحسين عن أحمد ابن محمد بن أبى نصر عن عبد الكريم بن عمرو عن عبد الله بن أبي يعفور قال سألت أبا عبد الله عليه السلام عن الرجل لا يدري أركعتين صلى ام واحدة فقال يتم بركعة
thaqalaynSanad: And what was narrated by Sa‘d bin Abdillah, from Muhammad bin al-Husayn, from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr, from Abd al-Karim bin ‘Amr, from Abdillah bin Abi Ya‘fur, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who does not know whether he prayed two rak‘ahs or one. Imam (a.s) said: "He completes (the prayer) with one rak‘ah."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 188

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And what was narrated by Sa‘d also, from Abu Ja‘far, from al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Fadalah bin Ayyub, from al-Husayn bin Abi al-‘Ala’:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, (said) regarding a man who does not know whether he prayed two rak‘ahs or one. Imam (a.s) said: "He completes according to his prayer."
arabicText: وَ مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدٌ أَيْضاً عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ لاَ يَدْرِي رَكْعَتَيْنِ صَلَّى أَمْ وَاحِدَةً قَالَ« يُتِمُّ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ» فاول ما في هذه الاخبار انها لا تعارض ما قدمناه من الاخبار لانها اضعاف هذه ولا يجوز العدول عن الاكثر الى الاقل إلا لدليل ولو كانت هذه الاخبار معارضة لها ومساوية لم يكن فيها ما ينقض ما قدمناه لانه ليس في شئ من هذه الاخبار أن الشك إذا وقع في الاولة والثانية من صلاة الفرايض أو صلاة النوافل وإذا لم يكن هذا في الخبر حملناها على النوافل لان النوافل عندنا لا سهو فيها ويبني الانسان إن شاء على الاقل وإن شاء على الاكثر وإن كان البناء على الاقل افضل ومتى حملنا هذه الاخبار على ما ذكرناه كنا قد جمعنا بينها اجمع ولم نكن قد اطرحنا منها شيئا
thaqalaynSanad: And what was narrated by Sa‘d also, from Abu Ja‘far, from al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Fadalah bin Ayyub, from al-Husayn bin Abi al-‘Ala’:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, (said) regarding a man who does not know whether he prayed two rak‘ahs or one. Imam (a.s) said: "He completes according to his prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 188

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad bin Ya‘qub, from Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, and from Muhammad bin Isma‘il, from al-Fadl bin Shadhan, all from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs bin al-Bakhtari and others:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If you are doubtful in Maghrib, then repeat (the prayer), and if you are doubtful in Fajr, then repeat (the prayer)."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ جَمِيعاً عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ اَلْبَخْتَرِيِّ وَ غَيْرِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا شَكَكْتَ فِي اَلْمَغْرِبِ فَأَعِدْ وَ إِذَا شَكَكْتَ فِي اَلْفَجْرِ فَأَعِدْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad bin Ya‘qub, from Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, and from Muhammad bin Isma‘il, from al-Fadl bin Shadhan, all from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs bin al-Bakhtari and others:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If you are doubtful in Maghrib, then repeat (the prayer), and if you are doubtful in Fajr, then repeat (the prayer)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 189

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad bin Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who is praying and does not know whether he prayed one rak‘ah or two. Imam (a.s) said: "He should start over until he is certain that he has completed (the prayer), and this applies in Jumu‘ah, in Maghrib, and in prayer during travel."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي وَ لاَ يَدْرِي أَ وَاحِدَةً صَلَّى أَمِ اِثْنَتَيْنِ قَالَ« يَسْتَقْبِلُ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِنَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ أَتَمَّ وَ فِي اَلْجُمُعَةِ وَ فِي اَلْمَغْرِبِ وَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad bin Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who is praying and does not know whether he prayed one rak‘ah or two. Imam (a.s) said: "He should start over until he is certain that he has completed (the prayer), and this applies in Jumu‘ah, in Maghrib, and in prayer during travel."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 189

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad bin ‘Isa, from Yunus, from a man:
Abu Ja‘far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no forgetfulness in Maghrib and Fajr."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لَيْسَ فِي اَلْمَغْرِبِ وَ اَلْفَجْرِ سَهْوٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad bin ‘Isa, from Yunus, from a man:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja‘far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no forgetfulness in Maghrib and Fajr."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 189

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Safwan and Fadalah, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad bin Muslim, from one of them (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about forgetfulness in Maghrib. Imam (a.s) said: "He should repeat (the prayer) until he remembers, for it is not like the Shaf‘ (even-numbered prayers)."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلسَّهْوِ فِي اَلْمَغْرِبِ قَالَ« يُعِيدُ حَتَّى يَحْفَظَ إِنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ مِثْلَ اَلشَّفْعِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Safwan and Fadalah, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad bin Muslim, from one of them (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them both, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about forgetfulness in Maghrib. Imam (a.s) said: "He should repeat (the prayer) until he remembers, for it is not like the Shaf‘ (even-numbered prayers)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 189

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad bin Sinan, from Ibn Maskan, and Fadalah, from Husayn, from Ibn Maskan, from Anbasah bin Mus‘ab, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If you are doubtful in Maghrib, then repeat (the prayer), and if you are doubtful in Fajr, then repeat (the prayer)."
arabicText: وعنه عن محمد بن سنان عن ابن مسكان وفضالة عن حسين عن ابن مسكان عن عنبسة بن مصعب قال قال أبو عبد الله عليه السلام إذا شككت في المغرب فأعد وإذا شككت في الفجر فأعد
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad bin Sinan, from Ibn Maskan, and Fadalah, from Husayn, from Ibn Maskan, from Anbasah bin Mus‘ab, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If you are doubtful in Maghrib, then repeat (the prayer), and if you are doubtful in Fajr, then repeat (the prayer)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 190

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Musa bin Bakr, from al-Fudayl, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about forgetfulness. Imam (a.s) said: "In the Maghrib prayer, if you do not remember whether it was three or four (rak‘ahs), then repeat your prayer."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلسَّهْوِ فَقَالَ« فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْمَغْرِبِ إِذَا لَمْ تَحْفَظْ مَا بَيْنَ اَلثَّلاَثِ إِلَى اَلْأَرْبَعِ فَأَعِدْ صَلاَتَكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Nadr, from Musa bin Bakr, from al-Fudayl, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about forgetfulness. Imam (a.s) said: "In the Maghrib prayer, if you do not remember whether it was three or four (rak‘ahs), then repeat your prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 190

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Hasan, from Zur‘ah bin Muhammad, from al-Hadrami, from Sama‘ah, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about forgetfulness in the Fajr prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "If you do not know whether you prayed one rak‘ah or two, then repeat the prayer from the beginning. And Jumu‘ah also, if the Imam (of prayer) is forgetful in it, then he must repeat the prayer, because it is two rak‘ahs. And Maghrib, if one is forgetful in it and does not know how many rak‘ahs he prayed, then he must repeat the prayer."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلسَّهْوِ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْغَدَاةِ قَالَ «إِذَا لَمْ تَدْرِ وَاحِدَةً صَلَّيْتَ أَمْ ثِنْتَيْنِ فَأَعِدِ اَلصَّلاَةَ مِنْ أَوَّلِهَا وَ اَلْجُمُعَةُ أَيْضاً إِذَا سَهَا فِيهَا اَلْإِمَامُ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُعِيدَ اَلصَّلاَةَ لِأَنَّهَا رَكْعَتَانِ وَ اَلْمَغْرِبُ إِذَا سَهَا فِيهَا وَ لَمْ يَدْرِ كَمْ رَكْعَةً صَلَّى فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُعِيدَ اَلصَّلاَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Hasan, from Zur‘ah bin Muhammad, from al-Hadrami, from Sama‘ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about forgetfulness in the Fajr prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "If you do not know whether you prayed one rak‘ah or two, then repeat the prayer from the beginning. And Jumu‘ah also, if the Imam (of prayer) is forgetful in it, then he must repeat the prayer, because it is two rak‘ahs. And Maghrib, if one is forgetful in it and does not know how many rak‘ahs he prayed, then he must repeat the prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 190

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Husayn bin Uthman, from Harun bin Kharijah, from Abu Basir, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If you are forgetful in the Maghrib prayer, then repeat the prayer."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ :«إِذَا سَهَوْتَ فِي اَلْمَغْرِبِ فَأَعِدِ اَلصَّلاَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Fadalah, from Husayn bin Uthman, from Harun bin Kharijah, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If you are forgetful in the Maghrib prayer, then repeat the prayer."

And from him, from Fadalah, from al-‘Ala’, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about a man who doubts in the Fajr prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "He should repeat (the prayer)." I asked: (how about) "Maghrib?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, and Witr, and Jumu‘ah", without me asking Him (a.s) about them.

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, and from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs bin al-Bakhtari and more than one person:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “If you are doubtful in Maghrib, then repeat (the prayer), and if you are doubtful in Fajr, then repeat (the prayer).”
arabicText: وعنه عن ابن أبي عمير عن حماد عن الحلبي عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام وابن أبي عمير عن حفص بن البختري وغير واحد عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام قال إذا شككت في المغرب فاعد وإذا شككت في الفجر فاعد
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, and from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hafs bin al-Bakhtari and more than one person:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “If you are doubtful in Maghrib, then repeat (the prayer), and if you are doubtful in Fajr, then repeat (the prayer).”

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Sa‘d bin Abdillah, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from al-Husayn, from Fadalah, from Sayf bin Umayrah, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami:
He (Abu Bakr al-Hadrami) said: “I led my companions in the Maghrib prayer, and when I had prayed two rak‘ahs, I performed the taslim. Some of them said, ‘You only prayed two rak‘ahs.’ So I repeated the prayer. Then I informed Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him. Imam (a.s) said: "Perhaps you repeated it?" I said: "Yes." Imam (a.s) laughed and then said: "It would have sufficed you to stand and perform one rak‘ah. The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, once forgot and performed the taslim after two rak‘ahs.” And then He (a.s) mentioned the narration of Dhu al-Shimalayn, and said: “Then he stood and added two rak‘ahs to it."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ قَالَ: صَلَّيْتُ بِأَصْحَابِيَ اَلْمَغْرِبَ فَلَمَّا أَنْ صَلَّيْتُ رَكْعَتَيْنِ سَلَّمْتُ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِنَّمَا صَلَّيْتَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَأَعَدْتُ فَأَخْبَرْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ« لَعَلَّكَ أَعَدْتَ» فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ فَضَحِكَ ثُمَّ قَالَ« إِنَّمَا كَانَ يُجْزِيكَ أَنْ تَقُومَ وَ تَرْكَعَ رَكْعَةً إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ سَهَا فَسَلَّمَ فِي رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ حَدِيثَ ذِي اَلشِّمَالَيْنِ فَقَالَ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَأَضَافَ إِلَيْهَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Sa‘d bin Abdillah, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from al-Husayn, from Fadalah, from Sayf bin Umayrah, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami:
thaqalaynMatn: He (Abu Bakr al-Hadrami) said: “I led my companions in the Maghrib prayer, and when I had prayed two rak‘ahs, I performed the taslim. Some of them said, ‘You only prayed two rak‘ahs.’ So I repeated the prayer. Then I informed Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him. Imam (a.s) said: "Perhaps you repeated it?" I said: "Yes." Imam (a.s) laughed and then said: "It would have sufficed you to stand and perform one rak‘ah. The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, once forgot and performed the taslim after two rak‘ahs.” And then He (a.s) mentioned the narration of Dhu al-Shimalayn, and said: “Then he stood and added two rak‘ahs to it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 190

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And Sa‘d narrated from Muhammad bin al-Husayn, from Ja‘far bin Bashir, from al-Harith bin al-Mughirah al-Nasri, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “We prayed Maghrib, and the imam (of prayer) was forgetful and performed the taslim after two rak‘ahs, so we repeated the prayer.” Imam (a.s) said: "And why did you repeat it? Did not the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) once leave the prayer after two rak‘ahs and then complete it with two more (rak’ahs)? Should you not have completed it?"
arabicText: وَ رَوَى سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنِ اَلْحَارِثِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ اَلنَّصْرِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّا صَلَّيْنَا اَلْمَغْرِبَ فَسَهَا اَلْإِمَامُ فَسَلَّمَ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ فَأَعَدْنَا اَلصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَ« وَ لِمَ أَعَدْتُمْ أَ لَيْسَ قَدِ اِنْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَأَتَمَّ بِرَكْعَتَيْنِ أَلاَّ أَتْمَمْتُمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: And Sa‘d narrated from Muhammad bin al-Husayn, from Ja‘far bin Bashir, from al-Harith bin al-Mughirah al-Nasri, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “We prayed Maghrib, and the imam (of prayer) was forgetful and performed the taslim after two rak‘ahs, so we repeated the prayer.” Imam (a.s) said: "And why did you repeat it? Did not the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) once leave the prayer after two rak‘ahs and then complete it with two more (rak’ahs)? Should you not have completed it?"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 192

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa‘d, from Ayyub bin Nuh, from Ali bin al-Nu‘man al-Razi, who said:
I (al-Razi) was with some companions of mine on a journey, and I was their Imam (of prayer). I led them in the Maghrib prayer and performed the taslim after the first two rak‘ahs. My companions said: "You only prayed two rak‘ahs with us." We spoke to each other, and they said: "As for us, we will repeat (the prayer)." So I said: "As for me, I will not repeat it; I will complete it with one rak‘ah." So I completed it with one rak‘ah. Then we continued our journey, and I came to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him and mentioned to Him (a.s) what had happened with us. Imam (a.s) said to me: "You acted more correctly than they did. Only the one who does not know what he has prayed must repeat (the prayer)."
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ اَلرَّازِيِّ قَالَ: كُنْتُ مَعَ أَصْحَابٍ لِي فِي سَفَرٍ وَ أَنَا إِمَامُهُمْ فَصَلَّيْتُ بِهِمُ اَلْمَغْرِبَ فَسَلَّمْتُ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ فَقَالَ أَصْحَابِي إِنَّمَا صَلَّيْتَ بِنَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَكَلَّمْتُهُمْ وَ كَلَّمُونِي فَقَالُوا أَمَّا نَحْنُ فَنُعِيدُ فَقُلْتُ لَكِنِّي لاَ أُعِيدُ وَ أُتِمُّ بِرَكْعَةٍ فَأَتْمَمْتُ بِرَكْعَةٍ ثُمَّ سِرْنَا فَأَتَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَذَكَرْتُ لَهُ اَلَّذِي كَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا فَقَالَ لِي« أَنْتَ كُنْتَ أَصْوَبَ مِنْهُمْ فِعْلاً إِنَّمَا يُعِيدُ مَنْ لاَ يَدْرِي مَا صَلَّى»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa‘d, from Ayyub bin Nuh, from Ali bin al-Nu‘man al-Razi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (al-Razi) was with some companions of mine on a journey, and I was their Imam (of prayer). I led them in the Maghrib prayer and performed the taslim after the first two rak‘ahs. My companions said: "You only prayed two rak‘ahs with us." We spoke to each other, and they said: "As for us, we will repeat (the prayer)." So I said: "As for me, I will not repeat it; I will complete it with one rak‘ah." So I completed it with one rak‘ah. Then we continued our journey, and I came to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him and mentioned to Him (a.s) what had happened with us. Imam (a.s) said to me: "You acted more correctly than they did. Only the one who does not know what he has prayed must repeat (the prayer)."

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad and al-Hakam bin Miskin, from ‘Ammar al-Sabati, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man doubts in the Maghrib prayer and does not know whether he has prayed two rak‘ahs or three.” Imam (a.s) said: "He performs the taslim, then stands and adds to it one rak‘ah." Then Imam (a.s) said: "By Allah (swt), this is something that is never made up (qadha)."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ وَ اَلْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ شَكَّ فِي اَلْمَغْرِبِ فَلَمْ يَدْرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ صَلَّى أَمْ ثَلاَثَةً قَالَ« يُسَلِّمُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُضِيفُ إِلَيْهَا رَكْعَةً» ثُمَّ قَالَ« هَذَا وَ اَللَّهِ مِمَّا لاَ يُقْضَى أَبَداً»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn bin Sa‘id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad and al-Hakam bin Miskin, from ‘Ammar al-Sabati, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man doubts in the Maghrib prayer and does not know whether he has prayed two rak‘ahs or three.” Imam (a.s) said: "He performs the taslim, then stands and adds to it one rak‘ah." Then Imam (a.s) said: "By Allah (swt), this is something that is never made up (qadha)."

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And what was narrated by Ahmad bin Muhammad bin ‘Isa, from Mu‘awiyah bin Hakim, from Muhammad bin Abi Umayr, from Hammad al-Nabb, from ‘Ammar al-Sabati, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who does not know whether he prayed two rak‘ahs or one in the Fajr prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "He should recite the tashahhud and conclude (the prayer), then stand and pray one rak‘ah. If he had prayed two rak‘ahs, then this (extra) rak‘ah is a recommended prayer (nafilah), and if he had prayed only one rak‘ah, then this is the completion of the prayer." I asked: "And what if he prayed Maghrib and does not know whether he prayed two rak‘ahs or three?" Imam (a.s) said: "He should recite the tashahhud and conclude (the prayer), then stand and pray one rak‘ah. If he had prayed three, then this (extra) rak‘ah is a recommended prayer (nafilah), and if he had prayed two, then this is the completion of the prayer. And by Allah (swt), this is something that is never made up (qadah’)."
arabicText: وَ مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ اَلنَّابِ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ لَمْ يَدْرِ صَلَّى اَلْفَجْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ أَوْ رَكْعَةً قَالَ« يَتَشَهَّدُ وَ يَنْصَرِفُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَةً فَإِنْ كَانَ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ كَانَتْ هَذِهِ تَطَوُّعاً وَ إِنْ كَانَ صَلَّى رَكْعَةً كَانَتْ هَذِهِ تَمَامَ اَلصَّلاَةِ قُلْتُ فَصَلَّى اَلْمَغْرِبَ فَلَمْ يَدْرِ اِثْنَتَيْنِ صَلَّى أَمْ ثَلاَثَةً» قَالَ« يَتَشَهَّدُ وَ يَنْصَرِفُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَةً فَإِنْ كَانَ صَلَّى ثَلاَثاً كَانَتْ هَذِهِ تَطَوُّعاً وَإِنْ كَانَ صَلَّى اِثْنَتَيْنِ كَانَتْ هَذِهِ تَمَامَ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَهَذَا وَاَللَّهِ مِمَّا لاَ يُقْضَى أَبَداً»
thaqalaynSanad: And what was narrated by Ahmad bin Muhammad bin ‘Isa, from Mu‘awiyah bin Hakim, from Muhammad bin Abi Umayr, from Hammad al-Nabb, from ‘Ammar al-Sabati, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who does not know whether he prayed two rak‘ahs or one in the Fajr prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "He should recite the tashahhud and conclude (the prayer), then stand and pray one rak‘ah. If he had prayed two rak‘ahs, then this (extra) rak‘ah is a recommended prayer (nafilah), and if he had prayed only one rak‘ah, then this is the completion of the prayer." I asked: "And what if he prayed Maghrib and does not know whether he prayed two rak‘ahs or three?" Imam (a.s) said: "He should recite the tashahhud and conclude (the prayer), then stand and pray one rak‘ah. If he had prayed three, then this (extra) rak‘ah is a recommended prayer (nafilah), and if he had prayed two, then this is the completion of the prayer. And by Allah (swt), this is something that is never made up (qadah’)."

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: And from him, from al-Hajjal, from Abdillah (a.s), from ‘Ubayd: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said regarding a man who prayed one rak‘ah of Fajr, then went away and came back after morning had begun and remembered that he had prayed only one rak‘ah. Imam (a.s) said: "He should add one rak‘ah to it."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَجَّالِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ: فِي رَجُلٍ صَلَّى اَلْفَجْرَ رَكْعَةً ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ وَ جَاءَ بَعْدَ مَا أَصْبَحَ وَ ذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ صَلَّى رَكْعَةً قَالَ« يُضِيفُ إِلَيْهَا رَكْعَةً»
thaqalaynMatn: And from him, from al-Hajjal, from Abdillah (a.s), from ‘Ubayd: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said regarding a man who prayed one rak‘ah of Fajr, then went away and came back after morning had begun and remembered that he had prayed only one rak‘ah. Imam (a.s) said: "He should add one rak‘ah to it."

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya al-Mu‘adhi, from al-Tayalisi, from Sayf bin Umayrah, from Ishaq bin ‘Ammar, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If your assumption always leans toward completion (the higher number) in every prayer, then perform two prostrations (sajdatayn) without a ruku‘. Do you understand?" I said: "Yes."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى اَلْمُعَاذِيُّ عَنِ اَلطَّيَالِسِيِّ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِذَا ذَهَبَ وَهْمُكَ إِلَى اَلتَّمَامِ أَبَداً فِي كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ فَاسْجُدْ سَجْدَتَيْنِ بِغَيْرِ رُكُوعٍ أَفَهِمْتَ» قُلْتُ نَعَمْ
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya al-Mu‘adhi, from al-Tayalisi, from Sayf bin Umayrah, from Ishaq bin ‘Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If your assumption always leans toward completion (the higher number) in every prayer, then perform two prostrations (sajdatayn) without a ruku‘. Do you understand?" I said: "Yes."

chapter: Chapter on Rulings on Forgetfulness (Sahw) in Prayer and What Requires Repeating of Prayer
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya, from Ya‘qub bin Yazid, from Ali bin al-Nu‘man, from al-Husayn bin Abi al-‘Ala’, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I (narrator) said: "I came to the imam (of prayer) while he had preceded me by one rak‘ah in the Fajr prayer. When he completed the prayer with the taslim, it occurred in my heart that I had completed (my prayer), so I remained engaged in the remembrance of Allah (swt) until the sun rose. When the sun rose, I stood up and remembered that the Imam had preceded me by one rak‘ah." Imam (a.s) said: "If you were still in your place, then complete it with one rak‘ah; but if you had already left, then you must repeat the prayer."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ أَجِيءُ إِلَى اَلْإِمَامِ وَ قَدْ سَبَقَنِي بِرَكْعَةٍ فِي اَلْفَجْرِ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ وَقَعَ فِي قَلْبِي أَنِّي قَدْ أَتْمَمْتُ فَلَمْ أَزَلْ ذَاكِراً لِلَّهِ حَتَّى طَلَعَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ فَلَمَّا طَلَعَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ نَهَضْتُ فَذَكَرْتُ أَنَّ اَلْإِمَامَ كَانَ قَدْ سَبَقَنِي بِرَكْعَةٍ قَالَ «فَإِنْ كُنْتَ فِي مَقَامِكَ فَأَتِمَّ بِرَكْعَةٍ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ قَدِ اِنْصَرَفْتَ فَعَلَيْكَ اَلْإِ عَادَةُ» يعني به إذا كان قد أستدبر القبلة
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad bin Ahmad bin Yahya, from Ya‘qub bin Yazid, from Ali bin al-Nu‘man, from al-Husayn bin Abi al-‘Ala’, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I (narrator) said: "I came to the imam (of prayer) while he had preceded me by one rak‘ah in the Fajr prayer. When he completed the prayer with the taslim, it occurred in my heart that I had completed (my prayer), so I remained engaged in the remembrance of Allah (swt) until the sun rose. When the sun rose, I stood up and remembered that the Imam had preceded me by one rak‘ah." Imam (a.s) said: "If you were still in your place, then complete it with one rak‘ah; but if you had already left, then you must repeat the prayer."
