chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, by Ali ibn Ibrahim, by his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "It is not proper for a Muslim woman to wear of head coverings (khumur) and long shirts (duru‘) that do not conceal anything."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ يَصْلُحُ لِلْمَرْأَةِ اَلْمُسْلِمَةِ أَنْ تَلْبَسَ مِنَ اَلْخُمُرِ وَ اَلدُّرُوعِ مَا لاَ يُوَارِي شَيْئاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, by Ali ibn Ibrahim, by his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "It is not proper for a Muslim woman to wear of head coverings (khumur) and long shirts (duru‘) that do not conceal anything."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 233

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa‘id ibn ‘Uqda, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, who said: My father narrated to me, from Abdullah ibn Jamil ibn ‘Ayyash Abu Ali al-Bazzaz, who said: My father informed me, saying:
I asked (Imam) Ja‘far ibn Muhammad (a.s), peace be upon him, about a garment made by the People of the Book, may I pray in it before it is washed? Imam (a.s) said: "There is no problem, though it is more beloved to me that it be washed."
arabicText: وَ رَوَى أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ اِبْنُ عُقْدَةَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جَمِيلِ بْنِ عَيَّاشٍ أَبِي عَلِيٍّ اَلْبَزَّازِ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ جَعْفَرَ بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلثَّوْبِ يَعْمَلُهُ أَهْلُ اَلْكِتَابِ أُصَلِّي فِيهِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُغْسَلَ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ وَ أَنْ يُغْسَلَ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa‘id ibn ‘Uqda, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, who said: My father narrated to me, from Abdullah ibn Jamil ibn ‘Ayyash Abu Ali al-Bazzaz, who said: My father informed me, saying:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked (Imam) Ja‘far ibn Muhammad (a.s), peace be upon him, about a garment made by the People of the Book, may I pray in it before it is washed? Imam (a.s) said: "There is no problem, though it is more beloved to me that it be washed."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 233

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Ibn al-Barqi, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Fadl, from someone who narrated to him:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There are ten places in which prayer is not to be performed: mud, water, bathhouses, graves, the resting places along roads, ant colonies, camel resting spots, water channels, salty barren land (al-sabkha), and snow."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْفَضْلِ عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« عَشَرَةُ مَوَاضِعَ لاَ يُصَلَّى فِيهَا اَلطِّينُ وَ اَلْمَاءُ وَ اَلْحَمَّامُ وَ اَلْقُبُورُ وَ مَسَانُّ اَلطُّرُقِ وَ قُرَى اَلنَّمْلِ وَ مَعَاطِنُ اَلْإِبِلِ وَ مَجْرَى اَلْمَاءِ وَ اَلسَّبَخُ وَ اَلثَّلْجُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Ibn al-Barqi, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Fadl, from someone who narrated to him:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There are ten places in which prayer is not to be performed: mud, water, bathhouses, graves, the resting places along roads, ant colonies, camel resting spots, water channels, salty barren land (al-sabkha), and snow."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 233

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "Do not pray in a house in which there is wine or an intoxicant."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ تُصَلِّ فِي بَيْتٍ فِيهِ خَمْرٌ أَوْ مُسْكِرٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar al-Sabati:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "Do not pray in a house in which there is wine or an intoxicant."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 234

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about prayer in sheep enclosures. Imam (a.s) said: "Pray in them. But do not pray in camel enclosures unless you fear for the loss of your belongings, then sweep it and sprinkle it with water, and pray." And I asked him about prayer on the side of the road. He said: "There is no problem with praying on the edges between the main pathways. But as for on the main roads themselves, do not pray on them."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي مَرَابِضِ اَلْغَنَمِ فَقَالَ« صَلِّ فِيهَا وَلاَ تُصَلِّ فِي أَعْطَانِ اَلْإِبِلِ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَخَافَ عَلَى مَتَاعِكَ اَلضَّيْعَةَ فَاكْنُسْهُ وَ رُشَّهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَ صَلِّ» وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي ظَهْرِ اَلطَّرِيقِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ فِي اَلظَّوَاهِرِ اَلَّتِي بَيْنَ اَلْجَوَادِّ فَأَمَّا عَلَى اَلْجَوَادِّ فَلاَ تُصَلِّ فِيهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about prayer in sheep enclosures. Imam (a.s) said: "Pray in them. But do not pray in camel enclosures unless you fear for the loss of your belongings, then sweep it and sprinkle it with water, and pray." And I asked him about prayer on the side of the road. He said: "There is no problem with praying on the edges between the main pathways. But as for on the main roads themselves, do not pray on them."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 234

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, who said:
(Imam (a.s)) Al-Ridha (a.s) said: "Every pathway that is walked upon or passed through, whether it has a main road (jadah) or not, it is not appropriate to pray in it." I asked: "Then where should I pray?" Imam (a.s) said: "To the right or to the left (off the path)."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ قَالَ قَالَ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« كُلُّ طَرِيقٍ يُوطَأُ أَوْ يُتَطَرَّقُ وَ كَانَتْ فِيهِ جَادَّةٌ أَوْ لَمْ تَكُنْ فَلاَ يَنْبَغِي اَلصَّلاَةُ فِيهِ» قُلْتُ فَأَيْنَ أُصَلِّي فَقَالَ« يَمْنَةً وَ يَسْرَةً»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s)) Al-Ridha (a.s) said: "Every pathway that is walked upon or passed through, whether it has a main road (jadah) or not, it is not appropriate to pray in it." I asked: "Then where should I pray?" Imam (a.s) said: "To the right or to the left (off the path)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 234

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from al-Hasan, from Zur‘ah, from Sama‘ah, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about praying in camel enclosures, and in the pens of cows and sheep. Imam (a.s) said: "If you sprinkle them with water and they are dry, then there is no problem in praying there. But as for the stables of horses and mules, no."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي أَعْطَانِ اَلْإِبِلِ وَ فِي مَرَابِضِ اَلْبَقَرِ وَ اَلْغَنَمِ فَقَالَ« إِنْ نَضَحْتَهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَ قَدْ كَانَ يَابِساً فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا فَأَمَّا مَرَابِطُ اَلْخَيْلِ وَ اَلْبِغَالِ فَلاَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from al-Hasan, from Zur‘ah, from Sama‘ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about praying in camel enclosures, and in the pens of cows and sheep. Imam (a.s) said: "If you sprinkle them with water and they are dry, then there is no problem in praying there. But as for the stables of horses and mules, no."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 235

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about prayer in camel enclosures. Imam (a.s) said: "If you fear the loss of your belongings, then sweep it, sprinkle it with water, and pray. And there is no problem with praying in sheep enclosures."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي أَعْطَانِ اَلْإِبِلِ فَقَالَ« إِنْ تَخَوَّفْتَ اَلضَّيْعَةَ عَلَى مَتَاعِكَ فَاكْنُسْهُ وَ اِنْضِحْهُ وَ صَلِّ وَ لاَ بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاَةِ فِي مَرَابِضِ اَلْغَنَمِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about prayer in camel enclosures. Imam (a.s) said: "If you fear the loss of your belongings, then sweep it, sprinkle it with water, and pray. And there is no problem with praying in sheep enclosures."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 235

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about prayer during travel. Imam (a.s) said: "Do not pray on the main road (jadah); rather, move to its sides."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فَقَالَ« لاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى اَلْجَادَّةِ وَ اِعْتَزِلْ عَلَى جَانِبَيْهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about prayer during travel. Imam (a.s) said: "Do not pray on the main road (jadah); rather, move to its sides."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 235

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm:
Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Every path that is walked upon, do not pray on it." I asked: "It has been narrated from your grandfather that 'there is no problem with praying on the edges (zawahir) of the roads.'" Imam (a.s) said: "That might be when a man accompanied me on it." I asked: "And if a man fears the loss of his belongings?" Imam (a.s) said: "If he fears loss, then let him pray."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ اَلْجَهْمِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَ قَالَ: «كُلُّ طَرِيقٍ يُوطَأُ فَلاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ إِنَّهُ قَدْ رُوِيَ عَنْ جَدِّكَ« أَنَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ عَلَى اَلظَّوَاهِرِ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهَا» قَالَ «ذَاكَ رُبَّمَا سَايَرَنِي عَلَيْهِ اَلرَّجُلُ» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ خَافَ اَلرَّجُلُ عَلَى مَتَاعِهِ اَلضَّيْعَةَ قَالَ« فَإِنْ خَافَ اَلضَّيْعَةَ فَلْيُصَلِّ
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Every path that is walked upon, do not pray on it." I asked: "It has been narrated from your grandfather that 'there is no problem with praying on the edges (zawahir) of the roads.'" Imam (a.s) said: "That might be when a man accompanied me on it." I asked: "And if a man fears the loss of his belongings?" Imam (a.s) said: "If he fears loss, then let him pray."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 235

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from someone who asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
(Imam (a.s) was asked) about a mosque whose wall in the direction of the qiblah is leaking from a drainage hole (balu‘ah) into which people urinate. He said: "If the leakage is from the drainage hole (balu‘ah), then do not pray in it. But if it is from something else, then there is no problem."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ: عَمَّنْ سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَسْجِدِ يَنِزُّ حَائِطُ قِبْلَتِهِ مِنْ بَالُوعَةٍ يُبَالُ فِيهَا فَقَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ نَزُّهُ مِنَ اَلْبَالُوعَةِ فَلاَ تُصَلِّ فِيهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from someone who asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) was asked) about a mosque whose wall in the direction of the qiblah is leaking from a drainage hole (balu‘ah) into which people urinate. He said: "If the leakage is from the drainage hole (balu‘ah), then do not pray in it. But if it is from something else, then there is no problem."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 236

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from al-Hasan, from Zur‘ah, from Sama‘ah, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about prayer on salty barren land (al-sibakh). Imam (a.s) said: "There is no problem."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي اَلسِّبَاخِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from al-Hasan, from Zur‘ah, from Sama‘ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about prayer on salty barren land (al-sibakh). Imam (a.s) said: "There is no problem."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 236

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Shu‘ayb ibn Ya‘qub, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about prayer on salty barren land (al-sabkha), why is it disliked? Imam (a.s) said: "Because the forehead does not rest evenly." So I said: "And if there is flat ground within it?" Imam (a.s) said: "Then there is no problem."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي اَلسَّبَخَةِ لِمَ تَكْرَهُهُ قَالَ« لِأَنَّ اَلْجَبْهَةَ لاَ تَقَعُ مُسْتَوِيَةً» فَقُلْتُ إِنْ كَانَ فِيهَا أَرْضٌ مُسْتَوِيَةٌ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Shu‘ayb ibn Ya‘qub, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about prayer on salty barren land (al-sabkha), why is it disliked? Imam (a.s) said: "Because the forehead does not rest evenly." So I said: "And if there is flat ground within it?" Imam (a.s) said: "Then there is no problem."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 236

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-‘Ayyas ibn al-Qasim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about churches (biya’) and synagogues (kanaʾis), can one pray in them? Imam (a.s) said: "Yes." And I asked Him (a.s): "Is it permissible to tear them down and build a mosque in their place?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعِيصِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْبِيَعِ وَ اَلْكَنَائِسِ يُصَلَّى فِيهِمَا فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ» وَ سَأَلْتُهُ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ نَقْضُهَا مَسْجِداً فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-‘Ayyas ibn al-Qasim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about churches (biya’) and synagogues (kanaʾis), can one pray in them? Imam (a.s) said: "Yes." And I asked Him (a.s): "Is it permissible to tear them down and build a mosque in their place?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 236

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from al-Nadr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about praying in churches (biya’), synagogues (kanaʾis), and Zoroastrian fire temples (buyut al-majus). Imam (a.s) said: "Sprinkle (them with water), and then pray."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي اَلْبِيَعِ وَ اَلْكَنَائِسِ وَ بُيُوتِ اَلْمَجُوسِ فَقَالَ« رُشَّ وَ صَلِّ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from al-Nadr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about praying in churches (biya’), synagogues (kanaʾis), and Zoroastrian fire temples (buyut al-majus). Imam (a.s) said: "Sprinkle (them with water), and then pray."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 237

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Fadalah, from Hammad al-Nab, from al-Hakam ibn al-Hakam, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s) being asked about prayer in churches (biya’) and synagogues (kanaʾis). Imam (a.s) said: "Pray in them, I have seen how clean they are!" I asked: "Is it permissible to pray in them even though they (non-Muslims) pray in them?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes. Do you not read the Qur’an: 'Say, each works according to his own way, but your Lord (azj) is most knowing of who is best guided in path'? (Surah Isra 17:84) Pray facing the Qiblah, and let them go their way."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ اَلنَّابِ عَنِ اَلْحَكَمِ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: وَ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي اَلْبِيَعِ وَ اَلْكَنَائِسِ فَقَالَ« صَلِّ فِيهَا قَدْ رَأَيْتُهَا مَا أَنْظَفَهَا» قُلْتُ أَ يُصَلَّى فِيهَا وَ إِنْ كَانُوا يُصَلُّونَ فِيهَا فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ أَ مَا تَقْرَأُ اَلْقُرْآنَ« قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلىٰ شٰاكِلَتِهِ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدىٰ سَبِيلاً» صَلِّ عَلَى اَلْقِبْلَةِ وَ غَرِّبْهُمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Fadalah, from Hammad al-Nab, from al-Hakam ibn al-Hakam, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s) being asked about prayer in churches (biya’) and synagogues (kanaʾis). Imam (a.s) said: "Pray in them, I have seen how clean they are!" I asked: "Is it permissible to pray in them even though they (non-Muslims) pray in them?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes. Do you not read the Qur’an: 'Say, each works according to his own way, but your Lord (azj) is most knowing of who is best guided in path'? (Surah Isra 17:84) Pray facing the Qiblah, and let them go their way."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 237

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Shu‘ayb ibn Ya‘qub, from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about prayer in the houses of the Magians (Zoroastrians). Imam (a.s) said: "Sprinkle (them with water), and then pray."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي بُيُوتِ اَلْمَجُوسِ قَالَ« رُشَّ وَ صَلِّ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Shu‘ayb ibn Ya‘qub, from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about prayer in the houses of the Magians (Zoroastrians). Imam (a.s) said: "Sprinkle (them with water), and then pray."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 237

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about madhi (pre-ejaculatory fluid) that gets on a garment. Imam (a.s) said: "Sprinkle it with water if you wish." And regarding mani (semen) that gets on a garment. Imam (a.s) said: "If you know its location, then wash it. And if it is not clear to you, then wash the entire garment."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَذْيِ يُصِيبُ اَلثَّوْبَ فَقَالَ« يَنْضَحُهُ بِالْمَاءِ إِنْ شَاءَ» وَ قَالَ فِي اَلْمَنِيِّ يُصِيبُ اَلثَّوْبَ قَالَ« إِنْ عَرَفْتَ مَكَانَهُ فَاغْسِلْهُ وَ إِنْ خَفِيَ عَلَيْكَ فَاغْسِلْهُ كُلَّهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about madhi (pre-ejaculatory fluid) that gets on a garment. Imam (a.s) said: "Sprinkle it with water if you wish." And regarding mani (semen) that gets on a garment. Imam (a.s) said: "If you know its location, then wash it. And if it is not clear to you, then wash the entire garment."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 237

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from ‘Uthman, from Sama‘ah, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about semen (mani) getting on a garment. Imam (a.s) said: "Wash the entire garment if the location is unknown to you, whether it is a small amount or a large amount."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَنِيِّ يُصِيبُ اَلثَّوْبَ قَالَ« اِغْسِلِ اَلثَّوْبَ كُلَّهُ إِذَا خَفِيَ عَلَيْكَ مَكَانُهُ قَلِيلاً كَانَ أَوْ كَثِيراً»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from ‘Uthman, from Sama‘ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about semen (mani) getting on a garment. Imam (a.s) said: "Wash the entire garment if the location is unknown to you, whether it is a small amount or a large amount."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 238

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Imam (a.s) mentioned semen (mani) and emphasized its impurity, considering it more severe than urine. Then Imam (a.s) said: "If you see semen before or after entering the prayer, you must repeat the prayer. But if you looked at your garment and did not see it, and then prayed in it, and later saw it, then there is no need for you to repeat the prayer. And the same applies to urine."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: ذَكَرَ اَلْمَنِيَّ فَشَدَّدَهُ وَ جَعَلَهُ أَشَدَّ مِنَ اَلْبَوْلِ ثُمَّ قَالَ« إِنْ رَأَيْتَ اَلْمَنِيَّ قَبْلَ أَوْ بَعْدَ مَا تَدْخُلُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَعَلَيْكَ إِعَادَةُ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ إِنْ أَنْتَ نَظَرْتَ فِي ثَوْبِكَ فَلَمْ تُصِبْهُ ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتَ فِيهِ ثُمَّ رَأَيْتَهُ بَعْدُ فَلاَ إِعَادَةَ عَلَيْكَ وَ كَذَلِكَ اَلْبَوْلُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) mentioned semen (mani) and emphasized its impurity, considering it more severe than urine. Then Imam (a.s) said: "If you see semen before or after entering the prayer, you must repeat the prayer. But if you looked at your garment and did not see it, and then prayed in it, and later saw it, then there is no need for you to repeat the prayer. And the same applies to urine."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 238

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
What was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from a group (of our companions), from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from his brother al-Hasan, from Zur‘ah, from Sama‘ah, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about a man who is in a deserted land and has only one garment, and he becomes in a state of major ritual impurity (junub) in it, and he does not have water, what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: "He performs tayammum and prays naked, seated, and gestures (for bowing and prostration)."
arabicText: مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ جَمَاعَةٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَكُونُ فِي فَلاَةٍ مِنَ اَلْأَرْضِ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ ثَوْبٌ وَاحِدٌ وَ أَجْنَبَ فِيهِ وَ لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُ مَاءٌ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ« يَتَيَمَّمُ وَ يُصَلِّي عُرْيَاناً قَاعِداً وَ يُومِئُ»
thaqalaynSanad: What was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from a group (of our companions), from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from his brother al-Hasan, from Zur‘ah, from Sama‘ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about a man who is in a deserted land and has only one garment, and he becomes in a state of major ritual impurity (junub) in it, and he does not have water, what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: "He performs tayammum and prays naked, seated, and gestures (for bowing and prostration)."

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Sayf ibn Umayrah, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said Muhammad ibn Ali al-Halabi narrated to me:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who becomes junub (in a state of major ritual impurity) while in the open desert and has only one garment, and semen (mani) has gotten on that garment. Imam (a.s) said: "He should perform tayammum, remove his garment, sit with his body gathered (to cover his private parts), and pray, gesturing with motions (imaʾ)."
arabicText: وَرَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ اَلْحَلَبِيُّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي رَجُلٍ أَصَابَتْهُ جَنَابَةٌ وَ هُوَ بِالْفَلاَةِ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ ثَوْبٌ وَاحِدٌ وَ أَصَابَ ثَوْبَهُ مَنِيٌّ قَالَ« يَتَيَمَّمُ وَ يَطْرَحُ ثَوْبَهُ وَ يَجْلِسُ مُجْتَمِعاً وَ يُصَلِّي وَ يُومِئُ إِيمَاءً»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Sayf ibn Umayrah, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said Muhammad ibn Ali al-Halabi narrated to me:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who becomes junub (in a state of major ritual impurity) while in the open desert and has only one garment, and semen (mani) has gotten on that garment. Imam (a.s) said: "He should perform tayammum, remove his garment, sit with his body gathered (to cover his private parts), and pray, gesturing with motions (imaʾ)."

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aban ibn ‘Uthman, from Muhammad al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who becomes junub in his garment or it is soiled with urine, and he has no other garment besides it. Imam (a.s) said: "He should pray in it if he is forced to do so."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُجْنِبُ فِي اَلثَّوْبِ أَوْ يُصِيبُهُ بَوْلٌ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ ثَوْبٌ غَيْرُهُ قَالَ« يُصَلِّي فِيهِ إِذَا اُضْطُرَّ إِلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Aban ibn ‘Uthman, from Muhammad al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who becomes junub in his garment or it is soiled with urine, and he has no other garment besides it. Imam (a.s) said: "He should pray in it if he is forced to do so."

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ja‘far narrated from his brother (Imam al Kadhim (a.s)), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about a man who is naked and the time for prayer arrives, and he finds a garment, but half of it or all of it is stained with blood, should he pray in it, or should he pray naked? Imam (a.s) said: "If he finds water, he should wash it. If he does not find water, then he should pray in it and not pray while naked."
arabicText: وَ رَوَى عَلِيُّ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عُرْيَانٍ وَ حَضَرَتِ اَلصَّلاَةُ فَأَصَابَ ثَوْباً نِصْفُهُ دَمٌ أَوْ كُلُّهُ أَ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ أَوْ يُصَلِّي عُرْيَاناً فَقَالَ« إِنْ وَجَدَ مَاءً غَسَلَهُ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ مَاءً صَلَّى فِيهِ وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عُرْيَاناً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ja‘far narrated from his brother (Imam al Kadhim (a.s)), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about a man who is naked and the time for prayer arrives, and he finds a garment, but half of it or all of it is stained with blood, should he pray in it, or should he pray naked? Imam (a.s) said: "If he finds water, he should wash it. If he does not find water, then he should pray in it and not pray while naked."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 239

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa‘d ibn Abdullah, from Abu Ja‘far, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban, from Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about a man who becomes junub in a garment and has no other garment, nor is he able to wash it. Imam (a.s) said: "He should pray in it."
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُجْنِبُ فِي ثَوْبٍ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ غَيْرُهُ وَ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى غَسْلِهِ قَالَ« يُصَلِّي فِيهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa‘d ibn Abdullah, from Abu Ja‘far, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban, from Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about a man who becomes junub in a garment and has no other garment, nor is he able to wash it. Imam (a.s) said: "He should pray in it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 239

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) was asked about a man who has only one garment, and it is not permissible to pray in it, and he does not find water to wash it, what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: "He performs tayammum and prays. Then when he obtains water, he washes the garment and repeats the prayer."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ إِلاَّ ثَوْبٌ وَ لاَ تَحِلُّ اَلصَّلاَةُ فِيهِ وَ لَيْسَ يَجِدُ مَاءً يَغْسِلُهُ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ« يَتَيَمَّمُ وَ يُصَلِّي فَإِذَا أَصَابَ مَاءً غَسَلَهُ وَ أَعَادَ اَلصَّلاَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about a man who has only one garment, and it is not permissible to pray in it, and he does not find water to wash it, what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: "He performs tayammum and prays. Then when he obtains water, he washes the garment and repeats the prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 240

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa’d, from Ali ibn Isma’il, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I wrote to Him (a.s) asking about a man who had two garments, and one of them was contaminated with urine, but he did not know which one. The time for prayer arrived, and he feared missing it, and he had no water, what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: "He should pray in both of them together."
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ كَانَ مَعَهُ ثَوْبَانِ فَأَصَابَ أَحَدَهُمَا بَوْلٌ وَ لَمْ يَدْرِ أَيُّهُمَا هُوَ وَ حَضَرَتِ اَلصَّلاَةُ وَ خَافَ فَوْتَهَا وَ لَيْسَ عِنْدَهُ مَاءٌ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ« يُصَلِّي فِيهِمَا جَمِيعاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa’d, from Ali ibn Isma’il, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to Him (a.s) asking about a man who had two garments, and one of them was contaminated with urine, but he did not know which one. The time for prayer arrived, and he feared missing it, and he had no water, what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: "He should pray in both of them together."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 240

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from ‘Imran ibn Musa and Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who prays while there is an open Qur'an (mushaf) in front of him in the direction of the Qiblah. Imam (a.s) said: "No." I asked: "What if it is in a cover?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes." And Imam (a.s) said: "A man should not pray while there is fire or iron in his (direction of) Qiblah." I asked: "Can he pray while there is a brass incense burner (mijmarah shabah) in front of him?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, but if it contains fire, then he should not pray until he moves it away from his (direction of) Qiblah." And (Imam (a.s) said) about a man who prays while there is a hanging lamp (qindil) in front of him with fire in it, but it is level with him. Imam (a.s) said: "If it is raised high, it is worse, he should not pray directly in line with it."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ مُوسَى وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مُصْحَفٌ مَفْتُوحٌ فِي قِبْلَتِهِ قَالَ« لاَ» قُلْتُ فَإِنْ كَانَ فِي غِلاَفٍ قَالَ« نَعَمْ» وَ قَالَ« لاَ يُصَلِّي اَلرَّجُلُ وَ فِي قِبْلَتِهِ نَارٌ أَوْ حَدِيدٌ» قُلْتُ أَ لَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِجْمَرَةُ شَبَهٍ قَالَ« نَعَمْ فَإِنْ كَانَ فِيهَا نَارٌ فَلاَ يُصَلِّي حَتَّى يُنَحِّيَهَا عَنْ قِبْلَتِهِ» وَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ قِنْدِيلٌ مُعَلَّقٌ وَ فِيهِ نَارٌ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ بِحِيَالِهِ قَالَ« إِذَا اِرْتَفَعَ كَانَ شَرّاً لاَ يُصَلِّي بِحِيَالِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from ‘Imran ibn Musa and Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar al-Sabati:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who prays while there is an open Qur'an (mushaf) in front of him in the direction of the Qiblah. Imam (a.s) said: "No." I asked: "What if it is in a cover?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes." And Imam (a.s) said: "A man should not pray while there is fire or iron in his (direction of) Qiblah." I asked: "Can he pray while there is a brass incense burner (mijmarah shabah) in front of him?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, but if it contains fire, then he should not pray until he moves it away from his (direction of) Qiblah." And (Imam (a.s) said) about a man who prays while there is a hanging lamp (qindil) in front of him with fire in it, but it is level with him. Imam (a.s) said: "If it is raised high, it is worse, he should not pray directly in line with it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 240

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him, from Muhammad, from al-‘Amraki, from Ali ibn Ja‘far, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about a man praying while a lamp (siraj) is placed in front of him in the direction of the Qiblah. Imam (a.s) said: "It is not proper for him to face the fire."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي وَ اَلسِّرَاجُ مَوْضُوعٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فِي اَلْقِبْلَةِ فَقَالَ« لاَ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَسْتَقْبِلَ اَلنَّارَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him, from Muhammad, from al-‘Amraki, from Ali ibn Ja‘far, from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about a man praying while a lamp (siraj) is placed in front of him in the direction of the Qiblah. Imam (a.s) said: "It is not proper for him to face the fire."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 241

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
This was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-Hasan, from al-Husayn ibn ‘Amr, from his father ‘Amr ibn Ibrahim al-Hamdani.
He (al Hamdani) raised the narration, saying that Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm if a man prays while there is fire, a lamp, or an image in front of him, indeed, the One (azj) to whom he is praying is nearer to him than that which is in front of him."
arabicText: رَوَى ذَلِكَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَمْرِو بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ اَلْهَمْدَانِيِّ رَفَعَ اَلْحَدِيثَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ اَلرَّجُلُ وَ اَلنَّارُ وَ اَلسِّرَاجُ وَ اَلصُّورَةُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ إِنَّ اَلَّذِي يُصَلِّي لَهُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنَ اَلَّذِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: This was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-Hasan, from al-Husayn ibn ‘Amr, from his father ‘Amr ibn Ibrahim al-Hamdani.
thaqalaynMatn: He (al Hamdani) raised the narration, saying that Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm if a man prays while there is fire, a lamp, or an image in front of him, indeed, the One (azj) to whom he is praying is nearer to him than that which is in front of him."

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ibn Mahbub, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abu Ja‘far (a.s), peace be upon him: "Shall I pray while statues (tamathil) are in front of me and I am looking at them?" Imam (a.s) said: "No, throw a cloth over them. There is no problem if they are to your right, or your left, or behind you, or beneath your feet, or above your head. But if they are in the direction of the Qiblah, then cover them with a cloth and pray."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أُصَلِّي وَ اَلتَّمَاثِيلُ قُدَّامِي وَ أَنَا أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهَا قَالَ« لاَ اِطْرَحْ عَلَيْهَا ثَوْباً وَ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهَا إِذَا كَانَتْ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ أَوْ شِمَالِكَ أَوْ خَلْفِكَ أَوْ تَحْتَ رِجْلِكَ أَوْ فَوْقَ رَأْسِكَ وَ إِنْ كَانَتْ فِي اَلْقِبْلَةِ فَأَلْقِ عَلَيْهَا ثَوْباً وَ صَلِّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Ibn Mahbub, from al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Ja‘far (a.s), peace be upon him: "Shall I pray while statues (tamathil) are in front of me and I am looking at them?" Imam (a.s) said: "No, throw a cloth over them. There is no problem if they are to your right, or your left, or behind you, or beneath your feet, or above your head. But if they are in the direction of the Qiblah, then cover them with a cloth and pray."

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from Husayn, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Sometimes I would stand to pray and in front of me would be a cushion with images of birds on it, so I would place a cloth over it."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« رُبَّمَا قُمْتُ فَأُصَلِّي وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ اَلْوِسَادَةُ فِيهَا تَمَاثِيلُ طَيْرٍ فَجَعَلْتُ عَلَيْهَا ثَوْباً»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from Husayn, from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Sometimes I would stand to pray and in front of me would be a cushion with images of birds on it, so I would place a cloth over it."

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan and Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Jamil ibn Salih, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: "I stand for prayer and I see excrement (al-’adhirah) in front of me in the direction of the Qiblah." Imam (a.s) said: "Move away from it as much as you can, and do not pray on the main roads (al-jawadd)."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَقُومُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَأَرَى قُدَّامِي فِي اَلْقِبْلَةِ اَلْعَذِرَةَ فَقَالَ« تَنَحَّ عَنْهَا مَا اِسْتَطَعْتَ وَ لاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى اَلْجَوَادِّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan and Ali ibn Muhammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Jamil ibn Salih, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: "I stand for prayer and I see excrement (al-’adhirah) in front of me in the direction of the Qiblah." Imam (a.s) said: "Move away from it as much as you can, and do not pray on the main roads (al-jawadd)."

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from a man, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from his father, from Ali ibn Uqbah, from Musa ibn Ukayl al-Numayri:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "As for iron, it is the adornment of the people of Hell, and gold is the adornment of the people of Paradise. Allah (swt) has made gold in this world the adornment of women, so He (azj) prohibited it for men to wear and to pray while wearing it. And Allah (swt) has made iron in this world the adornment of the jinn and the devils, so He (azj) prohibited the Muslim man from wearing it during prayer, except if he is facing an enemy, in which case there is no harm in it." He (narrator) said: “I asked Him (a.s): ‘What about a man while traveling who has with him a knife in his boot, which he cannot do without, or it is tied in his trousers, or a key, fearing that if he sets it down, it will be lost, or he wears a belt with iron in it, what then?" Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in the knife and the belt for the traveler or in times of necessity. Likewise, there is no harm in the key if he fears loss or forgetting it. And there is no harm in the sword and every kind of weapon during war. But outside of that, it is not permissible to pray in anything made of iron, for it is impure (najis) and accursed (mamsukh)."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أُكَيْلٍ اَلنُّمَيْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« فِي اَلْحَدِيدِ أَنَّهُ حِلْيَةُ أَهْلِ اَلنَّارِ وَ اَلذَّهَبَ حِلْيَةُ أَهْلِ اَلْجَنَّةِ وَ جَعَلَ اَللَّهُ اَلذَّهَبَ فِي اَلدُّنْيَا زِينَةَ اَلنِّسَاءِ فَحَرَّمَ عَلَى اَلرِّجَالِ لُبْسَهُ وَ اَلصَّلاَةَ فِيهِ وَ جَعَلَ اَللَّهُ اَلْحَدِيدَ فِي اَلدُّنْيَا زِينَةَ اَلْجِنِّ وَ اَلشَّيَاطِينِ فَحَرَّمَ عَلَى اَلرَّجُلِ اَلْمُسْلِمِ أَنْ يَلْبَسَهُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ قِبَالَ عَدُوٍّ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ فَالرَّجُلُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ يَكُونُ مَعَهُ اَلسِّكِّينُ فِي خُفِّهِ لاَ يَسْتَغْنِي عَنْهُ أَوْ فِي سَرَاوِيلِهِ مَشْدُود اًوَ اَلْمِفْتَاحُ يَخْشَى إِنْ وَضَعَهُ ضَاعَ أَوْ يَكُونُ فِي وَسَطِهِ اَلْمِنْطَقَةُ مِنْ حَدِيدٍ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِالسِّكِّينِ وَ اَلْمِنْطَقَةِ لِلْمُسَافِرِ أَوْ فِي وَقْتِ ضَرُورَةٍ وَ كَذَلِكَ اَلْمِفْتَاحُ إِذَا خَافَ اَلضَّيْعَةَ وَ اَلنِّسْيَانَ وَ لاَ بَأْسَ بِالسَّيْفِ وَ كُلِّ آلَةِ اَلسِّلاَحِ فِي اَلْحَرْبِ وَ فِي غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ لاَ يَجُوزُ اَلصَّلاَةُ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ اَلْحَدِيدِ فَإِنَّهُ نَجَسٌ مَمْسُوخٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from a man, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from his father, from Ali ibn Uqbah, from Musa ibn Ukayl al-Numayri:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "As for iron, it is the adornment of the people of Hell, and gold is the adornment of the people of Paradise. Allah (swt) has made gold in this world the adornment of women, so He (azj) prohibited it for men to wear and to pray while wearing it. And Allah (swt) has made iron in this world the adornment of the jinn and the devils, so He (azj) prohibited the Muslim man from wearing it during prayer, except if he is facing an enemy, in which case there is no harm in it." He (narrator) said: “I asked Him (a.s): ‘What about a man while traveling who has with him a knife in his boot, which he cannot do without, or it is tied in his trousers, or a key, fearing that if he sets it down, it will be lost, or he wears a belt with iron in it, what then?" Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in the knife and the belt for the traveler or in times of necessity. Likewise, there is no harm in the key if he fears loss or forgetting it. And there is no harm in the sword and every kind of weapon during war. But outside of that, it is not permissible to pray in anything made of iron, for it is impure (najis) and accursed (mamsukh)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 243

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said: "A man should not pray while there is an iron ring on his hand."
arabicText: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ :«لاَ يُصَلِّي اَلرَّجُلُ وَ فِي يَدِهِ خَاتَمُ حَدِيدٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said: "A man should not pray while there is an iron ring on his hand."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 243

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about a man who prays among the graves. Imam (a.s) said: "That is not permissible unless he places between himself and the graves, when he prays, a distance of ten cubits in front of him, ten cubits behind him, ten cubits to his right, and ten cubits to his left. Then he may pray if he wishes."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي بَيْنَ اَلْقُبُورِ قَالَ« لاَ يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ اَلْقُبُورِ إِذَا صَلَّى عَشَرَةَ أَذْرُعٍ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَ عَشَرَةَ أَذْرُعٍ مِنْ خَلْفِهِ وَ عَشَرَةَ أَذْرُعٍ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَ عَشَرَةَ أَذْرُعٍ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي إِنْ شَاءَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about a man who prays among the graves. Imam (a.s) said: "That is not permissible unless he places between himself and the graves, when he prays, a distance of ten cubits in front of him, ten cubits behind him, ten cubits to his right, and ten cubits to his left. Then he may pray if he wishes."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 243

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Mu‘awiyah ibn Hakim, from Mu‘ammar ibn Khallad:
(Imam) al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in praying among the graves as long as one does not take the grave as a Qiblah."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمٍ عَنْ مُعَمَّرِ بْنِ خَلاَّدٍ عَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاَةِ بَيْنَ اَلْمَقَابِرِ مَا لَمْ يَتَّخِذِ اَلْقَبْرَ قِبْلَةً»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Mu‘awiyah ibn Hakim, from Mu‘ammar ibn Khallad:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam) al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in praying among the graves as long as one does not take the grave as a Qiblah."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 244

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud, from his father, who said: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Himyari narrated to us, saying:
I (al-Himyari) wrote to the Jurist (peace be upon him), asking him about a man who visits the graves of the Imams, peace be upon them; ‘Is it permissible for him to prostrate upon the grave or not? And is it permissible for someone who prays near their graves to stand behind the grave and make the grave his Qiblah? And to stand by its head or feet? And is it permissible to stand in front of the grave and pray with the grave behind him, or not? So He (the Jurist (a.s)), peace be upon him, replied and I read the tawqi’ (written response), and from it I (al-Himyari) copied; "As for prostration on the grave, it is not permissible in an obligatory or supererogatory prayer, nor during a visitation. Rather, he should place his right cheek on the grave (of Imam (a.s)). As for prayer, it should be behind the grave, making it (the grave of Imam (a.s)) as his Imam (leader of prayer), and it is not permissible to pray in front of it, because the Imam (of prayer) is not preceded. He may pray to its right or left."
arabicText: رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْحِمْيَرِيُّ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى اَلْفَقِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَزُورُ قُبُورَ اَلْأَئِمَّةِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ هَلْ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ عَلَى اَلْقَبْرِ أَمْ لاَ وَ هَلْ يَجُوزُ لِمَنْ صَلَّى عِنْدَ قُبُورِهِمْ أَنْ يَقُومَ وَرَاءَ اَلْقَبْرِ وَ يَجْعَلَ اَلْقَبْرَ قِبْلَةً وَ يَقُومَ عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ وَ رِجْلَيْهِ وَ هَلْ يَجُوزُ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ اَلْقَبْرَ وَ يُصَلِّيَ وَ يَجْعَلَهُ خَلْفَهُ أَمْ لاَ فَأَجَابَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَقَرَأْتُ اَلتَّوْقِيعَ وَمِنْهُ نَسَخْتُ« أَمَّا اَلسُّجُودُ عَلَى اَلْقَبْرِ فَلاَ يَجُوزُ فِي نَافِلَةٍ وَلاَ فَرِيضَةٍ وَ لاَ زِيَارَةٍ بَلْ يَضَعُ خَدَّهُ اَلْأَيْمَنَ عَلَى اَلْقَبْرِ وَأَمَّا اَلصَّلاَةُ فَإِنَّهَا خَلْفَهُ يَجْعَلُهُ اَلْأَمَامَ وَلاَ يَجُوزُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ لِأَنَّ اَلْإِمَامَ لاَ يُتَقَدَّمُ وَ يُصَلِّي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَ شِمَالِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud, from his father, who said: Muhammad ibn Abdullah al-Himyari narrated to us, saying:
thaqalaynMatn: I (al-Himyari) wrote to the Jurist (peace be upon him), asking him about a man who visits the graves of the Imams, peace be upon them; ‘Is it permissible for him to prostrate upon the grave or not? And is it permissible for someone who prays near their graves to stand behind the grave and make the grave his Qiblah? And to stand by its head or feet? And is it permissible to stand in front of the grave and pray with the grave behind him, or not? So He (the Jurist (a.s)), peace be upon him, replied and I read the tawqi’ (written response), and from it I (al-Himyari) copied; "As for prostration on the grave, it is not permissible in an obligatory or supererogatory prayer, nor during a visitation. Rather, he should place his right cheek on the grave (of Imam (a.s)). As for prayer, it should be behind the grave, making it (the grave of Imam (a.s)) as his Imam (leader of prayer), and it is not permissible to pray in front of it, because the Imam (of prayer) is not preceded. He may pray to its right or left."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 244

chapter: Chapter on What is Permissible to Pray in, from Clothing and Place, and What is Not Permissible to Pray in, from That
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Nu’man, from the one who narrated it: Abu Abdillah (a.s) (was asked) regarding a man who prays while gesturing on his mount (dabbah) while wearing a turban. Imam (a.s) said: "He must uncover the spot of prostration."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَمَّنْ رَوَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي وَ هُوَ يُومِئُ عَلَى دَابَّتِهِ مُتَعَمِّماً قَالَ« يَكْشِفُ مَوْضِعَ اَلسُّجُودِ»
thaqalaynMatn: Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Nu’man, from the one who narrated it: Abu Abdillah (a.s) (was asked) regarding a man who prays while gesturing on his mount (dabbah) while wearing a turban. Imam (a.s) said: "He must uncover the spot of prostration."
