chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Musa Al-Khashshab, from Ghiyath ibn Kallub, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from (Imam) Ja'far (a.s), from his father (a.s), peace be upon them both:
(Imam (a.s) said) "Two men from among the companions of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, differed regarding the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. So they wrote to Ubayy ibn Ka'b asking: “How many pauses did the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, have in his prayer?” He said: “He had two pauses, one when he finished reciting the ‘Opening of the Book’ (Surah Al-Fatiha) and another when he finished the Surah."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى اَلْخَشَّابِ عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ كَلُّوبٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ :«أَنَّ رَجُلَيْنِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ اِخْتَلَفَا فِي صَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَكَتَبَا إِلَى أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ كَمْ كَانَتْ لِرَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مِنْ سَكْتَةٍ قَالَ كَانَتْ لَهُ سَكْتَتَانِ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ أُمِّ اَلْقُرْآنِ وَ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ اَلسُّورَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Musa Al-Khashshab, from Ghiyath ibn Kallub, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from (Imam) Ja'far (a.s), from his father (a.s), peace be upon them both:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s) said) "Two men from among the companions of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, differed regarding the prayer of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. So they wrote to Ubayy ibn Ka'b asking: “How many pauses did the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, have in his prayer?” He said: “He had two pauses, one when he finished reciting the ‘Opening of the Book’ (Surah Al-Fatiha) and another when he finished the Surah."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 321

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah who said:
Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "When you intend to bow and to prostrate, raise your hands and then bow and prostrate."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَرْكَعَ وَ تَسْجُدَ فَارْفَعْ يَدَيْكَ ثُمَّ اِرْكَعْ وَ اُسْجُدْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "When you intend to bow and to prostrate, raise your hands and then bow and prostrate."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 322

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Musa ibn Yasar Al-Minqari from Ali ibn Ja'far Al-Sakuni from Isma'il ibn Muslim Al-Sha'iri from Abu Abdillah (a.s), from his father (a.s), from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them:
The Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: "Place the two hands where you place the face, for indeed they both prostrate just as the face prostrates."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ يَسَارٍ اَلْمِنْقَرِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ اَلشَّعِيرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ:« ضَعُوا اَلْيَدَيْنِ حَيْثُ تَضَعُونَ اَلْوَجْهَ فَإِنَّهُمَا يَسْجُدَانِ كَمَا يَسْجُدُ اَلْوَجْهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Musa ibn Yasar Al-Minqari from Ali ibn Ja'far Al-Sakuni from Isma'il ibn Muslim Al-Sha'iri from Abu Abdillah (a.s), from his father (a.s), from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: The Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: "Place the two hands where you place the face, for indeed they both prostrate just as the face prostrates."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 322

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Musa ibn Umar, from Al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr and Tha'labah, from Burayd:
Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "The forehead to the nose, whichever of them you place upon the ground in prostration, it suffices you, and prostrating with all of it (the entire forehead and nose) is better."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ وَ ثَعْلَبَةَ عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «اَلْجَبْهَةُ إِلَى اَلْأَنْفِ أَيُّ ذَلِكَ أَصَبْتَ بِهِ اَلْأَرْضَ فِي اَلسُّجُودِ أَجْزَأَكَ وَ اَلسُّجُودُ عَلَيْهِ كُلِّهِ أَفْضَلُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Musa ibn Umar, from Al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr and Tha'labah, from Burayd:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "The forehead to the nose, whichever of them you place upon the ground in prostration, it suffices you, and prostrating with all of it (the entire forehead and nose) is better."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 322

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah Al-Barqi from Muhammad ibn Musadif, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s) say: "Indeed, the prostration is upon the forehead, and there is no prostration upon the nose."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُصَادِفٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« إِنَّمَا اَلسُّجُودُ عَلَى اَلْجَبْهَةِ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى اَلْأَنْفِ سُجُودٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah Al-Barqi from Muhammad ibn Musadif, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s) say: "Indeed, the prostration is upon the forehead, and there is no prostration upon the nose."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 322

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Marwan ibn Muslim and Ammar Al-Sabati:
(Imam (a.s)) said: "The area between the hairline and the tip of the nose is a place of prostration; whichever part of that you place on the ground suffices you."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ وَعَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ:« مَا بَيْنَ قُصَاصِ اَلشَّعْرِ إِلَى طَرَفِ اَلْأَنْفِ مَسْجِدٌ أَيُّ ذَلِكَ أَصَبْتَ بِهِ اَلْأَرْضَ أَجْزَأَكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Marwan ibn Muslim and Ammar Al-Sabati:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s)) said: "The area between the hairline and the tip of the nose is a place of prostration; whichever part of that you place on the ground suffices you."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 322

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ammar from (Imam) Ja'far (a.s) from his father (a.s), peace be upon them both:
(Imam (a.s)) said: “(Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘The prayer is not sufficient if the nose does not touch what the forehead touches’."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« لاَ تُجْزِي صَلاَةٌ لاَ يُصِيبُ اَلْأَنْفُ مَا يُصِيبُ اَلْجَبِينُ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ammar from (Imam) Ja'far (a.s) from his father (a.s), peace be upon them both:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s)) said: “(Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘The prayer is not sufficient if the nose does not touch what the forehead touches’."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 322

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from (Imam) Ja'far (a.s) from his father (a.s), peace be upon them both: (Imam (a.s)) said: "Indeed, (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, disliked arranging the pebbles during the prayer, and He (a.s) used to dislike that one should pray upon the hairline until he lets it fall naturally."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَرِهَ تَنْظِيمَ اَلْحَصَى فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَى قُصَاصِ شَعْرِهِ حَتَّى يُرْسِلَهُ إِرْسَالاً»
thaqalaynMatn: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from (Imam) Ja'far (a.s) from his father (a.s), peace be upon them both: (Imam (a.s)) said: "Indeed, (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, disliked arranging the pebbles during the prayer, and He (a.s) used to dislike that one should pray upon the hairline until he lets it fall naturally."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 323

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Najran from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘Prostration is upon seven bones: the forehead, the two hands, the two knees, and the two big toes, and you press your nose firmly in humility. As for the obligation, it is these seven, and as for pressing the nose, it is a Sunnah from the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ:« اَلسُّجُودُ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَعْظُمٍ اَلْجَبْهَةِ وَ اَلْيَدَيْنِ وَ اَلرُّكْبَتَيْنِ وَ اَلْإِبْهَامَيْنِ وَ تُرْغِمُ بِأَنْفِكَ إِرْغَاماً فَأَمَّا اَلْفَرْضُ فَهَذِهِ اَلسَّبْعَةُ وَ أَمَّا اَلْإِرْغَامُ بِالْأَنْفِ فَسُنَّةٌ مِنَ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Najran from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘Prostration is upon seven bones: the forehead, the two hands, the two knees, and the two big toes, and you press your nose firmly in humility. As for the obligation, it is these seven, and as for pressing the nose, it is a Sunnah from the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 323

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Umar Al-Halabi from Aban ibn Taghlib, who said:
I entered upon Abu Abdillah (a.s), while He (a.s) was praying, and I counted for Him (a.s) in the bowing and the prostration sixty tasbihat.
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عُمَرَ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ هُوَ يُصَلِّي فَعَدَدْتُ لَهُ فِي اَلرُّكُوعِ وَ اَلسُّجُودِ سِتِّينَ تَسْبِيحَةً
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Umar Al-Halabi from Aban ibn Taghlib, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I entered upon Abu Abdillah (a.s), while He (a.s) was praying, and I counted for Him (a.s) in the bowing and the prostration sixty tasbihat.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 323

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who remembers the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, while he is in the obligatory prayer, whether bowing or prostrating, and he sends blessings upon Him (saws) while in that state. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, indeed, sending blessings upon the Prophet of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, is like the takbir and the tasbih, and it is ten good deeds, and eighteen angels hasten to deliver it to him, each vying as to who will convey it to him."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَذْكُرُ اَلنَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ هُوَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةِ إِمَّا رَاكِعاً وَ إِمَّا سَاجِداً فَيُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ عَلَى تِلْكَ اَلْحَالِ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ إِنَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ عَلَى نَبِيِّ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَهَيْئَةِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ وَ اَلتَّسْبِيحِ وَ هِيَ عَشْرُ حَسَنَاتٍ يَبْتَدِرُهَا ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ مَلَكاً أَيُّهُمْ يُبَلِّغُهَا إِيَّاهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who remembers the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, while he is in the obligatory prayer, whether bowing or prostrating, and he sends blessings upon Him (saws) while in that state. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, indeed, sending blessings upon the Prophet of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, is like the takbir and the tasbih, and it is ten good deeds, and eighteen angels hasten to deliver it to him, each vying as to who will convey it to him."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 323

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Fadalah from Aban from Abdurrahman ibn Sayabah, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “Shall I supplicate to Allah (swt) while I am in prostration?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, so supplicate for the world and the Hereafter, for indeed He (azj) is the Lord (azj) of the world and the Hereafter."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَيَابَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَدْعُو اَللَّهَ وَ أَنَا سَاجِدٌ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ فَادْعُ لِلدُّنْيَا وَ اَلْآخِرَةِ فَإِنَّهُ رَبُّ اَلدُّنْيَا وَ اَلْآخِرَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Fadalah from Aban from Abdurrahman ibn Sayabah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “Shall I supplicate to Allah (swt) while I am in prostration?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, so supplicate for the world and the Hereafter, for indeed He (azj) is the Lord (azj) of the world and the Hereafter."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 324

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Basir led us in prayer on the way to Mecca, and while he was in prostration, and their camel had been lost, he said: “O Allah (swt), return so-and-so’s camel to him.” Muhammad (ibn Muslim) said: “Then I entered upon Abu Abdillah (a.s), and informed him, and Imam (a.s) said: "And he did that?" I said: “Yes”. Imam (a.s) then remained silent. I asked: “Should I repeat the prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: "No."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: صَلَّى بِنَا أَبُو بَصِيرٍ فِي طَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ فَقَالَ وَ هُوَ سَاجِدٌ وَ قَدْ كَانَتْ ضَاعَتْ نَاقَةٌ لَهُمْ اَللَّهُمَّ رُدَّ عَلَى فُلاَنٍ نَاقَتَهُ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ« وَ فَعَلَ» فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ فَسَكَتَ قُلْتُ أَ فَأُعِيدُ اَلصَّلاَةَ قَالَ« لاَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Basir led us in prayer on the way to Mecca, and while he was in prostration, and their camel had been lost, he said: “O Allah (swt), return so-and-so’s camel to him.” Muhammad (ibn Muslim) said: “Then I entered upon Abu Abdillah (a.s), and informed him, and Imam (a.s) said: "And he did that?" I said: “Yes”. Imam (a.s) then remained silent. I asked: “Should I repeat the prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: "No."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 324

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ibn Mahbub from Abu Jarir Al-Rawasi, who said:
I heard Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), while He (a.s) was saying: "O Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for comfort at the time of death and pardon at the time of the reckoning," and He (a.s) kept repeating it.
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَرِيرٍ اَلرَّوَّاسِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ:« اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ اَلرَّاحَةَ عِنْدَ اَلْمَوْتِ وَ اَلْعَفْوَ عِنْدَ اَلْحِسَابِ» يُرَدِّدُهَا.
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ibn Mahbub from Abu Jarir Al-Rawasi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), while He (a.s) was saying: "O Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) for comfort at the time of death and pardon at the time of the reckoning," and He (a.s) kept repeating it.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 324

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Ibn Bukayr from Hamzah ibn Humran and Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad, who said:
We entered upon Abu Abdillah (a.s), and with Him (a.s) were a group of people. He (a.s) led them in the Asr prayer, and we had already prayed, so we counted for Him (a.s) in his bowing "Glory be to my Lord (azj), the Great" either four or thirty-three times, and one of them mentioned in his narration "and with His (azj) praise" in the bowing and the prostration.
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ حُمْرَانَ وَاَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ قَالاَ: دَخَلْنَا عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ عِنْدَهُ قَوْمٌ فَصَلَّى بِهِمُ اَلْعَصْرَ وَ قَدْ كُنَّا صَلَّيْنَا فَعَدَدْ نَا لَهُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ« سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ اَلْعَظِيمِ» أَرْبَعاً أَوْ ثَلاَثاً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ مَرَّةً وَ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا فِي حَدِيثِهِ« وَ بِحَمْدِهِ» فِي اَلرُّكُوعِ وَ اَلسُّجُودِ
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Ibn Bukayr from Hamzah ibn Humran and Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: We entered upon Abu Abdillah (a.s), and with Him (a.s) were a group of people. He (a.s) led them in the Asr prayer, and we had already prayed, so we counted for Him (a.s) in his bowing "Glory be to my Lord (azj), the Great" either four or thirty-three times, and one of them mentioned in his narration "and with His (azj) praise" in the bowing and the prostration.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 324

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban ibn Uthman from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about a man, when he bows and then raises his head, should he first place his hands on the ground or his knees? Imam (a.s) said: "It does not harm him whichever of them he begins with; it is accepted from him."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ إِذَا رَكَعَ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ أَ يَبْدَأُ فَيَضَعُ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ أَمْ رُكْبَتَيْهِ قَالَ« لاَ يَضُرُّهُ بِأَيِّ ذَلِكَ بَدَأَ هُوَ مَقْبُولٌ مِنْهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban ibn Uthman from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about a man, when he bows and then raises his head, should he first place his hands on the ground or his knees? Imam (a.s) said: "It does not harm him whichever of them he begins with; it is accepted from him."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 325

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said: "There is no harm in sitting in the Iq'a' position during the prayer between the two prostrations." (sitting back on the heels with the bottom of the toes, and the knees, upon the ground)
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ بِالْإِقْعَاءِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فِيمَا بَيْنَ اَلسَّجْدَتَيْنِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah Al-Halabi:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said: "There is no harm in sitting in the Iq'a' position during the prayer between the two prostrations." (sitting back on the heels with the bottom of the toes, and the knees, upon the ground)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 325

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Sama'ah from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "Do not sit in the Iq'a' position between the two prostrations."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ تُقْعِ بَيْنَ اَلسَّجْدَتَيْنِ إِقْعَاءً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Sama'ah from Abu Basir:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "Do not sit in the Iq'a' position between the two prostrations."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 325

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Abu Isma'il Al-Sarraj from Harun ibn Kharijah, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah (a.s) while He (a.s) was in prostration, and He (a.s) had lifted his feet from the ground, with one of his feet placed upon the other.
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ اَلسَّرَّاجِ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ هُوَ سَاجِدٌ وَ قَدْ رَفَعَ قَدَمَيْهِ مِنَ اَلْأَرْضِ وَ إِحْدَى قَدَمَيْهِ عَلَى اَلْأُخْرَى
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Abu Isma'il Al-Sarraj from Harun ibn Kharijah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I saw Abu Abdillah (a.s) while He (a.s) was in prostration, and He (a.s) had lifted his feet from the ground, with one of his feet placed upon the other.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 325

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah (a.s) leveling the pebbles at the place of his prostration between the two prostrations.
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يُسَوِّي اَلْحَصَى فِي مَوْضِعِ سُجُودِهِ بَيْنَ اَلسَّجْدَتَيْنِ
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I saw Abu Abdillah (a.s) leveling the pebbles at the place of his prostration between the two prostrations.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 326

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah Al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
I asked Imam (a.s): “Should a man wipe his forehead during the prayer if dust sticks to it?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, indeed Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, used to wipe his forehead during the prayer if dust stuck to it."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ أَ يَمْسَحُ اَلرَّجُلُ جَبْهَتَهُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ إِذَا لَصِقَ بِهَا تُرَابٌ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ قَدْ كَانَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَمْسَحُ جَبْهَتَهُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ إِذَا لَصِقَ بِهَا اَلتُّرَابُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah Al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s): “Should a man wipe his forehead during the prayer if dust sticks to it?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, indeed Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, used to wipe his forehead during the prayer if dust stuck to it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 326

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said: I said to Imam (a.s): “Is it sufficient that I say instead of the tasbih in bowing and prostration, ‘There is no god but Allah (swt), and praise be to Allah (swt), and Allah (swt) is the Greatest?’ Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, all of this is remembrance of Allah (swt)."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ يُجْزِي أَنْ أَقُولَ مَكَانَ اَلتَّسْبِيحِ فِي اَلرُّكُوعِ وَ اَلسُّجُودِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ وَ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَ اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ كُلُّ هَذَا ذِكْرُ اَللَّهِ»
thaqalaynMatn: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said: I said to Imam (a.s): “Is it sufficient that I say instead of the tasbih in bowing and prostration, ‘There is no god but Allah (swt), and praise be to Allah (swt), and Allah (swt) is the Greatest?’ Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, all of this is remembrance of Allah (swt)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 326

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab from Ja'far ibn Bashir from Hammad ibn Uthman from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (a.s): similar to it.
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: مِثْلَهُ.
thaqalaynMatn: Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab from Ja'far ibn Bashir from Hammad ibn Uthman from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (a.s): similar to it.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 326

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim from Abu Malik Al-Hadrami from Al-Husayn ibn Hammad, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “I prostrate and my forehead falls upon a raised surface.” Imam (a.s) said: "Raise your head and then place it (properly)."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْجُدُ فَتَقَعُ جَبْهَتِي عَلَى اَلْمَوْضِعِ اَلْمُرْتَفِعِ قَالَ« اِرْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ ثُمَّ ضَعْهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim from Abu Malik Al-Hadrami from Al-Husayn ibn Hammad, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “I prostrate and my forehead falls upon a raised surface.” Imam (a.s) said: "Raise your head and then place it (properly)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 326

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan from Ishaq ibn Ammar from a man from Banu Ijl, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a place that has dust in it, so I blow on it when I want to prostrate. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي عِجْلٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَكَانِ يَكُونُ فِيهِ اَلْغُبَارُ فَأَنْفُخُهُ إِذَا أَرَدْتُ اَلسُّجُودَ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan from Ishaq ibn Ammar from a man from Banu Ijl, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a place that has dust in it, so I blow on it when I want to prostrate. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 326

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "When you place your forehead upon a clod of earth, do not lift it, but rather drag it along the ground."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِذَا وَضَعْتَ جَبْهَتَكَ عَلَى نَبَكَةٍ فَلاَ تَرْفَعْهَا وَ لَكِنْ جُرَّهَا عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "When you place your forehead upon a clod of earth, do not lift it, but rather drag it along the ground."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 327

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad from Al-Fadl from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
I said to Him (a.s): “A man blows during the prayer upon the place of his forehead.” Imam (a.s) said: "No."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدٌ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَنْفُخُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ مَوْضِعَ جَبْهَتِهِ فَقَالَ« لاَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad from Al-Fadl from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Him (a.s): “A man blows during the prayer upon the place of his forehead.” Imam (a.s) said: "No."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 327

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "When a man prostrates and then wants to rise, he should not knead the ground with his hands, but rather he should spread his palms without placing his buttocks on the ground."
arabicText: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا سَجَدَ اَلرَّجُلُ ثُمَّ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنْهَضَ فَلاَ يَعْجِنُ بِيَدَيْهِ فِي اَلْأَرْضِ وَ لَكِنْ يَبْسُطُ كَفَّيْهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَضَعَ مَقْعَدَتَهُ فِي اَلْأَرْضِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "When a man prostrates and then wants to rise, he should not knead the ground with his hands, but rather he should spread his palms without placing his buttocks on the ground."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 327

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
Al-Mu'alla ibn Khunays asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), while I was with Imam (a.s), about prostrating upon a barren land and upon tar. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلَ اَلْمُعَلَّى بْنُ خُنَيْسٍ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ أَنَا عِنْدَهُ عَنِ اَلسُّجُودِ عَلَى اَلْقُفْرِ وَ عَلَى اَلْقِيرِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Al-Mu'alla ibn Khunays asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), while I was with Imam (a.s), about prostrating upon a barren land and upon tar. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 327

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Al-Qasim ibn Urwah from Abu Al-Abbas Al-Fadl ibn Abd Al-Malik, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "Do not prostrate except upon the earth or what the earth grows, except for cotton and linen."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْعَبَّاسِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« لاَ تَسْجُدْ إِلاَّ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ أَوْ مَا أَنْبَتَتِ اَلْأَرْضُ إِلاَّ اَلْقُطْنَ وَ اَلْكَتَّانَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Al-Qasim ibn Urwah from Abu Al-Abbas Al-Fadl ibn Abd Al-Malik, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "Do not prostrate except upon the earth or what the earth grows, except for cotton and linen."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 327

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Him (a.s): “Shall I prostrate upon zift, meaning tar?” Imam (a.s) said: "No, and not upon a garment of cotton, nor upon wool, nor upon anything from an animal, nor upon food, nor upon anything from the fruits of the earth, nor upon anything from feathers."
arabicText: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَسْجُدُ عَلَى اَلزِّفْتِ يَعْنِي اَلْقِيرَ فَقَالَ« لاَ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلثَّوْبِ اَلْكُرْسُفِ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلصُّوفِ وَ لاَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنَ اَلْحَيَوَانِ وَ لاَ عَلَى طَعَامٍ وَ لاَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنْ ثِمَارِ اَلْأَرْضِ وَ لاَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنَ اَلرِّيَاشِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Him (a.s): “Shall I prostrate upon zift, meaning tar?” Imam (a.s) said: "No, and not upon a garment of cotton, nor upon wool, nor upon anything from an animal, nor upon food, nor upon anything from the fruits of the earth, nor upon anything from feathers."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 327

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about plaster (Gypsum) that had been burned with dung and the bones of the dead, and with which the mosque was plastered, is it permissible to prostrate upon it? So Imam (a.s) wrote to me in his own handwriting: "Indeed, the water and the fire have purified it."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْجِصِّ يُوقَدُ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَذِرَةِ وَ عِظَامِ اَلْمَوْتَى وَ يُجَصَّصُ بِهِ اَلْمَسْجِدُ أَ يُسْجَدُ عَلَيْهِ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ بِخَطِّهِ« إِنَّ اَلْمَاءَ وَ اَلنَّارَ قَدْ طَهَّرَاهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about plaster (Gypsum) that had been burned with dung and the bones of the dead, and with which the mosque was plastered, is it permissible to prostrate upon it? So Imam (a.s) wrote to me in his own handwriting: "Indeed, the water and the fire have purified it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 328

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ali ibn Isma'il from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Sa'id:
Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, said: "Do not prostrate upon barren land, nor upon tar, nor upon plaster."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ تَسْجُدْ عَلَى اَلْقُفْرِ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلْقِيرِ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلصَّارُوجِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ali ibn Isma'il from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Sa'id:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, said: "Do not prostrate upon barren land, nor upon tar, nor upon plaster."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 328

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid from Yunus ibn Ya'qub:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "Do not prostrate upon gold nor upon silver."
arabicText: سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْوَلِيدِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ تَسْجُدْ عَلَى اَلذَّهَبِ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلْفِضَّةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid from Yunus ibn Ya'qub:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "Do not prostrate upon gold nor upon silver."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 328

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far (a.s) said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man praying upon fresh grass that has grown. Imam (a.s) said: "If he presses his forehead to the ground, then there is no harm." And about praying upon thick grown grass (thayyil) that covers solid ground. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلرَّطْبَةِ اَلنَّابِتَةِ قَالَ فَقَالَ« إِذَا أَلْصَقَ جَبْهَتَهُ بِالْأَرْضِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ» وَ عَلَى اَلْحَشِيشِ اَلنَّابِتِ اَلثَّيِّلِ وَ هُوَ يُصِيبُ أَرْضاً جَدَداً قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yahya from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far (a.s) said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man praying upon fresh grass that has grown. Imam (a.s) said: "If he presses his forehead to the ground, then there is no harm." And about praying upon thick grown grass (thayyil) that covers solid ground. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 328

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn:
Some of our companions wrote to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Madi, peace be upon him, asking him about praying upon glass. He said: “When my letter reached Imam (a.s), I reflected and said to myself: ‘it is from what the earth has produced, and I should not have asked about it.’” So Imam (a.s) wrote back to him: "Do not pray upon glass, even if your soul suggests to you that it is from what the earth has produced, for it is from salt and sand, and both are transformed (altered)."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ : أَنَّ بَعْضَ أَصْحَابِنَا كَتَبَ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْمَاضِي عَ يَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلزُّجَاجِ قَالَ فَلَمَّا نَفَذَ كِتَابِي إِلَيْهِ تَفَكَّرْتُ وَ قُلْتُ هُوَ مِمَّا أَنْبَتَتِ اَلْأَرْضُ وَ مَا كَانَ لِي أَنْ أَسْأَلَ عَنْهُ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ «لاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى اَلزُّجَاجِ وَ إِنْ حَدَّثَتْكَ نَفْسُكَ أَنَّهُ مِمَّا أَنْبَتَتِ اَلْأَرْضُ وَ لَكِنَّهُ مِنَ اَلْمِلْحِ وَ اَلرَّمْلِ وَ هُمَا مَمْسُوخَانِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn:
thaqalaynMatn: Some of our companions wrote to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Madi, peace be upon him, asking him about praying upon glass. He said: “When my letter reached Imam (a.s), I reflected and said to myself: ‘it is from what the earth has produced, and I should not have asked about it.’” So Imam (a.s) wrote back to him: "Do not pray upon glass, even if your soul suggests to you that it is from what the earth has produced, for it is from salt and sand, and both are transformed (altered)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 328

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Jamil ibn Darraj about Abu Abdillah (a.s):
"Imam (a.s) disliked prostrating upon paper that has writing on it."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ:« أَنَّهُ كَرِهَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ عَلَى قِرْطَاسٍ عَلَيْهِ كِتَابَةٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Jamil ibn Darraj about Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: "Imam (a.s) disliked prostrating upon paper that has writing on it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 328

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from (Imam) Ja'far (a.s), from his father (a.s), from (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) said: "A man should not prostrate upon something that the rest of his body is not upon."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« لاَ يَسْجُدُ اَلرَّجُلُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ سَائِرُ جَسَدِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from (Imam) Ja'far (a.s), from his father (a.s), from (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "A man should not prostrate upon something that the rest of his body is not upon."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 329

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
What was narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Jamil ibn Darraj from Aban from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Uqbah from Humran from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them both:
(Imam (a.s)) said: "My father (a.s) used to pray upon the khumrah (a small mat) placing it upon the carpet and would prostrate upon it, and if there was no khumrah, He (a.s) would place pebbles on the carpet where He (a.s) would prostrate."
arabicText: مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عُقْبَةَ عَنْ حُمْرَانَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« كَانَ أَبِي يُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلْخُمْرَةِ يَجْعَلُهَا عَلَى اَلطِّنْفِسَةِ وَ يَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهَا فَإِذَا لَمْ تَكُنْ خُمْرَةٌ جَعَلَ حَصًى عَلَى اَلطِّنْفِسَةِ حَيْثُ يَسْجُدُ»
thaqalaynSanad: What was narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Jamil ibn Darraj from Aban from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Uqbah from Humran from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them both:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s)) said: "My father (a.s) used to pray upon the khumrah (a small mat) placing it upon the carpet and would prostrate upon it, and if there was no khumrah, He (a.s) would place pebbles on the carpet where He (a.s) would prostrate."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 329

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Al-Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "My father (a.s) requested a khumrah (small prayer mat), but I delayed in bringing it to Him (a.s), so He (a.s) took a handful of pebbles and placed them on the carpet, then prostrated upon them."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« دَعَا أَبِي بِخُمْرَةٍ فَأَبْطَأْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَأَخَذَ كَفّاً مِنْ حَصًى فَجَعَلَهُ عَلَى اَلْبِسَاطِ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "My father (a.s) requested a khumrah (small prayer mat), but I delayed in bringing it to Him (a.s), so He (a.s) took a handful of pebbles and placed them on the carpet, then prostrated upon them."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 329

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar and Burayd ibn Mu'awiyah from one of them (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them both:
(Imam (a.s)) said: "There is no harm in standing upon a prayer mat made of hair or wool if one prostrates upon the earth; but if it is from the plants of the earth, then there is no harm in standing upon it and prostrating upon it."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ وَبُرَيْدِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ بِالْقِيَامِ عَلَى اَلْمُصَلَّى مِنَ اَلشَّعْرِ وَ اَلصُّوفِ إِذَا كَانَ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ فَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ نَبَاتِ اَلْأَرْضِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِالْقِيَامِ عَلَيْهِ وَ اَلسُّجُودِ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar and Burayd ibn Mu'awiyah from one of them (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them both:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s)) said: "There is no harm in standing upon a prayer mat made of hair or wool if one prostrates upon the earth; but if it is from the plants of the earth, then there is no harm in standing upon it and prostrating upon it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 329

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about plaster (Gypsum) that had been burned with dung and the bones of the dead, and with which the mosque was plastered, is it permissible to prostrate upon it? So He (a.s) wrote to me in his own handwriting: "Indeed, the water and the fire have purified it."
arabicText: احمد بن محمد عن الحسن بن محبوب قال سألت أبا الحسن عليه السلام عن الجص يوقد عليه بالعذرة وعظام الموتى ويجصص به المسجد يسجد عليه؟ فكتب إلي بخطه إن الماء والنار قد طهراه
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about plaster (Gypsum) that had been burned with dung and the bones of the dead, and with which the mosque was plastered, is it permissible to prostrate upon it? So He (a.s) wrote to me in his own handwriting: "Indeed, the water and the fire have purified it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 330

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Rayan, who said:
Some of our companions wrote with the hand of Ibrahim ibn Uqbah to Imam (a.s), meaning Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, asking Him (a.s) about prayer upon the khumrah of Madinah. So He (a.s) wrote: "Pray upon it as long as it is made with threadwork, and do not pray upon that which is made with leather straps." He said: Then our companions hesitated, so I recited to them a line of poetry by Ta'abbata Sharran Al-Fihmi: "As if it were the threadwork of a Mari, twisted and spun," and Mari is a man who makes ropes and twists threads.
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلرَّيَّانِ قَالَ: كَتَبَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا بِيَدِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ إِلَيْهِ يَعْنِي أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْخُمْرَةِ اَلْمَدَنِيَّةِ فَكَتَبَ« صَلِّ فِيهَا مَا كَانَ مَعْمُولاً بِخُيُوطَةٍ وَلاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى مَا كَانَ بِسُيُورَةٍ» قَالَ فَتَوَقَّفَ أَصْحَابُنَا فَأَنْشَدْتُهُمْ بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ لِتَأَبَّطَ شَرّاً اَلْفَهْمِيِّ كَأَنَّهَا خُيُوطَةُ مَارِيٍّ تُغَارُ وَ تُفْتَلُ وَ مَارِيٌّ رَجُلٌ حَبَّالٌ يَفْتِلُ اَلْخُيُوطَ
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Rayan, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Some of our companions wrote with the hand of Ibrahim ibn Uqbah to Imam (a.s), meaning Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, asking Him (a.s) about prayer upon the khumrah of Madinah. So He (a.s) wrote: "Pray upon it as long as it is made with threadwork, and do not pray upon that which is made with leather straps." He said: Then our companions hesitated, so I recited to them a line of poetry by Ta'abbata Sharran Al-Fihmi: "As if it were the threadwork of a Mari, twisted and spun," and Mari is a man who makes ropes and twists threads.
