chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Al-Muthanna Al-Hannat from Uyaynah, the seller of reeds, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “I enter the mosque on a day of extreme heat and dislike to pray upon the pebbles, so I spread my garment and prostrate upon it.” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, there is no harm in it."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنِ اَلْمُثَنَّى اَلْحَنَّاطِ عَنْ عُيَيْنَةَ بَيَّاعِ اَلْقَصَبِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَدْخُلُ اَلْمَسْجِدَ فِي اَلْيَوْمِ اَلشَّدِيدِ اَلْحَرِّ فَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ عَلَى اَلْحَصَى فَأَبْسُطُ ثَوْبِي فَأَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ لَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Al-Muthanna Al-Hannat from Uyaynah, the seller of reeds, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “I enter the mosque on a day of extreme heat and dislike to pray upon the pebbles, so I spread my garment and prostrate upon it.” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, there is no harm in it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 330

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam (a.s): “I am on a journey and the time for prayer arrives, and I fear the scorching ground for my face. What should I do?” Imam (a.s) said: "Prostrate upon part of your garment." I asked: “I do not have a garment with me whose edge or hem I can prostrate upon.” Imam (a.s) said: "Prostrate on back of your hand, for it is one of places of prostration."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَكُونُ فِي اَلسَّفَرِ فَتَحْضُرُ اَلصَّلاَةُ وَأَخَافُ اَلرَّمْضَاءَ عَلَى وَجْهِي كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ قَالَ« تَسْجُدُ عَلَى بَعْضِ ثَوْبِكَ» قُلْتُ لَيْسَ عَلَيَّ ثَوْبٌ يُمْكِنُنِي أَنْ أَسْجُدَ عَلَى طَرَفِهِ وَ لاَ ذَيْلِهِ قَالَ« اُسْجُدْ عَلَى ظَهْرِ كَفِّكَ فَإِنَّهَا إِحْدَى اَلْمَسَاجِدِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam (a.s): “I am on a journey and the time for prayer arrives, and I fear the scorching ground for my face. What should I do?” Imam (a.s) said: "Prostrate upon part of your garment." I asked: “I do not have a garment with me whose edge or hem I can prostrate upon.” Imam (a.s) said: "Prostrate on back of your hand, for it is one of places of prostration."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 330

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abu Talib ibn Al-Salt from Al-Qasim ibn Al-Fudayl, who said:
I said to (Imam) Al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, a man prostrates upon his sleeve due to the harm of heat or cold.” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي طَالِبِ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ اَلرَّجُلُ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى كُمِّهِ مِنْ أَذَى اَلْحَرِّ وَ اَلْبَرْدِ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abu Talib ibn Al-Salt from Al-Qasim ibn Al-Fudayl, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to (Imam) Al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, a man prostrates upon his sleeve due to the harm of heat or cold.” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 330

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Abbad ibn Sulayman from Sa'd ibn Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim ibn Al-Fudayl from Ahmad ibn Umar, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about a man who prostrates upon the sleeve of his shirt due to the harm of heat or cold, or upon his cloak when there is beneath it a mat or something else upon which prostration is not permitted. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى كُمِّ قَمِيصِهِ مِنْ أَذَى اَلْحَرِّ وَ اَلْبَرْدِ أَوْ عَلَى رِدَائِهِ إِذَا كَانَ تَحْتَهُ مِسْحٌ أَوْ غَيْرُهُ مِمَّا لاَ يُسْجَدُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Abbad ibn Sulayman from Sa'd ibn Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim ibn Al-Fudayl from Ahmad ibn Umar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about a man who prostrates upon the sleeve of his shirt due to the harm of heat or cold, or upon his cloak when there is beneath it a mat or something else upon which prostration is not permitted. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 331

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Abbad ibn Sulayman from Sa'd ibn Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim ibn Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:
A man wrote to Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), asking: “Should a man prostrate upon a cloth to protect his face from heat and cold, or from something he dislikes to prostrate upon?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, there is no harm in it."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ: كَتَبَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ هَلْ يَسْجُدُ اَلرَّجُلُ عَلَى اَلثَّوْبِ يَتَّقِي بِهِ وَجْهَهُ مِنَ اَلْحَرِّ وَ اَلْبَرْدِ وَ مِنَ اَلشَّيْءِ يَكْرَهُ اَلسُّجُودَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Abbad ibn Sulayman from Sa'd ibn Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim ibn Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: A man wrote to Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), asking: “Should a man prostrate upon a cloth to protect his face from heat and cold, or from something he dislikes to prostrate upon?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, there is no harm in it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 331

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab from Wuhaib ibn Hafs from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who prostrates upon a mat. Imam (a.s) said: "If it is out of dissimulation (taqiyyah), then there is no harm in it."
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْخَطَّابِ عَنْ وُهَيْبِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى اَلْمِسْحِ فَقَالَ« إِذَا كَانَ فِي تَقِيَّةٍ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab from Wuhaib ibn Hafs from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who prostrates upon a mat. Imam (a.s) said: "If it is out of dissimulation (taqiyyah), then there is no harm in it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 331

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother Al-Husayn ibn Ali from their father Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Madi, peace be upon him, about a man who prostrates upon a mat or a carpet. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm if it is in a state of dissimulation (taqiyyah)."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْمَاضِيَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى اَلْمِسْحِ وَ اَلْبِسَاطِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي حَالِ تَقِيَّةٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother Al-Husayn ibn Ali from their father Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Madi, peace be upon him, about a man who prostrates upon a mat or a carpet. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm if it is in a state of dissimulation (taqiyyah)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 331

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Sa'd ibn Abdullah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Dawud Al-Sarmi, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Thalith, peace be upon him, and said: “Is it permissible to prostrate upon linen and cotton without dissimulation (taqiyyah)?” Imam (a.s) said: "It is permissible."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ اَلصَّرْمِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ اَلثَّالِثَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَقُلْتُ هَلْ يَجُوزُ اَلسُّجُودُ عَلَى اَلْكَتَّانِ وَ اَلْقُطْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ تَقِيَّةٍ فَقَالَ« جَائِزٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Sa'd ibn Abdullah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Dawud Al-Sarmi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Thalith, peace be upon him, and said: “Is it permissible to prostrate upon linen and cotton without dissimulation (taqiyyah)?” Imam (a.s) said: "It is permissible."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 331

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Hamid from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Mansur ibn Hazim from more than one of our companions, who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “We are in a cold land where there is snow; should we prostrate upon it?” Imam (a.s) said: "No, but place something between you and it, such as cotton or linen."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّا نَكُونُ بِأَرْضٍ بَارِدَةٍ يَكُونُ فِيهَا اَلثَّلْجُ أَ فَنَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ« لاَ وَ لَكِنِ اِجْعَلْ بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَهُ شَيْئاً قُطْناً أَوْ كَتَّاناً»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Hamid from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Mansur ibn Hazim from more than one of our companions, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “We are in a cold land where there is snow; should we prostrate upon it?” Imam (a.s) said: "No, but place something between you and it, such as cotton or linen."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 332

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd from Abdullah ibn Ja'far from Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Kaysan Al-San'ani, who said:
I wrote to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Thalith, peace be upon him, asking Him (a.s) about prostrating upon cotton and linen without dissimulation (taqiyyah) and without necessity. So Imam (a.s) wrote back to me: "That is permissible."
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ اَلصَّنْعَانِيِّ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلثَّالِثِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلسُّجُودِ عَلَى اَلْقُطْنِ وَ اَلْكَتَّانِ مِنْ غَيْرِ تَقِيَّةٍ وَ لاَ ضَرُورَةٍ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ« ذَلِكَ جَائِزٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd from Abdullah ibn Ja'far from Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Kaysan Al-San'ani, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Thalith, peace be upon him, asking Him (a.s) about prostrating upon cotton and linen without dissimulation (taqiyyah) and without necessity. So Imam (a.s) wrote back to me: "That is permissible."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 332

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Yasir the servant, who said:
Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), passed by me while I was praying on the Tabari mat, and I had placed something upon it to prostrate on, so Imam (a.s) said to me: “Why do you not prostrate upon it? Is it not from what the earth has produced?”
arabicText: أحمد بن محمد عن أحمد بن اسحاق عن ياسر الخادم قال مر بي أبو الحسن عليه السلام وانا اصلي على الطبري وقد القيت عليه شيئا اسجد عليه فقال لي مالك لا تسجد عليه؟ أليس هو من نبات الارض؟
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Yasir the servant, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), passed by me while I was praying on the Tabari mat, and I had placed something upon it to prostrate on, so Imam (a.s) said to me: “Why do you not prostrate upon it? Is it not from what the earth has produced?”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 333

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said:
Dawud ibn Yazid asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about papers and parchment that have writing on them, is it permissible to prostrate upon them or not? So Imam (a.s) wrote: "It is permissible."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: سَأَلَ دَاوُدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْقَرَاطِيسِ وَ اَلْكَوَاغِذِ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةِ عَلَيْهَا هَلْ يَجُوزُ اَلسُّجُودُ عَلَيْهَا أَمْ لاَ فَكَتَبَ« يَجُوزُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Dawud ibn Yazid asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about papers and parchment that have writing on them, is it permissible to prostrate upon them or not? So Imam (a.s) wrote: "It is permissible."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 333

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Najran from Safwan Al-Jammal, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah (a.s), in the howdah prostrating upon paper, and most of the time Imam (a.s) would gesture with a slight indication.
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ اَلْجَمَّالِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي اَلْمَحْمِلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى قِرْطَاسٍ وَ أَكْثَرَ ذَلِكَ يُومِئُ إِيمَاءً
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Najran from Safwan Al-Jammal, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I saw Abu Abdillah (a.s), in the howdah prostrating upon paper, and most of the time Imam (a.s) would gesture with a slight indication.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 333

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Husayn ibn Uthman from Ibn Muskan from Muhammad ibn Mudarib from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
I asked Him (a.s) about a mound of wheat covered with clay, may I pray upon it? Imam (a.s) said: "Do not pray upon it." I asked: “But it is like a leveled surface.” Imam (a.s) said: "Do not pray upon it."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُضَارِبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ كُدْسِ حِنْطَةٍ مُطَيَّنٍ أُصَلِّي فَوْقَهُ فَقَالَ« لاَ تُصَلِّ فَوْقَهُ» قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ مِثْلُ اَلسَّطْحِ مُسْتَوٍ فَقَالَ« لاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Husayn ibn Uthman from Ibn Muskan from Muhammad ibn Mudarib from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him (a.s) about a mound of wheat covered with clay, may I pray upon it? Imam (a.s) said: "Do not pray upon it." I asked: “But it is like a leveled surface.” Imam (a.s) said: "Do not pray upon it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 333

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washsha from Ahmad ibn A'id from Umar ibn Hanzalah, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “There is a mound of food covered with clay, levelled like a surface, may I pray upon it?” He said: "Pray upon it."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَائِذٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَكُونُ اَلْكُدْسُ مِنَ اَلطَّعَامِ مُطَيَّناً مِثْلَ اَلسَّطْحِ قَالَ« صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washsha from Ahmad ibn A'id from Umar ibn Hanzalah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “There is a mound of food covered with clay, levelled like a surface, may I pray upon it?” He said: "Pray upon it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 334

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah, who said:
Abu Ja'far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in prostrating while there is your garment between your palms and the ground."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ تَسْجُدَ وَ بَيْنَ كَفَّيْكَ وَ بَيْنَ اَلْأَرْضِ ثَوْبُكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja'far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in prostrating while there is your garment between your palms and the ground."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 334

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from (Imam (a.s)) Ja'far (a.s), from his father (a.s), about (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him:
"That He (Imam Ali (a.s)) would not prostrate upon the sleeves nor upon the turban."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّهُ كَانَ لاَ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى اَلْكُمَّيْنِ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلْعِمَامَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from (Imam (a.s)) Ja'far (a.s), from his father (a.s), about (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: "That He (Imam Ali (a.s)) would not prostrate upon the sleeves nor upon the turban."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 334

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Dawud Al-Sarmi, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), and said to Him (a.s): “I go out on this journey, and sometimes there is no place to pray except upon snow, what should I do?” Imam (a.s) said: "If it is possible for you not to prostrate upon the snow, then do not prostrate upon it, but if it is not possible, then level it and prostrate upon it."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ اَلصَّرْمِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنِّي أَخْرُجُ فِي هَذَا اَلْوَجْهِ وَ رُبَّمَا لَمْ يَكُنْ مَوْضِعٌ أُصَلِّي فِيهِ مِنَ اَلثَّلْجِ فَكَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ فَقَالَ« إِنْ أَمْكَنَكَ أَنْ لاَ تَسْجُدَ عَلَى اَلثَّلْجِ فَلاَ تَسْجُدْ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يُمْكِنْكَ فَسَوِّهِ وَ اُسْجُدْ عَلَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Dawud Al-Sarmi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), and said to Him (a.s): “I go out on this journey, and sometimes there is no place to pray except upon snow, what should I do?” Imam (a.s) said: "If it is possible for you not to prostrate upon the snow, then do not prostrate upon it, but if it is not possible, then level it and prostrate upon it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 334

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Mu'ammar ibn Khallad, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about prostrating upon snow. Imam (a.s) said: "Do not prostrate in the salt marsh nor upon snow."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَمَّرِ بْنِ خَلاَّدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلسُّجُودِ عَلَى اَلثَّلْجِ فَقَالَ« لاَ تَسْجُدْ فِي اَلسَّبَخَةِ وَ لاَ عَلَى اَلثَّلْجِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Mu'ammar ibn Khallad, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about prostrating upon snow. Imam (a.s) said: "Do not prostrate in the salt marsh nor upon snow."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 334

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim Al-Hudayni, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who prays upon a bed while he is able to pray on the ground. So Imam (a.s) wrote: "There is no harm; pray upon it."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَشْيَمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ اَلْحُضَيْنِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلسَّرِيرِ وَ هُوَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ فَكَتَبَ« لاَ بَأْسَ صَلِّ فِيهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim Al-Hudayni, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who prays upon a bed while he is able to pray on the ground. So Imam (a.s) wrote: "There is no harm; pray upon it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 335

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmood, who said:
I said to (Imam) Al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man prays upon a bed made of teakwood and prostrates upon the teakwood, is that permissible?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي مَحْمُودٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلرَّجُلُ يُصَلِّي عَلَى سَرِيرٍ مِنْ سَاجٍ وَ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى اَلسَّاجِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmood, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to (Imam) Al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man prays upon a bed made of teakwood and prostrates upon the teakwood, is that permissible?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 335

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from Al-Husayn ibn Hammad, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who prostrates upon pebbles. Imam (a.s) said: "He should raise his head until he becomes firmly settled."
arabicText: اَلْمُفَضَّلُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى اَلْحَصَى قَالَ «يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَمْكِنَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from Al-Husayn ibn Hammad, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who prostrates upon pebbles. Imam (a.s) said: "He should raise his head until he becomes firmly settled."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 335

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-'Ala from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
It was mentioned that a man came to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, and asked Imam (a.s) about prostrating upon woven mats, palm-leaf mats, and plants. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: ذَكَرَ أَنَّ رَجُلاً أَتَى أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ سَأَلَهُ عَنِ اَلسُّجُودِ عَلَى اَلْبُورِيَاءِ وَ اَلْخَصَفَةِ وَ اَلنَّبَاتِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-'Ala from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: It was mentioned that a man came to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, and asked Imam (a.s) about prostrating upon woven mats, palm-leaf mats, and plants. Imam (a.s) said: "Yes."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 335

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ibrahim Al-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in praying upon woven mats, palm-leaf mats, and every plant except the fruit."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ اَلْخَزَّازِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْبُورِيَاءِ وَ اَلْخَصَفَةِ وَ كُلِّ نَبَاتٍ إِلاَّ اَلثَّمَرَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ibrahim Al-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in praying upon woven mats, palm-leaf mats, and every plant except the fruit."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 335

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Ishaq ibn Al-Fadl, who said:
He asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about prostrating upon mats and woven reed mats. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm, but that one prostrates upon the earth is more beloved to me, for the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to love that, to firmly place his forehead upon the earth, so I love for you what the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to love."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ اَلْفَضْلِ: أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلسُّجُودِ عَلَى اَلْحُصُرِ وَ اَلْبَوَارِي فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ وَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ يُحِبُّ ذَلِكَ أَنْ يُمَكِّنَ جَبْهَتَهُ مِنَ اَلْأَرْضِ فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ لَكَ مَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُحِبُّهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Ishaq ibn Al-Fadl, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: He asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about prostrating upon mats and woven reed mats. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm, but that one prostrates upon the earth is more beloved to me, for the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to love that, to firmly place his forehead upon the earth, so I love for you what the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to love."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 335

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the sick person. Imam (a.s) said: "He should prostrate upon the earth or on a hand fan (mirwaha) or upon a tooth-stick that he raises, this is better than gesturing. The one who disliked prostrating on a hand fan only did so because of the idols that were once worshipped besides Allah (swt), but we have never worshipped other than Allah (swt) at all. So prostrate on a hand fan, or on a stick, or on a tooth-stick (miswak)."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَرِيضِ فَقَالَ« يَسْجُدُ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ أَوْ عَلَى اَلْمِرْوَحَةِ أَوْ عَلَى سِوَاكٍ يَرْفَعُهُ هُوَ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ اَلْإِيمَاءِ إِنَّمَا كَرِهَ مَنْ كَرِهَ اَلسُّجُودَ عَلَى اَلْمِرْوَحَةِ مِنْ أَجْلِ اَلْأَوْثَانِ اَلَّتِي كَانَتْ تُعْبَدُ مِنْ دُونِ اَللَّهِ وَ إِنَّا لَمْ نَعْبُدْ غَيْرَ اَللَّهِ قَطُّ فَاسْجُدْ عَلَى اَلْمِرْوَحَةِ أَوْ عَلَى عُودٍ أَوْ عَلَى سِوَاكٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the sick person. Imam (a.s) said: "He should prostrate upon the earth or on a hand fan (mirwaha) or upon a tooth-stick that he raises, this is better than gesturing. The one who disliked prostrating on a hand fan only did so because of the idols that were once worshipped besides Allah (swt), but we have never worshipped other than Allah (swt) at all. So prostrate on a hand fan, or on a stick, or on a tooth-stick (miswak)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 335

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who gestures during the obligatory and supererogatory prayers when he does not find anything to prostrate upon and has no place to prostrate. Imam (a.s) said: "If it is like that, then let him gesture throughout the entire prayer."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُومِئُ فِي اَلْمَكْتُوبَةِ وَ اَلنَّوَافِلِ إِذَا لَمْ يَجِدْ مَا يَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَوْضِعٌ يَسْجُدُ فِيهِ قَالَ« إِذَا كَانَ هَكَذَا فَلْيُومِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ كُلِّهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who gestures during the obligatory and supererogatory prayers when he does not find anything to prostrate upon and has no place to prostrate. Imam (a.s) said: "If it is like that, then let him gesture throughout the entire prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 336

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And from him with this same chain of transmission, he said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who prays upon snow. Imam (a.s) said: "No, but if he is unable to find earth, he should spread his garment and pray upon it." And (Imam (a.s) was asked) about a man who is caught by rain and is in a place where he cannot prostrate due to the mud and cannot find a dry place. Imam (a.s) said: "He should begin the prayer, and when he bows, let him bow as usual in prayer, and when he raises his head from bowing, he should gesture for the prostration while standing. He should do that until he completes the prayer, and he should recite the testimony (tashahhud) while standing, then he should conclude with the taslim."
arabicText: وَ عَنْهُ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلثَّلْجِ قَالَ« لاَ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ بَسَطَ ثَوْبَهُ وَ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ» وَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصِيبُهُ مَطَرٌ وَ هُوَ فِي مَوْضِعٍ لاَ يَقْدِرُ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ فِيهِ مِنَ اَلطِّينِ وَ لاَ يَجِدُ مَوْضِعاً جَافّاً قَالَ« يَفْتَتِحُ اَلصَّلاَةَ فَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَلْيَرْكَعْ كَمَا رَكَعَ إِذَا صَلَّى فَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ اَلرُّكُوعِ فَلْيُومِ بِالسُّجُودِ إِيمَاءً وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ يَتَشَهَّدُ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ ثُمَّ يُسَلِّمُ»
thaqalaynSanad: And from him with this same chain of transmission, he said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about a man who prays upon snow. Imam (a.s) said: "No, but if he is unable to find earth, he should spread his garment and pray upon it." And (Imam (a.s) was asked) about a man who is caught by rain and is in a place where he cannot prostrate due to the mud and cannot find a dry place. Imam (a.s) said: "He should begin the prayer, and when he bows, let him bow as usual in prayer, and when he raises his head from bowing, he should gesture for the prostration while standing. He should do that until he completes the prayer, and he should recite the testimony (tashahhud) while standing, then he should conclude with the taslim."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 336

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And with this same chain of transmission from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the extent of mud upon which it is not permissible to prostrate, what is it? Imam (a.s) said: "When forehead sinks into it and does not remain stable on the ground."
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ حَدِّ اَلطِّينِ اَلَّذِي لاَ يُسْجَدُ عَلَيْهِ مَا هُوَ قَالَ« إِذَا غَرِقَتِ اَلْجَبْهَةُ فِيهِ وَ لَمْ تَثْبُتْ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ»
thaqalaynSanad: And with this same chain of transmission from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the extent of mud upon which it is not permissible to prostrate, what is it? Imam (a.s) said: "When forehead sinks into it and does not remain stable on the ground."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 336

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub by Al-Abbas by Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira by Alaa by Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in praying upon a patterned cloth if you place it beneath you."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَلاَءٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى اَلْمِثَالِ إِذَا جَعَلْتَهُ تَحْتَكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub by Al-Abbas by Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira by Alaa by Muhammad ibn Muslim:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in praying upon a patterned cloth if you place it beneath you."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 336

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Ibn Muskan from Husayn ibn Hammad from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
I said to Imam (a.s): “I lower my face for prostration, and my face falls upon a stone or something elevated, should I move my face to a level place?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, drag your face upon the ground without lifting it."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَضَعُ وَجْهِي لِلسُّجُودِ فَيَقَعُ وَجْهِي عَلَى حَجَرٍ أَوْ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مُرْتَفِعٍ أُحَوِّلُ وَجْهِي إِلَى مَكَانٍ مُسْتَوٍ قَالَ« نَعَمْ جُرَّ وَجْهَكَ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ تَرْفَعَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Ibn Muskan from Husayn ibn Hammad from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam (a.s): “I lower my face for prostration, and my face falls upon a stone or something elevated, should I move my face to a level place?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, drag your face upon the ground without lifting it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 337

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad from Musa ibn Al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah together from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who prostrates upon pebbles but does not firmly place his forehead upon the ground. Imam (a.s) said: "He should move his forehead until he becomes firmly settled, pushing the pebbles away from under his forehead without lifting his head."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ جَمِيعاً عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى اَلْحَصَى وَ لاَ يُمَكِّنُ جَبْهَتَهُ مِنَ اَلْأَرْضِ قَالَ« يُحَرِّكُ جَبْهَتَهُ حَتَّى يَتَمَكَّنَ فَيُنَحِّي اَلْحَصَى عَنْ جَبْهَتِهِ وَ لاَ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad from Musa ibn Al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah together from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who prostrates upon pebbles but does not firmly place his forehead upon the ground. Imam (a.s) said: "He should move his forehead until he becomes firmly settled, pushing the pebbles away from under his forehead without lifting his head."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 337

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Al-Nahdi from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about prostrating upon elevated ground. Imam (a.s) said: "If the place of your forehead is elevated above the place of your body by the height of a brick, then there is no harm."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلنَّهْدِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلسُّجُودِ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ اَلْمُرْتَفِعَةِ فَقَالَ« إِذَا كَانَ مَوْضِعُ جَبْهَتِكَ مُرْتَفِعاً عَنْ مَوْضِعِ بَدَنِكَ قَدْرَ لَبِنَةٍ فَلاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Al-Nahdi from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about prostrating upon elevated ground. Imam (a.s) said: "If the place of your forehead is elevated above the place of your body by the height of a brick, then there is no harm."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 337

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man, is it permissible for him to raise his voice in the tashahhud, and in what is said during bowing, prostration, and qunoot? Imam (a.s) said: "If he wishes, he may raise his voice, and if he wishes, he may not raise it."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ لَهُ أَنْ يَجْهَرَ بِالتَّشَهُّدِ وَ اَلْقَوْلِ فِي اَلرُّكُوعِ وَ اَلسُّجُودِ وَ اَلْقُنُوتِ قَالَ« إِنْ شَاءَ جَهَرَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ لَمْ يَجْهَرْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man, is it permissible for him to raise his voice in the tashahhud, and in what is said during bowing, prostration, and qunoot? Imam (a.s) said: "If he wishes, he may raise his voice, and if he wishes, he may not raise it."
