chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Yusuf ibn Al-Harith from Abdullah ibn Yazid Al-Minqari from Musa ibn Ayyub Al-Ghafiqi from his uncle Iyas ibn Amir Al-Ghafiqi from Uqbah ibn Amir Al-Juhani, who said:
When the verse "So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great" (Surah Waqi'ah 56:96) was revealed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said to us (companions): "Place it in your bowing." Then when the verse "Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High" (Surah A'la 87:1) was revealed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said to us (companions): "Place it in your prostration."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ اَلْحَارِثِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اَلْمِنْقَرِيِّ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَيُّوبَ اَلْغَافِقِيِّ عَنْ عَمِّهِ إِيَاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ اَلْغَافِقِيِّ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ اَلْجُهَنِيِّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ« فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ اَلْعَظِيمِ» قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ« اِجْعَلُوهَا فِي رُكُوعِكُمْ» فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ« سَبِّحِ اِسْمَ رَبِّكَ اَلْأَعْلَى» قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «اِجْعَلُوهَا فِي سُجُودِكُمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Yusuf ibn Al-Harith from Abdullah ibn Yazid Al-Minqari from Musa ibn Ayyub Al-Ghafiqi from his uncle Iyas ibn Amir Al-Ghafiqi from Uqbah ibn Amir Al-Juhani, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: When the verse "So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great" (Surah Waqi'ah 56:96) was revealed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said to us (companions): "Place it in your bowing." Then when the verse "Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High" (Surah A'la 87:1) was revealed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said to us (companions): "Place it in your prostration."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 337

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Sayrafi from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
I heard Imam (a.s) say: "Prostration is upon what the earth has produced, except for what is eaten or worn."
arabicText: عنه عن العباس بن معروف عن محمد بن يحيى الصيرفي عن حماد بن عثمان عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام قال :سمعته يقول: السجود على ما انبتت الارض إلا ما أكل أو لبس
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Sayrafi from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Imam (a.s) say: "Prostration is upon what the earth has produced, except for what is eaten or worn."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 338

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Hassan from Abu Muhammad Al-Razi from Al-Nawfali from Al-Sakuni from Abu Abdillah (a.s) said:
(Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: "Indeed, I dislike that I see a man whose forehead is bare and has no trace of prostration upon it."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ اَلرَّازِيِّ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ لِي عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِنِّي لَأَكْرَهُ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ أَرَى جَبْهَتَهُ جَلْحَاءَ لَيْسَ فِيهَا أَثَرُ اَلسُّجُودِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Hassan from Abu Muhammad Al-Razi from Al-Nawfali from Al-Sakuni from Abu Abdillah (a.s) said:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said to me: "Indeed, I dislike that I see a man whose forehead is bare and has no trace of prostration upon it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 338

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a woman whose forelock grows long, so when she prostrates, part of her forehead touches the ground while part of it is covered by her hair, is that permissible? Imam (a.s) said: "No, until she places her forehead fully upon the ground."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَرْأَةِ تَطُولُ قُصَّتُهَا فَإِذَا سَجَدَتْ وَقَعَ بَعْضُ جَبْهَتِهَا عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ وَ بَعْضٌ يُغَطِّيهِ اَلشَّعْرُ هَلْ يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ« لاَ حَتَّى تَضَعَ جَبْهَتَهَا عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a woman whose forelock grows long, so when she prostrates, part of her forehead touches the ground while part of it is covered by her hair, is that permissible? Imam (a.s) said: "No, until she places her forehead fully upon the ground."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 338

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Ali ibn Al-Hazawwar from Al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah, who said:
When the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, would raise his head from prostration, He (a.s) would sit until He (a.s) became calm, then He (a.s) would stand. So it was said to Imam (a.s): “O Commander of the Faithful (a.s), Abu Bakr and Umar before you, when they raised their heads from prostration, they would rise on the balls of their feet as camels rise. Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib (a.s)), peace be upon him, said: "Indeed, only the coarse people (Ahl al-Jafa) do that; rather, this calmness is part of showing reverence for the prayer." (‘coarse people - Ahl al-Jafa)’; harsh, rough, or lacking refinement in behavior and indifferent to the deeper etiquettes of worship)
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَزَوَّرِ عَنِ اَلْأَصْبَغِ بْنِ نُبَاتَةَ قَالَ: كَانَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ اَلسُّجُودِ قَعَدَ حَتَّى يَطْمَئِنَّ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَقِيلَ لَهُ يَا أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ كَانَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَ عُمَرُ إِذَا رَفَعُوا رُءُوسَهُمْ عَنِ اَلسُّجُودِ نَهَضُوا عَلَى صُدُورِ أَقْدَامِهِمْ كَمَا تَنْهَضُ اَلْإِبِلُ فَقَالَ أَمِيرُ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« إِنَّمَا يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ أَهْلُ اَلْجَفَاءِ مِنَ اَلنَّاسِ إِنَّ هَذَا مِنْ تَوْقِيرِ اَلصَّلاَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Ali ibn Al-Hazawwar from Al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: When the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, would raise his head from prostration, He (a.s) would sit until He (a.s) became calm, then He (a.s) would stand. So it was said to Imam (a.s): “O Commander of the Faithful (a.s), Abu Bakr and Umar before you, when they raised their heads from prostration, they would rise on the balls of their feet as camels rise. Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib (a.s)), peace be upon him, said: "Indeed, only the coarse people (Ahl al-Jafa) do that; rather, this calmness is part of showing reverence for the prayer." (‘coarse people - Ahl al-Jafa)’; harsh, rough, or lacking refinement in behavior and indifferent to the deeper etiquettes of worship)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 338

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Ibn Bukayr from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about mentioning a chapter from the Book (the Qur'an) and supplicating with it in prayer, like ‘Surah Al-Ikhlas’. Imam (a.s) said: "If you are supplicating with it, then there is no harm."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ اَلسُّورَةِ مِنَ اَلْكِتَابِ يَدْعُو بِهَا فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ مِثْلِ« قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» فَقَالَ« إِذَا كُنْتَ تَدْعُو بِهَا فَلاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Ibn Bukayr from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about mentioning a chapter from the Book (the Qur'an) and supplicating with it in prayer, like ‘Surah Al-Ikhlas’. Imam (a.s) said: "If you are supplicating with it, then there is no harm."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 338

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr from Yahya Al-Halabi from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Basir, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “I send blessings upon the Prophet, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, while I am in prostration, is that permissible?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, it is like saying SubhanAllah and Allahu Akbar."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ يَحْيَى اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَنَا سَاجِدٌ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ هُوَ مِثْلُ سُبْحَانَ اَللَّهِ وَ اَللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr from Yahya Al-Halabi from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “I send blessings upon the Prophet, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, while I am in prostration, is that permissible?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, it is like saying SubhanAllah and Allahu Akbar."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 339

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Rayan from Al-Husayn ibn Rashid from some of his companions from Misma' from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
The Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib (a.s)), peace be upon him: "The Prophet, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, forbade a man from closing his eyes during the prayer."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلرَّيَّانِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ مِسْمَعٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَمِيرِ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ نَهَى أَنْ يُغَمِّضَ اَلرَّجُلُ عَيْنَيْهِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Rayan from Al-Husayn ibn Rashid from some of his companions from Misma' from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: The Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib (a.s)), peace be upon him: "The Prophet, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, forbade a man from closing his eyes during the prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 339

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban from Isma'il ibn Al-Fadl, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about the qunoot and what should be said in it. Imam (a.s) said: "Whatever Allah (swt) causes to flow from your tongue, and I do not know of anything specifically fixed for it."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ اَلْفَضْلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْقُنُوتِ وَ مَا يُقَالُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ« مَا قَضَى اَللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِكَ وَ لاَ أَعْلَمُ فِيهِ شَيْئاً مُوَقَّتاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban from Isma'il ibn Al-Fadl, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about the qunoot and what should be said in it. Imam (a.s) said: "Whatever Allah (swt) causes to flow from your tongue, and I do not know of anything specifically fixed for it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 339

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about the minimum of the qunoot. Imam (a.s) said: "Five tasbihat (saying SubhanAllah five times)."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَدْنَى اَلْقُنُوتِ فَقَالَ« خَمْسُ تَسْبِيحَاتٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about the minimum of the qunoot. Imam (a.s) said: "Five tasbihat (saying SubhanAllah five times)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 339

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “A man forgets the qunoot while on his way (after the prayer).” Imam (a.s) said: "He should face the qiblah and then say it." Then Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed, I dislike for a man to turn away from the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, or to abandon it (Qunoot)."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ نَسِيَ اَلْقُنُوتَ وَ هُوَ فِي بَعْضِ اَلطَّرِيقِ فَقَالَ« يَسْتَقْبِلُ اَلْقِبْلَةَ ثُمَّ لْيَقُلْهُ» ثُمَّ قَالَ« إِنِّي لَأَكْرَهُ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يَرْغَبَ عَنْ سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَوْ يَدَعَهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “A man forgets the qunoot while on his way (after the prayer).” Imam (a.s) said: "He should face the qiblah and then say it." Then Imam (a.s) said: "Indeed, I dislike for a man to turn away from the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, or to abandon it (Qunoot)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 339

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Husayn ibn Ali Al-Kufi from Abu Dawud Sulayman ibn Sufyan from Amr ibn Hurayth, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), said to me: "Say in the first two rak‘ahs, after the tashahhud and before you rise, Subhan Allah (swt), Subhan Allah (swt) seven times."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْكُوفِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي دَاوُدَ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« قُلْ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ اَلتَّشَهُّدِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْهَضَ سُبْحَانَ اَللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ اَللَّهِ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Husayn ibn Ali Al-Kufi from Abu Dawud Sulayman ibn Sufyan from Amr ibn Hurayth, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), said to me: "Say in the first two rak‘ahs, after the tashahhud and before you rise, Subhan Allah (swt), Subhan Allah (swt) seven times."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 339

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "If a man forgets the qunoot in any part of the prayer until he bows, his prayer is still valid and there is nothing upon him, but it is not permissible for him to deliberately abandon it."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِنْ نَسِيَ اَلرَّجُلُ اَلْقُنُوتَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ فَقَدْ جَازَتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ وَ لَيْسَ لَهُ أَنْ يَدَعَهُ مُتَعَمِّداً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "If a man forgets the qunoot in any part of the prayer until he bows, his prayer is still valid and there is nothing upon him, but it is not permissible for him to deliberately abandon it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 340

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Sulayman, who said:
I wrote to the Al Faqih (Jurist), peace be upon him, asking Imam (a.s) about the qunoot. He (a.s) wrote back to me: "If there is a severe necessity, then do not raise your hands, and say three times: ‘Bismillah Hir Rahman Nir Rahim.’"
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى اَلْفَقِيهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلْقُنُوتِ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ« إِذَا كَانَتْ ضَرُورَةٌ شَدِيدَةٌ فَلاَ تَرْفَعِ اَلْيَدَيْنِ وَ قُلْ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ« بِسْمِ اَللّٰهِ اَلرَّحْمٰنِ اَلرَّحِيمِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Sulayman, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I wrote to the Al Faqih (Jurist), peace be upon him, asking Imam (a.s) about the qunoot. He (a.s) wrote back to me: "If there is a severe necessity, then do not raise your hands, and say three times: ‘Bismillah Hir Rahman Nir Rahim.’"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 340

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid Al-Khazzaz from Aban ibn Uthman from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Abdillah:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) (was asked) regarding a man who joins the last rak'ah of the Fajr prayer with the imam (of prayer), and the imam performs qunoot, should he perform qunoot with him? Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, and it suffices him for the qunoot for himself."
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْوَلِيدِ اَلْخَزَّازِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَدْخُلُ فِي اَلرَّكْعَةِ اَلْأَخِيرَةِ مِنَ اَلْغَدَاةِ مَعَ اَلْإِمَامِ فَيَقْنُتُ اَلْإِمَامُ أَ يَقْنُتُ مَعَهُ قَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ يُجْزِيهِ مِنَ اَلْقُنُوتِ لِنَفْسِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid Al-Khazzaz from Aban ibn Uthman from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Abdillah:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) (was asked) regarding a man who joins the last rak'ah of the Fajr prayer with the imam (of prayer), and the imam performs qunoot, should he perform qunoot with him? Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, and it suffices him for the qunoot for himself."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 340

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Ali ibn Asbat from Al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Ammar Al-Sabati, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “I fear to perform qunoot while there are opponents (non-followers) behind me”. Imam (a.s) said: "Raising your hands suffices," meaning raising them as if you are bowing.
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ عَنِ اَلْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَخَافُ أَنْ أَقْنُتَ وَ خَلْفِي مُخَالِفُونَ فَقَالَ« رَفْعُكَ يَدَيْكَ يُجْزِي» يَعْنِي رَفْعَهُمَا كَأَنَّكَ تَرْكَعُ
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Ali ibn Asbat from Al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Ammar Al-Sabati, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “I fear to perform qunoot while there are opponents (non-followers) behind me”. Imam (a.s) said: "Raising your hands suffices," meaning raising them as if you are bowing.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 340

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Abdullah ibn Bukayr:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "The tashahhud in the supererogatory prayer is part of the tashahhud of the obligatory prayer."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلتَّشَهُّدُ فِي اَلنَّافِلَةِ بَعْضُ تَشَهُّدِ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Abdullah ibn Bukayr:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "The tashahhud in the supererogatory prayer is part of the tashahhud of the obligatory prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 340

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: From him, from Ibn Abi Nasr from Tha'labah ibn Maymun from Muyassar: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "Two things by which people corrupt their prayer are: a man saying ‘Tabarakasmuka wa ta'ala jadduka wa la ilaha ghayruka’ (Blessed is Your (azj) Name, exalted is Your (azj) Majesty, and there is no god besides You (azj)), And this is something the jinn said out of ignorance, and Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, related it from them, and a man saying ‘As-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillah as-salihin’ (Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah (swt))."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ مُيَسِّرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« شَيْئَانِ يُفْسِدُ اَلنَّاسُ بِهِمَا صَلاَتَهُمْ قَوْلُ اَلرَّجُلِ تَبَارَكَ اِسْمُكَ وَ تَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَ لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ وَ إِنَّمَا هُوَ شَيْءٌ قَالَتْهُ اَلْجِنُّ بِجَهَالَةٍ فَحَكَى اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَنْهُمْ وَ قَوْلُ اَلرَّجُلِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلَى عِبَادِ اَللَّهِ اَلصَّالِحِينَ»
thaqalaynMatn: From him, from Ibn Abi Nasr from Tha'labah ibn Maymun from Muyassar: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "Two things by which people corrupt their prayer are: a man saying ‘Tabarakasmuka wa ta'ala jadduka wa la ilaha ghayruka’ (Blessed is Your (azj) Name, exalted is Your (azj) Majesty, and there is no god besides You (azj)), And this is something the jinn said out of ignorance, and Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, related it from them, and a man saying ‘As-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillah as-salihin’ (Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah (swt))."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 340

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub by Al-Abbas by Abu Shu'ayb by Abu Jamilah by Abdurrahman ibn Abdullah:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “What is the meaning of a man's saying At-tahiyyatu lillah (greetings are for Allah (swt))?” Imam (a.s) said: "It means sovereignty belongs to Allah (swt)."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ أَبِي شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ مَا مَعْنَى قَوْلِ اَلرَّجُلِ اَلتَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ قَالَ« اَلْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub by Al-Abbas by Abu Shu'ayb by Abu Jamilah by Abdurrahman ibn Abdullah:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s): “What is the meaning of a man's saying At-tahiyyatu lillah (greetings are for Allah (swt))?” Imam (a.s) said: "It means sovereignty belongs to Allah (swt)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 341

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Ali ibn Ya'qub Al-Hashimi from Marwan ibn Muslim from Abu Kahmas from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the first two rak'ahs, when I sit for the tashahhud and while sitting I say, ‘Peace be upon you, O Prophet (saws), and the mercy of Allah (swt) and His blessings’, is that considered the dismissal (end of prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: "No, but when you say, ‘Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah (swt)’, that is the dismissal (end of prayer)."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ اَلْهَاشِمِيِّ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي كَهْمَسٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ إِذَا جَلَسْتُ فِيهِمَا لِلتَّشَهُّدِ فَقُلْتُ وَ أَنَا جَالِسٌ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا اَلنَّبِيُّ وَ رَحْمَةُ اَللَّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ اِنْصِرَافاً هُوَ قَالَ« لاَ وَ لَكِنْ إِذَا قُلْتَ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلَى عِبَادِ اَللَّهِ اَلصَّالِحِينَ فَهُوَ اَلاِنْصِرَافُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Ali ibn Ya'qub Al-Hashimi from Marwan ibn Muslim from Abu Kahmas from Abu Abdillah (a.s), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the first two rak'ahs, when I sit for the tashahhud and while sitting I say, ‘Peace be upon you, O Prophet (saws), and the mercy of Allah (swt) and His blessings’, is that considered the dismissal (end of prayer)?” Imam (a.s) said: "No, but when you say, ‘Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah (swt)’, that is the dismissal (end of prayer)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 341

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Al-Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "Everything by which you mention Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, and the Prophet (saws), is part of the prayer, and if you say ‘Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah (swt)’, then you have concluded (the prayer)."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: «كُلُّمَا ذَكَرْتَ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِهِ وَ اَلنَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَهُوَ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ إِنْ قُلْتَ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلَى عِبَادِ اَللَّهِ اَلصَّالِحِينَ فَقَدِ اِنْصَرَفْتَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Al-Halabi, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "Everything by which you mention Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, and the Prophet (saws), is part of the prayer, and if you say ‘Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah (swt)’, then you have concluded (the prayer)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 341

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "When you conclude the prayer, then turn to your right side."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا اِنْصَرَفْتَ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَانْصَرِفْ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "When you conclude the prayer, then turn to your right side."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 341

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Muhammad from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Sulayman ibn Dawud from Al-Nu'man ibn Abd Al-Salam from Abu Hanifah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about crying during prayer, does it invalidate the prayer? Imam (a.s) said: "If he cries due to the remembrance of Paradise or Hellfire, then that is the best of deeds in prayer, but if he cries because of remembering a deceased person of his, then his prayer is invalid."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ عَنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلسَّلاَمِ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْبُكَاءِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ أَ يَقْطَعُ اَلصَّلاَةَ قَالَ« إِنْ بَكَى لِذِكْرِ جَنَّةٍ أَوْ نَارٍ فَذَلِكَ هُوَ أَفْضَلُ اَلْأَعْمَالِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ ذَكَرَ مَيِّتاً لَهُ فَصَلاَتُهُ فَاسِدَةٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Muhammad from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Sulayman ibn Dawud from Al-Nu'man ibn Abd Al-Salam from Abu Hanifah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about crying during prayer, does it invalidate the prayer? Imam (a.s) said: "If he cries due to the remembrance of Paradise or Hellfire, then that is the best of deeds in prayer, but if he cries because of remembering a deceased person of his, then his prayer is invalid."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 341

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa Al-Sabati, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about the taslim, what is it? Imam (a.s) said: "It is permission (to end the prayer)."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلتَّسْلِيمِ مَا هُوَ فَقَالَ« هُوَ إِذْنٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa Al-Sabati, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), about the taslim, what is it? Imam (a.s) said: "It is permission (to end the prayer)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 341

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
I saw my brothers (Imam) Musa (a.s), Ishaq, and Muhammad, the sons of Ja'far, peace be upon him, giving taslim (salutation) in prayer to the right and to the left, saying: "Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah (swt), peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah (swt)."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ إِخْوَتِي مُوسَى وَ إِسْحَاقَ وَ مُحَمَّداً بَنِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يُسَلِّمُونَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ عَنِ اَلْيَمِينِ وَ اَلشِّمَالِ« اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ رَحْمَةُ اَللَّهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ رَحْمَةُ اَللَّهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I saw my brothers (Imam) Musa (a.s), Ishaq, and Muhammad, the sons of Ja'far, peace be upon him, giving taslim (salutation) in prayer to the right and to the left, saying: "Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah (swt), peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah (swt)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 342

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Al-Fudayl, Zurarah, and Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "When a man completes the two testimonies (shahadatayn), his prayer is complete. So if he is in a hurry for something he fears may be missed, and he says the taslim and departs, it suffices him."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ اِبْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ وَ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا فَرَغَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ اَلشَّهَادَتَيْنِ فَقَدْ مَضَتْ صَلاَتُهُ فَإِنْ كَانَ مُسْتَعْجِلاً فِي أَمْرٍ يَخَافُ أَنْ يَفُوتَهُ فَسَلَّمَ وَ اِنْصَرَفَ أَجْزَأَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Al-Fudayl, Zurarah, and Muhammad ibn Muslim:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "When a man completes the two testimonies (shahadatayn), his prayer is complete. So if he is in a hurry for something he fears may be missed, and he says the taslim and departs, it suffices him."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 342

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) (was asked) regarding a man who is behind the imam (of prayer) and the imam (of prayer) prolongs the tashahhud. Imam (a.s) said: "Those behind him may say the taslim and proceed to their needs if they wish."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ خَلْفَ اَلْإِمَامِ فَيُطِيلُ اَلْإِمَامُ اَلتَّشَهُّدَ قَالَ« يُسَلِّمُ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ وَ يَمْضِي فِي حَاجَتِهِ إِنْ أَحَبَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) (was asked) regarding a man who is behind the imam (of prayer) and the imam (of prayer) prolongs the tashahhud. Imam (a.s) said: "Those behind him may say the taslim and proceed to their needs if they wish."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 342

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from Zurarah who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man experiences a hadath (minor ritual impurity) after he raises his head from the final prostration.” Imam (a.s) said: "His prayer is complete, and indeed the tashahhud is a sunnah within the prayer, so he should perform ablution and sit in his place or in a clean place and then recite the tashahhud."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلرَّجُلُ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَمَا يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ اَلسُّجُودِ اَلْأَخِيرِ فَقَالَ« تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنَّمَا اَلتَّشَهُّدُ سُنَّةٌ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَيَتَوَضَّأُ وَ يَجْلِسُ مَكَانَهُ أَوْ مَكَاناً نَظِيفاً فَيَتَشَهَّدُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from Zurarah who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “A man experiences a hadath (minor ritual impurity) after he raises his head from the final prostration.” Imam (a.s) said: "His prayer is complete, and indeed the tashahhud is a sunnah within the prayer, so he should perform ablution and sit in his place or in a clean place and then recite the tashahhud."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 342

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd from Abu Ja'far from his father from Muhammad ibn Isa and Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who experiences a hadath after he raises his head from the final prostration and before he recites the tashahhud. Imam (a.s) said: "He should leave, perform ablution, and if he wishes, he may return to the mosque, and if he wishes, then in his house, and if he wishes, wherever he wishes, he may sit and recite the tashahhud and then offer the taslim. And if the hadath occurs after the two testimonies, then his prayer has been completed."
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى وَ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فِي اَلسَّجْدَةِ اَلْأَخِيرَةِ وَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَشَهَّدَ قَالَ« يَنْصَرِفُ فَيَتَوَضَّأُ فَإِنْ شَاءَ رَجَعَ إِلَى اَلْمَسْجِدِ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ فَفِي بَيْتِهِ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ حَيْثُ شَاءَ قَعَدَ فَتَشَهَّدَ ثُمَّ يُسَلِّمُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ اَلْحَدَثُ بَعْدَ اَلشَّهَادَتَيْنِ فَقَدْ مَضَتْ صَلاَتُهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd from Abu Ja'far from his father from Muhammad ibn Isa and Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who experiences a hadath after he raises his head from the final prostration and before he recites the tashahhud. Imam (a.s) said: "He should leave, perform ablution, and if he wishes, he may return to the mosque, and if he wishes, then in his house, and if he wishes, wherever he wishes, he may sit and recite the tashahhud and then offer the taslim. And if the hadath occurs after the two testimonies, then his prayer has been completed."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 342

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd ibn Abdullah from Musa ibn Al-Hasan from Al-Sindi ibn Muhammad from Al-Ala' ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is overtaken by nosebleed or vomiting during the prayer; what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: "He should leave, wash his nose, and return to the prayer, and if he speaks, then he must repeat the prayer."
arabicText: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنِ اَلسِّنْدِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَأْخُذُهُ اَلرُّعَافُ أَوِ اَلْقَيْءُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ« يَنْفَتِلُ فَيَغْسِلُ أَنْفَهُ وَ يَعُودُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَإِنْ تَكَلَّمَ فَلْيُعِدِ اَلصَّلاَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd ibn Abdullah from Musa ibn Al-Hasan from Al-Sindi ibn Muhammad from Al-Ala' ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is overtaken by nosebleed or vomiting during the prayer; what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: "He should leave, wash his nose, and return to the prayer, and if he speaks, then he must repeat the prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 343

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Khalid from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa Al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If a man forgets the tashahhud in the prayer and remembers that he only said 'In the name of Allah (swt),' then his prayer is valid. But if he does not remember anything from the tashahhud, he must repeat the prayer."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِنْ نَسِيَ اَلرَّجُلُ اَلتَّشَهُّدَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ بِسْمِ اَللَّهِ فَقَطْ فَقَدْ جَازَتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ شَيْئاً مِنَ اَلتَّشَهُّدِ أَعَادَ اَلصَّلاَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Khalid from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa Al-Sabati:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If a man forgets the tashahhud in the prayer and remembers that he only said 'In the name of Allah (swt),' then his prayer is valid. But if he does not remember anything from the tashahhud, he must repeat the prayer."

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Ghalib ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who performs the obligatory prayer, and his prayer concludes and he recites the tashahhud, then he falls asleep before offering the taslim. Imam (a.s) said: "His prayer is complete, and if it was a nosebleed, he should wash it and then return and offer the taslim."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْكُوفِيِّ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ غَالِبِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي اَلْمَكْتُوبَةَ فَتَنْقَضِي صَلاَتُهُ وَ يَتَشَهَّدُ ثُمَّ يَنَامُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ قَالَ« قَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ رُعَافاً غَسَلَهُ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَسَلَّمَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Ghalib ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who performs the obligatory prayer, and his prayer concludes and he recites the tashahhud, then he falls asleep before offering the taslim. Imam (a.s) said: "His prayer is complete, and if it was a nosebleed, he should wash it and then return and offer the taslim."

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Sa'd ibn Bakr from Habib Al-Khath'ami from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam (a.s) say: “When a man sits for the tashahhud and praises Allah (swt), it suffices him.”
arabicText: أحمد بن محمد عن ابن أبي عمير عن سعد بن بكر عن حبيب الخثعمي عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام قال سمعته يقول إذا جلس الرجل للتشهد فحمد الله أجزأه
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Sa'd ibn Bakr from Habib Al-Khath'ami from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Imam (a.s) say: “When a man sits for the tashahhud and praises Allah (swt), it suffices him.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 344

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban ibn Uthman from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is praying, then sits and experiences a hadath before offering the taslim. Imam (a.s) said: "His prayer is complete, and if he is praying with an imam (of prayer) and he feels discomfort in his stomach and offers the taslim to himself and stands up, then his prayer is complete."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فَيُحْدِثُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلِّمَ قَالَ« قَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَعَ إِمَامٍ فَوَجَدَ فِي بَطْنِهِ أَذًى فَسَلَّمَ فِي نَفْسِهِ وَ قَامَ فَقَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban ibn Uthman from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is praying, then sits and experiences a hadath before offering the taslim. Imam (a.s) said: "His prayer is complete, and if he is praying with an imam (of prayer) and he feels discomfort in his stomach and offers the taslim to himself and stands up, then his prayer is complete."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 344

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah from Abu Basir who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say regarding a man who prayed the morning prayer, and when he sat in the two units before reciting the tashahhud, he experienced a nosebleed. Imam (a.s) said: "He should leave, wash his nose, then return and complete his prayer, for the end of the prayer is the taslim."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: فِي رَجُلٍ صَلَّى اَلصُّبْحَ فَلَمَّا جَلَسَ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَشَهَّدَ رَعَفَ قَالَ« فَلْيَخْرُجْ فَلْيَغْسِلْ أَنْفَهُ ثُمَّ لْيَرْجِعْ فَلْيُتِمَّ صَلاَتَهُ فَإِنَّ آخِرَ اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلتَّسْلِيمُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah from Abu Basir who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say regarding a man who prayed the morning prayer, and when he sat in the two units before reciting the tashahhud, he experienced a nosebleed. Imam (a.s) said: "He should leave, wash his nose, then return and complete his prayer, for the end of the prayer is the taslim."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 344

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Abbas from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Abu Dawud Al-Mustariq from Hisham who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I go out for a need, and I like to be among those who perform ta'qib (post-prayer supplication).” Imam (a.s) said: "If you are in a state of ablution, then you are among those who perform ta'qib."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَبِي دَاوُدَ اَلْمُسْتَرِقِّ عَنْ هِشَامٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنِّي أَخْرُجُ فِي اَلْحَاجَةِ وَ أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَكُونَ مُعَقِّباً فَقَالَ« إِنْ كُنْتَ عَلَى وُضُوءٍ فَأَنْتَ مُعَقِّبٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Abbas from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Abu Dawud Al-Mustariq from Hisham who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I go out for a need, and I like to be among those who perform ta'qib (post-prayer supplication).” Imam (a.s) said: "If you are in a state of ablution, then you are among those who perform ta'qib."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 345

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Musa ibn Umar from Mu'ammar ibn Khallad who said:
Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, sent for me regarding a need, so I entered upon Imam (a.s). Imam (a.s) said: "Leave, and when tomorrow comes, then come, but do not come except after the sun has risen, for I sleep after I have prayed the Fajr prayer."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ مُعَمَّرِ بْنِ خَلاَّدٍ قَالَ: أَرْسَلَ إِلَيَّ أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي حَاجَةٍ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ« اِنْصَرِفْ فَإِذَا كَانَ غَداً فَتَعَالَ وَلاَ تَجِئْ إِلاَّ بَعْدَ طُلُوعِ اَلشَّمْسِ فَإِنِّي أَنَامُ إِذَا صَلَّيْتُ اَلْفَجْرَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Musa ibn Umar from Mu'ammar ibn Khallad who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, sent for me regarding a need, so I entered upon Imam (a.s). Imam (a.s) said: "Leave, and when tomorrow comes, then come, but do not come except after the sun has risen, for I sleep after I have prayed the Fajr prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 345

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Al-Sakuni from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s):
(Imam) Al-Hasan ibn Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Whoever prays and sits in his prayer place until the rising of the sun, there will be for him a covering from the Fire."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« مَنْ صَلَّى فَجَلَسَ فِي مُصَلاَّهُ إِلَى طُلُوعِ اَلشَّمْسِ كَانَ لَهُ سِتْراً مِنَ اَلنَّارِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Al-Sakuni from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his father (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam) Al-Hasan ibn Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Whoever prays and sits in his prayer place until the rising of the sun, there will be for him a covering from the Fire."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 345

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim from Salim ibn Abi Khadijah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
A man asked Imam (a.s) while I was listening, and said: “I pray the Fajr prayer, then I engage in the remembrance of Allah (swt) with all that I wish to remember of what is obligatory upon me, then I desire to lay down my side and sleep before the rising of the sun, but I dislike that.” Imam (a.s) said: "And why?" (the man) said: “I dislike that the sun should rise from other than its usual place.” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no ambiguity in that. Look from where the Fajr rises, for from there the sun rises, and there is no harm upon you to sleep if you have already engaged in the remembrance of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي هَاشِمٍ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي خَدِيجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ وَ أَنَا أَسْمَعُ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أُصَلِّي اَلْفَجْرَ ثُمَّ أَذْكُرُ اَللَّهَ بِكُلِّ مَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَذْكُرَهُ مِمَّا يَجِبُ عَلَيَّ فَأُرِيدُ أَنْ أَضَعَ جَنْبِي فَأَنَامَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ اَلشَّمْسِ فَأَكْرَهُ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ« وَ لِمَ» قَالَ أَكْرَهُ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ اَلشَّمْسُ مِنْ غَيْرِ مَطْلَعِهَا قَالَ «لَيْسَ بِذَلِكَ خَفَاءٌ اُنْظُرْ مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ اَلْفَجْرُ فَمِنْ ثَمَّ تَطْلُعُ اَلشَّمْسُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حَرَجٍ أَنْ تَنَامَ إِذَا كُنْتَ قَدْ ذَكَرْتَ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim from Salim ibn Abi Khadijah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: A man asked Imam (a.s) while I was listening, and said: “I pray the Fajr prayer, then I engage in the remembrance of Allah (swt) with all that I wish to remember of what is obligatory upon me, then I desire to lay down my side and sleep before the rising of the sun, but I dislike that.” Imam (a.s) said: "And why?" (the man) said: “I dislike that the sun should rise from other than its usual place.” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no ambiguity in that. Look from where the Fajr rises, for from there the sun rises, and there is no harm upon you to sleep if you have already engaged in the remembrance of Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 345

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ammar ibn Marwan from Al-Munakhkhal ibn Jamil from Jabir:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: “When you turn away from an obligatory prayer, do not turn away except with a supplication for the curse upon the sons of Umayyah.”
arabicText: محمد بن علي بن محبوب عن محمد بن الحسين عن محمد ابن سنان عن عمار بن مروان عن المنخل بن جميل عن جابر عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام قال إذا انحرفت عن صلاة مكتوبة فلا تنحرف إلا بانصراف لعن بني امية
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ammar ibn Marwan from Al-Munakhkhal ibn Jamil from Jabir:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: “When you turn away from an obligatory prayer, do not turn away except with a supplication for the curse upon the sons of Umayyah.”

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 346

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Al-Husayn ibn Thuwair and Abu Salamah Al-Sarraj who said:
We heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, while Imam (a.s) was cursing after every obligatory prayer four men and four women; the Taymi, the Adawi, so-and-so, and Mu'awiyah. And Imam (a.s) would name them, and so-and-so and so-and-so and Hind and Umm Al-Hakam, the sister of Mu'awiyah.” (The Four Men: al-Taymi; Abu Bakr ibn Abi Quhafa from Banu Taym of Quraysh, al-Adawi; Umar ibn al-Khattab from the Banu ‘Adi clan, ‘so-and-so’; Uthman ibn ‘Affan & Mu‘awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan of Banu Umayyah. The Four Women: ‘so-and-so and so-and-so’; Aisha bint Abi Bakr and Hafsa bint Umar, Hind bint ‘Utbah; mother of Mu’awiyah and wife of Abu Sufyan, Umm al-Hakam bint Abi Sufyan; the sister of Mu’awiyah)
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ ثُوَيْرٍ وَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ اَلسَّرَّاجِ قَالاَ: سَمِعْنَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ هُوَ يَلْعَنُ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ مَكْتُوبَةٍ أَرْبَعَةً مِنَ اَلرِّجَالِ وَ أَرْبَعاً مِنَ اَلنِّسَاءِ اَلتَّيْمِيَّ وَ اَلْعَدَوِيَّ وَ فُعْلاَنَ وَ مُعَاوِيَةَ وَ يُسَمِّيهِمْ وَ فُلاَنَةَ وَ فُلاَنَةَ« وَ هِنْدَ وَ أُمَّ اَلْحَكَمِ أُخْتَ مُعَاوِيَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Al-Husayn ibn Thuwair and Abu Salamah Al-Sarraj who said:
thaqalaynMatn: We heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, while Imam (a.s) was cursing after every obligatory prayer four men and four women; the Taymi, the Adawi, so-and-so, and Mu'awiyah. And Imam (a.s) would name them, and so-and-so and so-and-so and Hind and Umm Al-Hakam, the sister of Mu'awiyah.” (The Four Men: al-Taymi; Abu Bakr ibn Abi Quhafa from Banu Taym of Quraysh, al-Adawi; Umar ibn al-Khattab from the Banu ‘Adi clan, ‘so-and-so’; Uthman ibn ‘Affan & Mu‘awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan of Banu Umayyah. The Four Women: ‘so-and-so and so-and-so’; Aisha bint Abi Bakr and Hafsa bint Umar, Hind bint ‘Utbah; mother of Mu’awiyah and wife of Abu Sufyan, Umm al-Hakam bint Abi Sufyan; the sister of Mu’awiyah)

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 346

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Hisham ibn Salim from Sulayman ibn Khalid who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "When the imam (of prayer) finishes the prayer, he should not perform two units of prayer in his place until he moves away from his position."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلنَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِذَا اِنْصَرَفَ اَلْإِمَامُ فَلاَ يُصَلِّي فِي مَقَامِهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ حَتَّى يَنْحَرِفَ عَنْ مَقَامِهِ ذَلِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Hisham ibn Salim from Sulayman ibn Khalid who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "When the imam (of prayer) finishes the prayer, he should not perform two units of prayer in his place until he moves away from his position."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 346

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them:
The Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib (a.s)), peace be upon him, said: "When one of you finishes the prayer, let him raise his hands toward the sky and devote himself to supplication." Ibn Saba said: “O Commander of the Faithful, is not Allah (swt) in every place?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes." He asked: “Then why does he raise his hands toward the sky?” Imam (a.s) said: "Do you not read in the Qur'an: 'And in the heaven is your sustenance and that which you are promised'? (Surah Dhariyat 51:22) So from where is sustenance sought except from its place? And the place of sustenance and what Allah (swt) has promised is the heaven."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَدِّهِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا فَرَغَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَلْيَرْفَعْ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى اَلسَّمَاءِ وَ لْيَنْصَبْ فِي اَلدُّعَاءِ» فَقَالَ اِبْنُ سَبَإٍ يَا أَمِيرَ اَلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَ لَيْسَ اَللَّهُ فِي كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَقَالَ« بَلَى» قَالَ فَلِمَ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى اَلسَّمَاءِ قَالَ« أَ مَا تَقْرَأُ فِي اَلْقُرْآنِ« وَ فِي اَلسَّمٰاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَ مٰا تُوعَدُونَ» فَمِنْ أَيْنَ يُطْلَبُ اَلرِّزْقُ إِلاَّ مِنْ مَوْضِعِهِ وَ مَوْضِعُ اَلرِّزْقِ وَ مَا وَعَدَ اَللَّهُ اَلسَّمَاءُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, from his forefathers (a.s), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: The Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib (a.s)), peace be upon him, said: "When one of you finishes the prayer, let him raise his hands toward the sky and devote himself to supplication." Ibn Saba said: “O Commander of the Faithful, is not Allah (swt) in every place?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes." He asked: “Then why does he raise his hands toward the sky?” Imam (a.s) said: "Do you not read in the Qur'an: 'And in the heaven is your sustenance and that which you are promised'? (Surah Dhariyat 51:22) So from where is sustenance sought except from its place? And the place of sustenance and what Allah (swt) has promised is the heaven."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 346

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to place the spear in front of him when he prayed."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« كَانَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَجْعَلُ اَلْعَنَزَةَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ إِذَا صَلَّى»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to place the spear in front of him when he prayed."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 346

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "The length of the saddle of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, was one cubit, and when He (saws) prayed, He (saws) would place it in front of Him and shield himself with it from those who would pass in front of Him (saws)."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ:« كَانَ طُولُ رَحْلِ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ذِرَاعاً وَ كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى وَضَعَهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَسْتَتِرُ بِهِ مِمَّنْ يَمُرُّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "The length of the saddle of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, was one cubit, and when He (saws) prayed, He (saws) would place it in front of Him and shield himself with it from those who would pass in front of Him (saws)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 347

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Ibn Muskan from Ibn Abi Ya'fur who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man, does anything that passes in front of him break his prayer? Imam (a.s) said: "Nothing breaks the prayer of a Muslim, but repel as much as you are able."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَقْطَعُ صَلاَتَهُ شَيْءٌ مِمَّا يَمُرُّ بِهِ فَقَالَ« لاَ يَقْطَعُ صَلاَةَ اَلْمُسْلِمِ شَيْءٌ وَ لَكِنِ اِدْرَءُوا مَا اِسْتَطَعْتُمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Ibn Muskan from Ibn Abi Ya'fur who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man, does anything that passes in front of him break his prayer? Imam (a.s) said: "Nothing breaks the prayer of a Muslim, but repel as much as you are able."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 347

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Nothing breaks the prayer, neither a dog, nor a donkey, nor a woman, but seek to shield yourselves with something. If there is in front of you the measure of a cubit raised from the ground, then you have shielded yourself."
arabicText: وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ يَقْطَعُ اَلصَّلاَةَ شَيْءٌ كَلْبٌ وَ لاَ حِمَارٌ وَ لاَ اِمْرَأَةٌ وَ لَكِنِ اِسْتَتِرُوا بِشَيْءٍ فَإِنْ كَانَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ قَدْرَ ذِرَاعٍ رَافِعٌ مِنَ اَلْأَرْضِ فَقَدِ اِسْتَتَرْتَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Nothing breaks the prayer, neither a dog, nor a donkey, nor a woman, but seek to shield yourselves with something. If there is in front of you the measure of a cubit raised from the ground, then you have shielded yourself."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 347

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Ghiyath: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "The Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, placed a cap (qalansuwah) and prayed facing it."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ غِيَاثٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« أَنَّ اَلنَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَضَعَ قَلَنْسُوَةً وَ صَلَّى إِلَيْهَا»
thaqalaynMatn: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Ghiyath: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "The Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, placed a cap (qalansuwah) and prayed facing it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 347

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Amr ibn Khalid from Sufyan ibn Khalid from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
Imam (a.s) was praying one day when a man passed in front of him while his son (Imam) Musa (a.s), peace be upon him, was sitting. When (Imam al-Sadiq (a.s)) finished, his son (Imam al-Kadhim (a.s)) said: "O my father, did you not see the man who passed in front of you?" Imam (a.s) said: "O my son, the One (azj) for whom I was praying is closer to me than the one who passed in front of me."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُصَلِّي ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ إِذْ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ قُدَّامَهُ وَ اِبْنُهُ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جَالِسٌ فَلَمَّا اِنْصَرَفَ قَالَ لَهُ اِبْنُهُ «يَا أَبَتِ مَا رَأَيْتَ اَلرَّجُلَ مَرَّ قُدَّامَكَ» فَقَالَ« يَا بُنَيَّ إِنَّ اَلَّذِي أُصَلِّي لَهُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيَّ مِنَ اَلَّذِي مَرَّ قُدَّامِي»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Amr ibn Khalid from Sufyan ibn Khalid from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was praying one day when a man passed in front of him while his son (Imam) Musa (a.s), peace be upon him, was sitting. When (Imam al-Sadiq (a.s)) finished, his son (Imam al-Kadhim (a.s)) said: "O my father, did you not see the man who passed in front of you?" Imam (a.s) said: "O my son, the One (azj) for whom I was praying is closer to me than the one who passed in front of me."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 347

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man, does anything that passes in front of him cut off his prayer? Imam (a.s) said: "Nothing cuts the prayer of a Muslim, but repel as much as you are able." He (al Halabi) said: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who experiences a nosebleed and the bleeding does not stop until the time of prayer enters.” Imam (a.s) said: "He should stuff his nose with something and then pray, and he should not prolong the prayer if he fears that the blood will precede him." He (al Halabi) said: “And Imam (a.s) said: ‘If you turn away during an obligatory prayer without completing it, then repeat the prayer if the turning was excessive; but if you have already recited the tashahhud, then do not repeat.’"
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ أَ يَقْطَعُ صَلاَتَهُ شَيْءٌ مِمَّا يَمُرُّ بِهِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ« لاَ يَقْطَعُ صَلاَةَ اَلْمُسْلِمِ شَيْءٌ وَ لَكِنِ اِدْرَأْ مَا اِسْتَطَعْتَ» قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ رَعَفَ وَ لَمْ يَرْقَ رُعَافُهُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ وَقْتُ اَلصَّلاَةِ قَالَ« يَحْشُو أَنْفَهُ بِشَيْءٍ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي وَ لاَ يُطِيلُ إِنْ خَشِيَ أَنْ يَسْبِقَهُ اَلدَّمُ» قَالَ وَ قَالَ« إِذَا اِلْتَفَتَّ فِي صَلاَةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ مِنْ غَيْرِ فَرَاغٍ فَأَعِدِ اَلصَّلاَةَ إِذَا كَانَ اَلاِلْتِفَاتُ فَاحِشاً وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ قَدْ تَشَهَّدْتَ فَلاَ تُعِدْ»
thaqalaynSanad: peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man, does anything that passes in front of him cut off his prayer? Imam (a.s) said: "Nothing cuts the prayer of a Muslim, but repel as much as you are able." He (al Halabi) said: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who experiences a nosebleed and the bleeding does not stop until the time of prayer enters.” Imam (a.s) said: "He should stuff his nose with something and then pray, and he should not prolong the prayer if he fears that the blood will precede him." He (al Halabi) said: “And Imam (a.s) said: ‘If you turn away during an obligatory prayer without completing it, then repeat the prayer if the turning was excessive; but if you have already recited the tashahhud, then do not repeat.’"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 347

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Abdullah ibn Amir from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah from Al-Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, about a man who experiences nosebleed and vomiting during the prayer, what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: "He should turn away, wash his nose, and return to his prayer. But if he speaks, then he must repeat his prayer, and he is not required to perform ablution."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَأْخُذُهُ اَلرُّعَافُ وَ اَلْقَيْءُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ« يَنْفَتِلُ فَيَغْسِلُ أَنْفَهُ وَ يَعُودُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ وَ إِنْ تَكَلَّمَ فَلْيُعِدْ صَلاَتَهُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ وُضُوءٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Abdullah ibn Amir from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah from Al-Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, about a man who experiences nosebleed and vomiting during the prayer, what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: "He should turn away, wash his nose, and return to his prayer. But if he speaks, then he must repeat his prayer, and he is not required to perform ablution."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 348

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Loud laughter does not invalidate the ablution, but it does invalidate the prayer."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «اَلْقَهْقَهَةُ لاَ تَنْقُضُ اَلْوُضُوءَ وَ لَكِنْ تَنْقُضُ اَلصَّلاَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Loud laughter does not invalidate the ablution, but it does invalidate the prayer."

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Hasan from his brother from Zur'ah from Sama'ah who said:
I asked Him about laughter, does it break the prayer? He said: "As for smiling, it does not break the prayer, but as for loud laughter, it does break the prayer."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلضَّحِكِ هَلْ يَقْطَعُ اَلصَّلاَةَ قَالَ «أَمَّا اَلتَّبَسُّمُ فَلاَ يَقْطَعُ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ أَمَّا اَلْقَهْقَهَةُ فَهِيَ تَقْطَعُ اَلصَّلاَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Hasan from his brother from Zur'ah from Sama'ah who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Him about laughter, does it break the prayer? He said: "As for smiling, it does not break the prayer, but as for loud laughter, it does break the prayer."

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Abdullah ibn Al-Hajjaj who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about a man who experiences cramping in his stomach and is able to endure it, should he pray in that condition or not? Imam (a.s) said: "If he can bear the endurance and does not fear being rushed in his prayer, then he should pray and be patient."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصِيبُهُ اَلْغَمْزُ فِي بَطْنِهِ وَ هُوَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَصْبِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى تِلْكَ اَلْحَالِ أَوْ لاَ يُصَلِّي قَالَ فَقَالَ «إِنِ اِحْتَمَلَ اَلصَّبْرَ وَ لَمْ يَخَفْ إِعْجَالاً عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ فَلْيُصَلِّ وَ لْيَصْبِرْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Abdullah ibn Al-Hajjaj who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about a man who experiences cramping in his stomach and is able to endure it, should he pray in that condition or not? Imam (a.s) said: "If he can bear the endurance and does not fear being rushed in his prayer, then he should pray and be patient."
