chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus from Al-Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of them (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them:
Imam (a.s) (was asked) regarding a man who touches his nose during the prayer and sees blood, what should he do, should he leave? Imam (a.s) said: "If it is dry, then he should throw it away and there is no harm."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَمَسُّ أَنْفَهُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَيَرَى دَماً كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ أَ يَنْصَرِفُ فَقَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ يَابِساً فَلْيَرْمِ بِهِ وَ لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus from Al-Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of them (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) (was asked) regarding a man who touches his nose during the prayer and sees blood, what should he do, should he leave? Imam (a.s) said: "If it is dry, then he should throw it away and there is no harm."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 348

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
Imam (a.s) was asked about a man who needs something while he is in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "He should gesture with his head and signal with his hand. And a woman, if she needs something while she is praying, should clap with her hands." He (al Halabi) said: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who yawns and stretches during the prayer”. Imam (a.s) said: "It is from Shaytan, and he will not be able to control it."
arabicText: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُرِيدُ اَلْحَاجَةَ وَ هُوَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ« يُومِئُ بِرَأْسِهِ وَ يُشِيرُ بِيَدِهِ وَ اَلْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا أَرَادَتِ اَلْحَاجَةَ وَ هِيَ تُصَلِّي تُصَفِّقُ بِيَدِهَا» قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَتَثَأَّبُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ يَتَمَطَّى قَالَ« هُوَ مِنَ اَلشَّيْطَانِ وَ لَنْ يَمْلِكَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) was asked about a man who needs something while he is in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "He should gesture with his head and signal with his hand. And a woman, if she needs something while she is praying, should clap with her hands." He (al Halabi) said: “And I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who yawns and stretches during the prayer”. Imam (a.s) said: "It is from Shaytan, and he will not be able to control it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 349

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Nasr from Abu Al-Walid who said:
I was sitting with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, when Najiyah Abu Habib asked Imam (a.s) and said: “May I be your ransom, I have a mill in which I grind, and sometimes I rise during a part of the night and know from the sound of the mill that the servant has fallen asleep, so I strike the wall to wake him up.” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, you are in obedience to Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, seeking His sustenance."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْوَلِيدِ قَالَ: كُنْتُ جَالِساً عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَسَأَلَهُ نَاجِيَةُ أَبُو حَبِيبٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ جَعَلَنِيَ اَللَّهُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّ لِي رَحًى أَطْحَنُ فِيهَا فَرُبَّمَا قُمْتُ فِي سَاعَةٍ مِنَ اَللَّيْلِ فَأَعْرِفُ مِنَ اَلرَّحَى أَنَّ اَلْغُلاَمَ قَدْ نَامَ فَأَضْرِبُ اَلْحَائِطَ لِأُوقِظَهُ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ أَنْتَ فِي طَاعَةِ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ تَطْلُبُ رِزْقَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Nasr from Abu Al-Walid who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I was sitting with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, when Najiyah Abu Habib asked Imam (a.s) and said: “May I be your ransom, I have a mill in which I grind, and sometimes I rise during a part of the night and know from the sound of the mill that the servant has fallen asleep, so I strike the wall to wake him up.” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, you are in obedience to Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, seeking His sustenance."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 349

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from some of his companions:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Everything with which you speak to Allah (swt) during the obligatory prayer, there is no harm in it, and it is not considered speech (that invalidates the prayer)."
arabicText: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «كُلُّمَا كَلَّمْتَ اَللَّهَ بِهِ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ وَ لَيْسَ بِكَلاَمٍ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from some of his companions:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Everything with which you speak to Allah (swt) during the obligatory prayer, there is no harm in it, and it is not considered speech (that invalidates the prayer)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 349

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah from Aban from Salamah from Abu Hafs:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said that (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: "Nosebleed, blood, and vomiting do not cut off the prayer. So whoever experiences discomfort should take the hand of a man from the people in the row and bring him forward, meaning if he is the imam (of prayer)."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي حَفْصٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ يَقُولُ:« لاَ يَقْطَعُ اَلصَّلاَةَ اَلرُّعَافُ وَ لاَ اَلدَّمُ وَ لاَ اَلْقَيْءُ فَمَنْ وَجَدَ أَذًى فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِيَدِ رَجُلٍ مِنَ اَلْقَوْمِ مِنَ اَلصَّفِّ فَلْيُقَدِّمْهُ يَعْنِي إِذَا كَانَ إِمَاماً»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah from Aban from Salamah from Abu Hafs:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said that (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: "Nosebleed, blood, and vomiting do not cut off the prayer. So whoever experiences discomfort should take the hand of a man from the people in the row and bring him forward, meaning if he is the imam (of prayer)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 349

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Dawud Al-Khandaqi from Abu Basir who said:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "When you stand for prayer, know that you are before Allah (swt); if you do not see Him (azj), then know that He (azj) sees you. So turn fully toward your prayer and do not blow your nose, nor spit, nor crack your fingers, nor sit in a sprawling manner, for a people were punished for cracking their fingers and sprawling during the prayer. When you raise your head from bowing (ruku'), straighten your back until your joints return to their places. And when you prostrate, do the same. And when you are in the first and second rak'ahs and raise your head from prostration, sit properly until your joints return to their places. When you stand up, say: 'By the power and strength of Allah (swt) I stand and sit,' for indeed (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to do so."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ دَاوُدَ اَلْخَنْدَقِيِّ[اَ لْ خَ نْ دَ قِ يِّ خ ل] عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِذَا قُمْتَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّكَ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اَللَّهِ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ لاَ تَرَاهُ فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ يَرَاكَ فَأَقْبِلْ قِبَلَ صَلاَتِكَ وَ لاَ تَمْتَخِطْ وَ لاَ تَبْزُقْ وَ لاَ تَنْقُضْ أَصَابِعَكَ وَ لاَ تَوَرَّكْ فَإِنَّ قَوْماً قَدْ عُذِّبُوا بِنَقْضِ اَلْأَصَابِعِ وَ اَلتَّوَرُّكِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَإِذَا رَفَعْتَ رَأْسَكَ مِنَ اَلرُّكُوعِ فَأَقِمْ صُلْبَكَ حَتَّى تَرْجِعَ مَفَاصِلُكَ وَ إِذَا سَجَدْتَ فَافْعَلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ وَ إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي اَلرَّكْعَةِ اَلْأُولَى وَ اَلثَّانِيَةِ فَرَفَعْتَ رَأْسَكَ مِنَ اَلسُّجُودِ فَاسْتَتِمَّ جَالِساً حَتَّى تَرْجِعَ مَفَاصِلُكَ فَإِذَا نَهَضْتَ فَقُلْ بِحَوْلِ اَللَّهِ وَ قُوَّتِهِ أَقُومُ وَ أَقْعُدُ فَإِنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ هَكَذَا كَانَ يَفْعَلُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Dawud Al-Khandaqi from Abu Basir who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "When you stand for prayer, know that you are before Allah (swt); if you do not see Him (azj), then know that He (azj) sees you. So turn fully toward your prayer and do not blow your nose, nor spit, nor crack your fingers, nor sit in a sprawling manner, for a people were punished for cracking their fingers and sprawling during the prayer. When you raise your head from bowing (ruku'), straighten your back until your joints return to their places. And when you prostrate, do the same. And when you are in the first and second rak'ahs and raise your head from prostration, sit properly until your joints return to their places. When you stand up, say: 'By the power and strength of Allah (swt) I stand and sit,' for indeed (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to do so."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 350

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami from his father from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: "Do not pray while you feel anything from the two impurities."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ:« لاَ تُصَلِّ وَ أَنْتَ تَجِدُ شَيْئاً مِنَ اَلْأَخْبَثَيْنِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami from his father from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: "Do not pray while you feel anything from the two impurities."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 350

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from (Imam) Ja'far (a.s) from his father (a.s):
(Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Do not let your gaze go beyond the place of your prostration during the prayer." And Imam (a.s) said: "A man should not pray with his buttons undone if he is not wearing an izar (waist wrap)."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاثِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ تُجَاوِزْ بِطَرَفِكَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ مَوْضِعَ سُجُودِكَ» وَ قَالَ« لاَ يُصَلِّي اَلرَّجُلُ مَحْلُولَ اَلْأَزْرَارِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ إِزَارٌ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from (Imam) Ja'far (a.s) from his father (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "Do not let your gaze go beyond the place of your prostration during the prayer." And Imam (a.s) said: "A man should not pray with his buttons undone if he is not wearing an izar (waist wrap)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 350

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from a man who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The people say that if a man prays while his buttons are undone and his hands are inside his shirt, it is as if he is praying naked.” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّ اَلنَّاسَ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ اَلرَّجُلَ إِذَا صَلَّى وَ أَزْرَارُهُ مَحْلُولَةٌ وَ يَدَاهُ دَاخِلَةٌ فِي اَلْقَمِيصِ إِنَّمَا يُصَلِّي عُرْيَاناً قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from a man who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “The people say that if a man prays while his buttons are undone and his hands are inside his shirt, it is as if he is praying naked.” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 350

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Ibn Abi Umayr who said: I heard Abdur-Rahman ibn Al-Hajjaj say:
I saw Abu Abdul Malik Al-Qummi asking Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about placing one's hand inside the garment during prayer in prostration. Imam (a.s) said: "If you wish, you may do so; it is not from this that I fear for you."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ اَلْحَجَّاجِ يَقُولُ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ اَلْقُمِّيَّ يَسْأَلُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ إِدْخَالِ يَدِهِ فِي اَلثَّوْبِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي اَلسُّجُودِ قَالَ« إِنْ شِئْتَ فَعَلْتَ لَيْسَ مِنْ هَذَا أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Ibn Abi Umayr who said: I heard Abdur-Rahman ibn Al-Hajjaj say:
thaqalaynMatn: I saw Abu Abdul Malik Al-Qummi asking Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about placing one's hand inside the garment during prayer in prostration. Imam (a.s) said: "If you wish, you may do so; it is not from this that I fear for you."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 351

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Mahziyar who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, about a man who speaks during the obligatory prayer with anything by which he converses with his Lord (azj). Imam (a.s) said: "Yes."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَتَكَلَّمُ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُنَاجِي رَبَّهُ قَالَ« نَعَمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Mahziyar who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, about a man who speaks during the obligatory prayer with anything by which he converses with his Lord (azj). Imam (a.s) said: "Yes."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 351

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Bakr ibn Muhammad Al-Azdi from Aban ibn Uthman from Al-Halabi who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Should I name the Imams, peace be upon them, individually in the prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: "Mention them collectively."
arabicText: عنه عن بكر بن محمد الازدي عن أبان بن عثمان عن الحلبي قال قلت لابي عبد الله عليه السلام أسمي الائمة عليهم السلام في الصلاة؟ قال اجملهم
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Bakr ibn Muhammad Al-Azdi from Aban ibn Uthman from Al-Halabi who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Should I name the Imams, peace be upon them, individually in the prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: "Mention them collectively."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 351

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Musa ibn Al-Qasim from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man, is it permissible for him to lean against the wall of the mosque while praying, or to place his hand on the wall while standing without illness or weakness? Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm." And I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is in the obligatory prayer and stands during the first two rak'ahs, is it permissible for him to reach toward the side of the mosque and use it to help himself rise without weakness or illness? Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَسْتَنِدَ إِلَى حَائِطِ اَلْمَسْجِدِ وَ هُوَ يُصَلِّي أَوْ يَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى اَلْحَائِطِ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ مِنْ غَيْرِ مَرَضٍ وَ لاَ عِلَّةٍ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ» وَعَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي صَلاَةٍ فَرِيضَةٍ فَيَقُومُ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأُولَيَيْنِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَ جَانِبَ اَلْمَسْجِدِ فَيَنْهَضَ يَسْتَعِينُ بِهِ عَلَى اَلْقِيَامِ مِنْ غَيْرِ ضَعْفٍ وَ لاَ عِلَّةٍ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Musa ibn Al-Qasim from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far (a.s), peace be upon them both, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man, is it permissible for him to lean against the wall of the mosque while praying, or to place his hand on the wall while standing without illness or weakness? Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm." And I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is in the obligatory prayer and stands during the first two rak'ahs, is it permissible for him to reach toward the side of the mosque and use it to help himself rise without weakness or illness? Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in it."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 351

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali from his father from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Hasan ibn Al-Jahm from Al-Husayn ibn Musa from Sa'id ibn Yasar who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about leaning during the prayer against the wall, whether to the right or the left. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ اَلْجَهْمِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلتُّكَأَةِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْحَائِطِ يَمِيناً وَ شِمَالاً فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali from his father from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Hasan ibn Al-Jahm from Al-Husayn ibn Musa from Sa'id ibn Yasar who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about leaning during the prayer against the wall, whether to the right or the left. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 351

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who prays leaning on a staff or on a wall. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in leaning on a staff or resting against a wall."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي مُتَوَكِّئاً عَلَى عَصًا أَوْ عَلَى حَائِطٍ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِالتَّوَكِّي عَلَى عَصًا وَ اَلاِتِّكَاءِ عَلَى اَلْحَائِطِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who prays leaning on a staff or on a wall. Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm in leaning on a staff or resting against a wall."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 352

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Ahmad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ribbat from Muhammad ibn Bajil, the brother of Ali ibn Bajil, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, praying, and a man passed in front of Him (a.s) while He (a.s) was between the two prostrations, so Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, threw a pebble at him, and the man turned toward him.
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ رِبَاطٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بَجِيلٍ أَخِي عَلِيِّ بْنِ بَجِيلٍ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يُصَلِّي فَمَرَّ بِهِ رَجُلٌ وَ هُوَ بَيْنَ اَلسَّجْدَتَيْنِ فَرَمَاهُ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ بِحَصَاةٍ فَأَقْبَلَ إِلَيْهِ اَلرَّجُلُ
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Ahmad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ribbat from Muhammad ibn Bajil, the brother of Ali ibn Bajil, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I saw Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, praying, and a man passed in front of Him (a.s) while He (a.s) was between the two prostrations, so Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, threw a pebble at him, and the man turned toward him.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 352

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah who said:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "If you insert your hand into your nose while you are praying and you find flowing blood that is not a nosebleed, then break your prayer with your hand."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« إِنْ أَدْخَلْتَ يَدَكَ فِي أَنْفِكَ وَ أَنْتَ تُصَلِّي فَوَجَدْتَ دَماً سَائِلاً لَيْسَ بِرُعَافٍ فَفُتَّهُ بِيَدِكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah who said:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "If you insert your hand into your nose while you are praying and you find flowing blood that is not a nosebleed, then break your prayer with your hand."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 352

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Ibn Abi Najran from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb Al-Bajali who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about nosebleed, does it invalidate the ablution? Imam (a.s) said: "If a man experiences a nosebleed during his prayer, and he has water with him or someone nearby who can signal to him and hand him water, and he gestures with his head and washes it, then let him continue his prayer and not cut it off."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ اَلْبَجَلِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرُّعَافِ أَ يَنْقُضُ اَلْوُضُوءَ قَالَ« لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً رَعَفَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ وَ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ مَاءٌ أَوْ مَنْ يُشِيرُ إِلَيْهِ بِمَاءٍ فَيُنَا وِلُهُ فَقَالَ بِرَأْسِهِ فَغَسَلَهُ فَلْيَبْنِ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ وَ لاَ يَقْطَعْهَا»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Ibn Abi Najran from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb Al-Bajali who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about nosebleed, does it invalidate the ablution? Imam (a.s) said: "If a man experiences a nosebleed during his prayer, and he has water with him or someone nearby who can signal to him and hand him water, and he gestures with his head and washes it, then let him continue his prayer and not cut it off."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 352

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Isma'il ibn Abd Al-Khaliq who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is among a group of people leading them in the obligatory prayer, and he experiences a nosebleed, what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: "He should leave, and if he finds water before speaking, he should wash the blood from the nosebleed, then return and continue with his prayer."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْخَالِقِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ مِنَ اَلْقَوْمِ يُصَلِّي بِهِمُ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةَ فَيَعْرِضُ لَهُ رُعَافٌ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ« يَخْرُجُ فَإِنْ وَجَدَ مَاءً قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ فَلْيَغْسِلِ اَلرُّعَافَ ثُمَّ لْيَعُدْ فَلْيَبْنِ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Isma'il ibn Abd Al-Khaliq who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is among a group of people leading them in the obligatory prayer, and he experiences a nosebleed, what should he do? Imam (a.s) said: "He should leave, and if he finds water before speaking, he should wash the blood from the nosebleed, then return and continue with his prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 352

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about nosebleed, cupping, and vomiting. Imam (a.s) said: "None of these invalidate the ablution, but they do invalidate the prayer."
arabicText: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرُّعَافِ وَ اَلْحِجَامَةِ وَ اَلْقَيْءِ قَالَ« لاَ يَنْقُضُ هَذَا شَيْئاً مِنَ اَلْوُضُوءِ وَ لَكِنْ يَنْقُضُ اَلصَّلاَةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), about nosebleed, cupping, and vomiting. Imam (a.s) said: "None of these invalidate the ablution, but they do invalidate the prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "Nothing interrupts the prayer except a nosebleed and severe discomfort in the stomach, so hasten to address them as much as you are able."
arabicText: وَ مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ يَقْطَعُ اَلصَّلاَةَ إِلاَّ رُعَافٌ وَ أَزٌّ فِي اَلْبَطْنِ فَبَادِرُوا بِهِنَّ مَا اِسْتَطَعْتُمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: And what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "Nothing interrupts the prayer except a nosebleed and severe discomfort in the stomach, so hasten to address them as much as you are able."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is greeted with salam while he is in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "He should respond by saying, 'Salamun alaykum,' and he should not say, 'Alaykumu as-salam,' for the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, was once standing in prayer when Ammar ibn Yasir passed by Him (saws) and greeted Him (saws) with salam, so the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, responded to him in this manner."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُسَلَّمُ عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ قَالَ« يَرُدُّ يَقُولُ« سَلاٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ» وَ لاَ يَقُولُ عَلَيْكُمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ قَائِماً يُصَلِّي فَمَرَّ بِهِ عَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ هَكَذَا»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is greeted with salam while he is in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "He should respond by saying, 'Salamun alaykum,' and he should not say, 'Alaykumu as-salam,' for the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, was once standing in prayer when Ammar ibn Yasir passed by Him (saws) and greeted Him (saws) with salam, so the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, responded to him in this manner."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
I entered upon Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, while He (a.s) was in prayer. I said: "Peace be upon you," And Imam (a.s) replied: "Peace be upon you." I asked: "How did you wake up?" But Imam (a.s) remained silent, and when He (a.s) finished, I said to Imam (a.s): "Does one return the salam while in prayer?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, in the manner it was said to him."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ هُوَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَقُلْتُ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ فَقَالَ« اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ» قُلْتُ كَيْفَ أَصْبَحْتَ فَسَكَتَ فَلَمَّا اِنْصَرَفَ قُلْتُ لَهُ أَ يَرُدُّ اَلسَّلاَمَ وَ هُوَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ« نَعَمْ مِثْلَ مَا قِيلَ لَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I entered upon Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, while He (a.s) was in prayer. I said: "Peace be upon you," And Imam (a.s) replied: "Peace be upon you." I asked: "How did you wake up?" But Imam (a.s) remained silent, and when He (a.s) finished, I said to Imam (a.s): "Does one return the salam while in prayer?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, in the manner it was said to him."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Misma’ who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s): “I might be praying and a slave-girl passes by me, and I might draw her toward me.” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مِسْمَعٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَقُلْتُ أَكُونُ أُصَلِّي فَتَمُرُّ بِي جَارِيَةٌ فَرُبَّمَا ضَمَمْتُهَا إِلَيَّ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Misma’ who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Al-Hasan (a.s): “I might be praying and a slave-girl passes by me, and I might draw her toward me.” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 353

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Abu Muhammad Al-Hajjal from Abu Ishaq from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in blowing during the prayer at the place of prostration as long as it does not harm anyone."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْحَجَّالِ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ بِالنَّفْخِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فِي مَوْضِعِ اَلسُّجُودِ مَا لَمْ يُؤْذِ أَحَداً»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Abu Muhammad Al-Hajjal from Abu Ishaq from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in blowing during the prayer at the place of prostration as long as it does not harm anyone."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 354

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText: From him from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah who said: "If you find a louse while you are in prayer, then bury it in the pebbles."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ قَالَ:« إِنْ وَجَدْتَ قَمْلَةً وَ أَنْتَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَادْفِنْهَا فِي اَلْحَصَى»
thaqalaynMatn: From him from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah who said: "If you find a louse while you are in prayer, then bury it in the pebbles."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 354

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Ala who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who stands in prayer and sees a louse. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him bury it in the gravel, for (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: 'If you see it, then bury it in the pebbles.'"
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَقُومُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَيَرَى اَلْقَمْلَةَ قَالَ« فَلْيَدْفِنْهَا فِي اَلْحَصَى فَإِنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ يَقُولُ« إِذَا رَأَيْتَهَا فَادْفِنْهَا فِي اَلْبَطْحَاءِ»»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Ala who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who stands in prayer and sees a louse. Imam (a.s) said: "Let him bury it in the gravel, for (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, used to say: 'If you see it, then bury it in the pebbles.'"

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 354

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq Al-Nahdi from Muhammad ibn Haytham Al-Tamimi from Sa'id Al-A'raj who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I spend the night intending to fast, and while I am in the witr prayer I become thirsty, but I dislike cutting off the supplication to drink, and I also dislike reaching morning while I am thirsty. In front of me there is a water container, two or three steps away.” Imam (a.s) said: "Go to it, drink what you need from it, and then return to your supplication."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْهَيْثَمِ بْنِ أَبِي مَسْرُوقٍ اَلنَّهْدِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ هَيْثَمٍ اَلتَّمِيمِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ اَلْأَعْرَجِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنِّي أَبِيتُ وَ أُرِيدُ اَلصَّوْمَ فَأَكُونُ فِي اَلْوَتْرِ فَأَعْطَشُ فَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَقْطَعَ اَلدُّعَاءَ فَأَشْرَبَ وَ أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُصْبِحَ وَ أَنَا عَطْشَانُ وَ أَمَامِي قُلَّةٌ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَهَا خُطْوَتَانِ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةٌ قَالَ« تَسْعَى إِلَيْهَا وَ تَشْرَبُ مِنْهَا حَاجَتَكَ وَ تَعُودُ فِي اَلدُّعَاءِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq Al-Nahdi from Muhammad ibn Haytham Al-Tamimi from Sa'id Al-A'raj who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I spend the night intending to fast, and while I am in the witr prayer I become thirsty, but I dislike cutting off the supplication to drink, and I also dislike reaching morning while I am thirsty. In front of me there is a water container, two or three steps away.” Imam (a.s) said: "Go to it, drink what you need from it, and then return to your supplication."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 354

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Amr ibn Sa'id Al-Mada'ini from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah Al-Mada'ini from Ammar Al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "There is no harm if a woman carries her child while she is praying, or if she breastfeeds him while she is reciting the tashahhud."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ اَلْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ اَلْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ تَحْمِلَ اَلْمَرْأَةُ صَبِيَّهَا وَ هِيَ تُصَلِّي أَوْ تُرْضِعَهُ وَ هِيَ تَتَشَهَّدُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Amr ibn Sa'id Al-Mada'ini from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah Al-Mada'ini from Ammar Al-Sabati:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s) said: "There is no harm if a woman carries her child while she is praying, or if she breastfeeds him while she is reciting the tashahhud."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 354

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from Ja'far from his father:
(Imam) Ali (a.s) said: "Whoever groans during his prayer has indeed spoken."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« مَنْ أَنَّ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَقَدْ تَكَلَّمَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from Ja'far from his father:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam) Ali (a.s) said: "Whoever groans during his prayer has indeed spoken."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 354

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Ala who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who sees a snake or a scorpion while he is praying the obligatory prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "He should kill them."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي اَلْعَلاَءِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَرَى اَلْحَيَّةَ وَ اَلْعَقْرَبَ وَ هُوَ يُصَلِّي اَلْمَكْتُوبَةَ قَالَ« يَقْتُلُهُمَا»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Ala who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who sees a snake or a scorpion while he is praying the obligatory prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "He should kill them."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 355

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Hammad from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who is in prayer and sees a snake or a scorpion, should he kill them if they harm him? Imam (a.s) said: "Yes."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَيَرَى اَلْحَيَّةَ أَوِ اَلْعَقْرَبَ يَقْتُلُهُمَا إِنْ آذَيَاهُ قَالَ« نَعَمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Hammad from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who is in prayer and sees a snake or a scorpion, should he kill them if they harm him? Imam (a.s) said: "Yes."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 355

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who kills a bug, a flea, a louse, or a fly during prayer, does it invalidate his prayer or his ablution? Imam (a.s) said: "No."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلرَّجُلِ يَقْتُلُ اَلْبَقَّةَ وَ اَلْبُرْغُوثَ وَ اَلْقَمْلَةَ وَ اَلذُّبَابَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ أَ يَنْقُضُ صَلاَتَهُ وَ وُضُوءَهُ قَالَ« لاَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who kills a bug, a flea, a louse, or a fly during prayer, does it invalidate his prayer or his ablution? Imam (a.s) said: "No."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 355

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is standing in obligatory prayer and remembers his pouch or some of his belongings, fearing their loss or ruin. Imam (a.s) said: "He should cut off his prayer, secure his belongings, and then start his prayer anew." I asked: “If he is in obligatory prayer and his animal breaks loose and he fears it might be lost or cause harm” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm if he cuts off his prayer."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ قَائِماً فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ فَيَنْسَى كِيسَهُ أَوْ مَتَاعاً لَهُ يَتَخَوَّفُ ضَيْعَتَهُ أَوْ هَلاَكَهُ قَالَ« يَقْطَعُ صَلاَتَهُ وَ يُحْرِزُ مَتَاعَهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَقْبِلُ اَلصَّلاَةَ» قُلْتُ فَيَكُونُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ فَتَفَلَّتُ دَابَّتُهُ فَيَخَافُ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ أَوْ يُصِيبَ مِنْهَا عَنَتاً فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يَقْطَعَ صَلاَتَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is standing in obligatory prayer and remembers his pouch or some of his belongings, fearing their loss or ruin. Imam (a.s) said: "He should cut off his prayer, secure his belongings, and then start his prayer anew." I asked: “If he is in obligatory prayer and his animal breaks loose and he fears it might be lost or cause harm” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm if he cuts off his prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 355

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Isma'il by Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan by Hammad by Hariz by someone from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
(Imam (a.s)) said: "If you are in obligatory prayer and you see your servant running away, or a debtor upon whom you have a debt, or a snake that you fear for yourself, then cut off the prayer and pursue your servant or your debtor and kill the snake."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَمَّنْ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ فَرَأَيْتَ غُلاَماً لَكَ قَدْ أَبَقَ أَوْ غَرِيماً لَكَ عَلَيْهِ مَالٌ أَوْ حَيَّةً تَخَافُهَا عَلَى نَفْسِكَ فَاقْطَعِ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَاِتْبَعِ اَلْغُلاَمَ أَوْ غَرِيماً لَكَ وَ اُقْتُلِ اَلْحَيَّةَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Isma'il by Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan by Hammad by Hariz by someone from Abu Abdillah (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam (a.s)) said: "If you are in obligatory prayer and you see your servant running away, or a debtor upon whom you have a debt, or a snake that you fear for yourself, then cut off the prayer and pursue your servant or your debtor and kill the snake."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 355

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Mansur ibn Yunus from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami from Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah, peace be upon them both:
The Imam (a.s) said: "Nothing invalidates the prayer except four things: relieving oneself, urination, passing wind, and speaking."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ يُونُسَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ اَلْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ:« لاَ يَقْطَعُ اَلصَّلاَةَ إِلاَّ أَرْبَعٌ اَلْخَلاَءُ وَ اَلْبَوْلُ وَ اَلرِّيحُ وَ اَلصَّوْتُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Mansur ibn Yunus from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami from Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah, peace be upon them both:
thaqalaynMatn: The Imam (a.s) said: "Nothing invalidates the prayer except four things: relieving oneself, urination, passing wind, and speaking."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 355

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Musa ibn Al-Qasim from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is in his prayer and someone seeks permission at the door, so he glorifies (says tasbih) and raises his voice and lets his servant girl hear, and she comes to him, and he gestures with his hand to show her that there is someone at the door, does that action invalidate his prayer and what is required of him? Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm; that does not invalidate his prayer."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَيَسْتَأْذِنُ إِنْسَانٌ عَلَى اَلْبَابِ فَيُسَبِّحُ وَ يَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ وَ يُسْمِعُ جَارِيَتَهُ فَتَأْتِيهِ فَيُرِيهَا بِيَدِهِ أَنَّ عَلَى اَلْبَابِ إِنْسَاناً هَلْ يَقْطَعُ ذَلِكَ صَلاَتَهُ وَ مَا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ لاَ يَقْطَعُ ذَلِكَ صَلاَتَهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Musa ibn Al-Qasim from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is in his prayer and someone seeks permission at the door, so he glorifies (says tasbih) and raises his voice and lets his servant girl hear, and she comes to him, and he gestures with his hand to show her that there is someone at the door, does that action invalidate his prayer and what is required of him? Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm; that does not invalidate his prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 356

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who is in prayer and sees a snake nearby, is it permissible for him to reach out and kill it? Imam (a.s) said: "If there is only one step between him and it, then he should step and kill it; otherwise, he should not."
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَيَرَى حَيَّةً بِحِيَالِهِ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَهَا فَيَقْتُلَهَا فَقَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَهَا خُطْوَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَلْيَخْطُ وَ لْيَقْتُلْهَا وَ إِلاَّ فَلاَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who is in prayer and sees a snake nearby, is it permissible for him to reach out and kill it? Imam (a.s) said: "If there is only one step between him and it, then he should step and kill it; otherwise, he should not."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 356

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
And with this same chain of narration, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a person who is praying. Imam (a.s) said: "If a man from among the Muslims greets you with salam while you are in prayer, then return the greeting to him within yourself without raising your voice."
arabicText: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُصَلِّي فَقَالَ« إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ اَلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ أَنْتَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ نَفْسِكَ وَ لاَ تَرْفَعْ صَوْتَكَ»
thaqalaynSanad: And with this same chain of narration, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a person who is praying. Imam (a.s) said: "If a man from among the Muslims greets you with salam while you are in prayer, then return the greeting to him within yourself without raising your voice."

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Hamid from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Ali ibn Al-Nu'man from Mansur ibn Hazim:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “If a man greets you with salam while you are praying, he said: ‘You should return the greeting quietly, just as he said it.’"
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْحَمِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلنُّعْمَانِ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكَ اَلرَّجُلُ وَ أَنْتَ تُصَلِّي قَالَ« تَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ خَفِيّاً كَمَا قَالَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Hamid from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Ali ibn Al-Nu'man from Mansur ibn Hazim:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “If a man greets you with salam while you are praying, he said: ‘You should return the greeting quietly, just as he said it.’"

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Abdullah ibn Muskan from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If a man sneezes during the prayer, he should say, 'All praise is due to Allah (swt)’ (Alhamdulillah)."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا عَطَسَ اَلرَّجُلُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَلْيَقُلِ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Abdullah ibn Muskan from Al-Halabi:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "If a man sneezes during the prayer, he should say, 'All praise is due to Allah (swt)’ (Alhamdulillah)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 356

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Al-Mu'alla Abu Uthman from Abu Basir who said:
I said to Imam (a.s): “I hear someone sneeze, so I praise Allah (swt) and send blessings upon the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, while I am in prayer.” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, even if there is an ocean between you and your companion."
arabicText: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنِ اَلْمُعَلَّى أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَسْمَعُ اَلْعَطْسَةَ فَأَحْمَدُ اَللَّهَ وَ أُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَنَا فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ صَاحِبِكَ اَلْيَمُّ»
thaqalaynSanad: Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Al-Mu'alla Abu Uthman from Abu Basir who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam (a.s): “I hear someone sneeze, so I praise Allah (swt) and send blessings upon the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, while I am in prayer.” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, even if there is an ocean between you and your companion."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 356

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Hasan Al-Ribati from Zakariyya Al-A'war who said:
I saw Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), praying while standing, and next to Him (a.s) was an elderly man who wanted to stand up and had a staff with him. He wanted to reach for it, so Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), bent down while he was still standing in his prayer and handed the man the staff, then returned to His (a.s) prayer.
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّبَاطِيِّ عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا اَلْأَعْوَرِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يُصَلِّي قَائِماً وَ إِلَى جَانِبِهِ رَجُلٌ كَبِيرٌ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَقُومَ وَ مَعَهُ عَصًا لَهُ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَهَا فَانْحَطَّ أَبُو اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَنَاوَلَ اَلرَّجُلَ اَلْعَصَا ثُمَّ عَادَ إِلَى صَلاَتِهِ
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Hasan Al-Ribati from Zakariyya Al-A'war who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I saw Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), praying while standing, and next to Him (a.s) was an elderly man who wanted to stand up and had a staff with him. He wanted to reach for it, so Abu Al-Hasan (a.s), bent down while he was still standing in his prayer and handed the man the staff, then returned to His (a.s) prayer.

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 357

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ali ibn Mahziyar from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “I might be in prayer and experience cramping in my stomach, or discomfort, or throbbing.” Imam (a.s) said: "Leave, then perform ablution, and continue from where you left off in your prayer, as long as you have not invalidated the prayer by speaking deliberately. But if you spoke forgetfully, there is no harm upon you, for it is like one who speaks in prayer forgetfully." I asked: “Even if he turns his face away from the qiblah?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, even if he turns his face away from the qiblah."
arabicText: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَكُونُ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ فَأَجِدُ غَمْزاً فِي بَطْنِي أَوْ أَذًى أَوْ ضَرَبَاناً فَقَالَ« اِنْصَرِفْ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأْ وَ اِبْنِ عَلَى مَا مَضَى مِنْ صَلاَتِكَ مَا لَمْ تَنْقُضِ اَلصَّلاَةَ بِالْكَلاَمِ مُتَعَمِّداً فَإِنْ تَكَلَّمْتَ نَاسِياً فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْكَ فَهُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ مَنْ تَكَلَّمَ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ نَاسِياً» قُلْتُ وَ إِنْ قَلَبَ وَجْهَهُ عَنِ اَلْقِبْلَةِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ وَ إِنْ قَلَبَ وَجْهَهُ عَنِ اَلْقِبْلَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ali ibn Mahziyar from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “I might be in prayer and experience cramping in my stomach, or discomfort, or throbbing.” Imam (a.s) said: "Leave, then perform ablution, and continue from where you left off in your prayer, as long as you have not invalidated the prayer by speaking deliberately. But if you spoke forgetfully, there is no harm upon you, for it is like one who speaks in prayer forgetfully." I asked: “Even if he turns his face away from the qiblah?” Imam (a.s) said: "Yes, even if he turns his face away from the qiblah."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 357

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who experiences a nosebleed and it continues until the time of another prayer enters. Imam (a.s) said: "He should stuff his nose and then pray, and he should not prolong the prayer if he fears that the blood will precede him."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ رَعَفَ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَرْعُفُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ وَقْتُ صَلاَةٍ أُخْرَى قَالَ« يَحْشُو أَنْفَهُ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي وَ لاَ يُطَوِّلُ إِنْ خَشِيَ أَنْ يَسْبِقَهُ اَلدَّمُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who experiences a nosebleed and it continues until the time of another prayer enters. Imam (a.s) said: "He should stuff his nose and then pray, and he should not prolong the prayer if he fears that the blood will precede him."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 357

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Al-Barqi from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no prayer for one who is holding in urine or one who is holding in feces, and he is in the position of someone who is relieving himself in his garment."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ صَلاَةَ لِحَاقِنٍ وَ لاَ لِحَاقِنَةٍ وَ هُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ثَوْبِهِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Al-Barqi from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no prayer for one who is holding in urine or one who is holding in feces, and he is in the position of someone who is relieving himself in his garment."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 357

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira who said: Abu Al-Qasim Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar narrated to me from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam (a.s): “A man plays with his private part during the obligatory prayer.” Imam (a.s) said: "And what action is that?" I said: “He played with it until he touched it with his hand.” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو اَلْقَاسِمِ مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ اَلرَّجُلُ يَعْبَثُ بِذَكَرِهِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةِ قَالَ« وَ مَا لَهُ فِعْلٌ» قُلْتُ عَبِثَ بِهِ حَتَّى مَسَّهُ بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira who said: Abu Al-Qasim Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar narrated to me from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I said to Imam (a.s): “A man plays with his private part during the obligatory prayer.” Imam (a.s) said: "And what action is that?" I said: “He played with it until he touched it with his hand.” Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 357

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad by Musa ibn Al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah by Ali ibn Ja'far by (Imam) Musa (a.s) said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is in his prayer and thinks that his garment might have been torn or that something has soiled it, is it permissible for him to look at it or touch it? Imam (a.s) said: "If it is at the front of his garment or on its sides, there is no harm; but if it is at the back, he should not turn around, for that is not appropriate."
arabicText: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَيَظُنُّ أَنَّ ثَوْبَهُ قَدِ اِنْخَرَقَ أَوْ أَصَابَهُ شَيْءٌ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ فِيهِ أَوْ يَمَسَّهُ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ فِي مُقَدَّمِ ثَوْبِهِ أَوْ جَانِبَيْهِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي مُؤَخَّرِهِ فَلاَ يَلْتَفِتُ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَصْلُحُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Ahmad ibn Muhammad by Musa ibn Al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah by Ali ibn Ja'far by (Imam) Musa (a.s) said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is in his prayer and thinks that his garment might have been torn or that something has soiled it, is it permissible for him to look at it or touch it? Imam (a.s) said: "If it is at the front of his garment or on its sides, there is no harm; but if it is at the back, he should not turn around, for that is not appropriate."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 358

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Al-Husayn ibn Yazid from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad from Ja'far from his father:
(Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said regarding a man who is praying and sees a child crawling toward a fire or a sheep entering the house to cause damage. Imam (a.s) said: "He should leave, secure what he fears for, and continue with his prayer as long as he has not spoken."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: فِي رَجُلٍ يُصَلِّي وَ يَرَى اَلصَّبِيَّ يَحْبُو إِلَى اَلنَّارِ أَوِ اَلشَّاةَ تَدْخُلُ اَلْبَيْتَ لِتُفْسِدَ اَلشَّيْءَ قَالَ« فَلْيَنْصَرِفْ وَ لْيُحْرِزْ مَا يَتَخَوَّفُ وَ يَبْنِي عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ مَا لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Al-Husayn ibn Yazid from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad from Ja'far from his father:
thaqalaynMatn: (Imam) Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, said regarding a man who is praying and sees a child crawling toward a fire or a sheep entering the house to cause damage. Imam (a.s) said: "He should leave, secure what he fears for, and continue with his prayer as long as he has not spoken."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 358

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa (a.s):
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is in an obligatory prayer and rises during the first two rak'ahs, is it permissible for him to reach toward the side of the mosque and use it to help himself stand, without weakness or illness? Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي صَلاَةٍ فَرِيضَةٍ فَيَقُومُ فِي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَ جَانِبَ اَلْمَسْجِدِ فَيَنْهَضَ يَسْتَعِينُ بِهِ عَلَى اَلْقِيَامِ مِنْ غَيْرِ ضَعْفٍ وَ لاَ عِلَّةٍ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa (a.s):
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who is in an obligatory prayer and rises during the first two rak'ahs, is it permissible for him to reach toward the side of the mosque and use it to help himself stand, without weakness or illness? Imam (a.s) said: "There is no harm."

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say, and He (a.s) mentioned the prayer of the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. Imam (a.s) said: " A vessel of water for purification would be brought and placed covered near His (saws) head, and His (saws) siwak (tooth-stick) would be placed under His (saws) bed. Then He (saws) would sleep as long as Allah (swt) willed. When He (saws) awoke, He (saws) would sit and turn his gaze toward the sky, then recite the verses from (Surah Ale Imran) 'Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of night and day' (Surah Al ‘Imran 3:190). Then He (saws) would use the siwak and perform purification, then stand and go to the mosque and pray four rak'ahs, with his bowing and prostration proportionate to his recitation. He (saws) would bow so long that it would be said, 'When will He (saws) raise his head?' And He (saws) would prostrate so long that it would be said, 'When will he raise his head?' Then He (saws) would return to his bed and sleep as long as Allah (swt) willed. Then He (saws) would awaken, sit, recite the verses from (Surah Ale Imran), turn His (saws) gaze toward the sky, use the siwak, purify himself, and stand and go to the mosque and pray four rak'ahs as He (saws) had prayed before. Then He (saws) would return to His (saws) bed and sleep as long as Allah (swt) willed. Then He (saws) would awaken, sit, recite the verses from (Surah Ale Imran), turn His (saws) gaze toward the sky, use the siwak, purify himself, and stand and go to the mosque to pray the witr and the two rak'ahs, then go out to the (obligatory) prayer."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: وَذَكَرَ صَلاَةَ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ:« كَانَ يُؤْتَى بِطَهُورٍ فَيُخَمَّرُ عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ وَ يُوضَعُ سِوَاكُهُ تَحْتَ فِرَاشِهِ ثُمَّ يَنَامُ مَا شَاءَ اَللَّهُ فَإِذَا اِسْتَيْقَظَ جَلَسَ ثُمَّ قَلَّبَ بَصَرَهُ فِي اَلسَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ تَلاَ اَلْآيَاتِ مِنْ آلِ عِمْرَانَ«« إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ اَلسَّمٰاوٰاتِ وَ اَلْأَرْضِ وَ اِخْتِلاٰفِ اَللَّيْلِ وَ اَلنَّهٰارِ»» اَلْآيَةَ ثُمَّ يَسْتَنُّ وَ يَتَطَهَّرُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ إِلَى اَلْمَسْجِدِ فَيَرْكَعُ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ عَلَى قَدْرِ قِرَاءَتِهِ رُكُوعُهُ وَ سُجُودُهُ عَلَى قَدْرِ رُكُوعِهِ يَرْكَعُ حَتَّى يُقَالَ مَتَى يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ وَ يَسْجُدُ حَتَّى يُقَالَ مَتَى يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ ثُمَّ يَعُودُ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَيَنَامُ مَا شَاءَ اَللَّهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَيْقِظُ فَيَجْلِسُ فَيَتْلُو اَلْآيَاتِ مِنْ آلِ عِمْرَانَ وَ يُقَلِّبُ بَصَرَهُ فِي اَلسَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَنُّ وَ يَتَطَهَّرُ وَ يَقُومُ إِلَى اَلْمَسْجِدِ فَيُصَلِّي أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ كَمَا رَكَعَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ يَعُودُ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَيَنَامُ مَا شَاءَ اَللَّهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَيْقِظُ فَيَجْلِسُ فَيَتْلُو اَلْآيَاتِ مِنْ آلِ عِمْرَانَ وَ يُقَلِّبُ بَصَرَهُ فِي اَلسَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَنُّ وَ يَتَطَهَّرُ وَيَقُومُ إِلَى اَلْمَسْجِدِ فَيُوتِرُ وَ يُصَلِّي اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ إِلَى اَلصَّلاَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say, and He (a.s) mentioned the prayer of the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. Imam (a.s) said: " A vessel of water for purification would be brought and placed covered near His (saws) head, and His (saws) siwak (tooth-stick) would be placed under His (saws) bed. Then He (saws) would sleep as long as Allah (swt) willed. When He (saws) awoke, He (saws) would sit and turn his gaze toward the sky, then recite the verses from (Surah Ale Imran) 'Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of night and day' (Surah Al ‘Imran 3:190). Then He (saws) would use the siwak and perform purification, then stand and go to the mosque and pray four rak'ahs, with his bowing and prostration proportionate to his recitation. He (saws) would bow so long that it would be said, 'When will He (saws) raise his head?' And He (saws) would prostrate so long that it would be said, 'When will he raise his head?' Then He (saws) would return to his bed and sleep as long as Allah (swt) willed. Then He (saws) would awaken, sit, recite the verses from (Surah Ale Imran), turn His (saws) gaze toward the sky, use the siwak, purify himself, and stand and go to the mosque and pray four rak'ahs as He (saws) had prayed before. Then He (saws) would return to His (saws) bed and sleep as long as Allah (swt) willed. Then He (saws) would awaken, sit, recite the verses from (Surah Ale Imran), turn His (saws) gaze toward the sky, use the siwak, purify himself, and stand and go to the mosque to pray the witr and the two rak'ahs, then go out to the (obligatory) prayer."

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan ibn Yahya from Al-Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no servant except that he is awakened every night once, or twice, or several times. If he gets up, then that is good; otherwise, Shaytan snorts and urinates in his ear. Do you not see that if one of you gets up without responding to this call, he gets up sluggish, heavy, and lazy?"
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ:« لَيْسَ مِنْ عَبْدٍ إِلاَّ يُوقَظُ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ مِرَاراً فَإِنْ قَامَ كَانَ ذَلِكَ وَإِلاَّ فَحَّجَ اَلشَّيْطَانُ فَبَالَ فِي أُذُنِهِ أَ وَ لاَ يَرَى أَحَدُكُمْ أَنَّهُ إِذَا قَامَ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ قَامَ وَ هُوَ مُتَخَثِّرٌ ثَقِيلٌ كَسْلاَنُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan ibn Yahya from Al-Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "There is no servant except that he is awakened every night once, or twice, or several times. If he gets up, then that is good; otherwise, Shaytan snorts and urinates in his ear. Do you not see that if one of you gets up without responding to this call, he gets up sluggish, heavy, and lazy?"

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him by Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn by Safwan from Ibn Bukayr from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Kamil:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "When you begin the night prayer and finish the opening supplication, then recite Ayat al-Kursi and the two surahs of seeking refuge (Al-Falaq and Al-Nas), then recite the Opening of the Book (Al-Fatiha) and a surah."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ كَامِلٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا اِسْتَفْتَحْتَ صَلاَةَ اَللَّيْلِ وَ فَرَغْتَ مِنَ اَلاِسْتِفْتَاحِ فَاقْرَأْ آيَةَ اَلْكُرْسِيِّ وَ اَلْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ اِقْرَأْ فَاتِحَةَ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ سُورَةً»
thaqalaynSanad: From him by Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn by Safwan from Ibn Bukayr from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Kamil:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "When you begin the night prayer and finish the opening supplication, then recite Ayat al-Kursi and the two surahs of seeking refuge (Al-Falaq and Al-Nas), then recite the Opening of the Book (Al-Fatiha) and a surah."

chapter: Chapter on the Manner of Prayer, Its Description and What is Obligatory and Recommended
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Mansur from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about the saying of Allah (swt), the Exalted: "Stand (in prayer) at night except a little." (Surah Muzzammil 73:2) Imam (a.s) said: "Allah (swt) commanded Him (saws) to pray every night except that there might come upon him a night among the nights in which he does not pray anything."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اَللَّهِ تَعَالَى« قُمِ اَللَّيْلَ إِلاّٰ قَلِيلاً» قَالَ« أَمَرَهُ اَللَّهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ كُلَّ لَيْلَةٍ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ عَلَيْهِ لَيْلَةٌ مِنَ اَللَّيَالِي لاَ يُصَلِّي فِيهَا شَيْئاً»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Mansur from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about the saying of Allah (swt), the Exalted: "Stand (in prayer) at night except a little." (Surah Muzzammil 73:2) Imam (a.s) said: "Allah (swt) commanded Him (saws) to pray every night except that there might come upon him a night among the nights in which he does not pray anything."
