chapter: Chapter on the Ages That Children Are Commanded to Pray
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Washsha’, from Al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Jabir, from Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about children when they line up in rows for the obligatory prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "Do not keep them back from the prayer, but separate them (do not let them stand together in one continuous row)."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنِ اَلْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلصِّبْيَانِ إِذَا صَفُّوا فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةِ قَالَ« لاَ تُؤَخِّرُوهُمْ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ فَرِّقُوا بَيْنَهُمْ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Washsha’, from Al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, from Jabir, from Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about children when they line up in rows for the obligatory prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "Do not keep them back from the prayer, but separate them (do not let them stand together in one continuous row)."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 410

chapter: Chapter on the Ages That Children Are Commanded to Pray
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad Al-‘Alawi, from Al-‘Amraki, from Ali ibn Ja‘far, from his brother Musa, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s): “At what point is fasting and prayer obligatory upon a boy?” Imam (a.s) said: "When he approaches puberty and understands prayer and fasting."
arabicText: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ اَلْعَلَوِيِّ عَنِ اَلْعَمْرَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْغُلاَمِ مَتَى يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ اَلصَّوْمُ وَ اَلصَّلاَةُ قَالَ« إِذَا رَاهَقَ اَلْحُلُمَ وَ عَرَفَ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ اَلصَّوْمَ»
thaqalaynSanad: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad Al-‘Alawi, from Al-‘Amraki, from Ali ibn Ja‘far, from his brother Musa, peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s): “At what point is fasting and prayer obligatory upon a boy?” Imam (a.s) said: "When he approaches puberty and understands prayer and fasting."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 410

chapter: Chapter on the Ages That Children Are Commanded to Pray
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar Al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s): “At what age is prayer obligatory upon a boy?” Imam (a.s) said: "When he reaches thirteen years of age. But if he experiences a wet dream before that, then prayer becomes obligatory upon him and the pen (of accountability) is applied to him. And the same is the case for the girl, if she reaches thirteen years of age or menstruates before that, then prayer becomes obligatory upon her and the pen (of accountability) is applied to her."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ اَلسَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْغُلاَمِ مَتَى تَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ اَلصَّلاَةُ قَالَ« إِذَا أَتَى عَلَيْهِ ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً فَإِنِ اِحْتَلَمَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْهِ اَلصَّلاَةُ وَجَرَى عَلَيْهِ اَلْقَلَمُ وَاَلْجَارِيَةُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ إِنْ أَتَى لَهَا ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً أَوْ حَاضَتْ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْهَا اَلصَّلاَةُ وَ جَرَى عَلَيْهَا اَلْقَلَمُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar Al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s): “At what age is prayer obligatory upon a boy?” Imam (a.s) said: "When he reaches thirteen years of age. But if he experiences a wet dream before that, then prayer becomes obligatory upon him and the pen (of accountability) is applied to him. And the same is the case for the girl, if she reaches thirteen years of age or menstruates before that, then prayer becomes obligatory upon her and the pen (of accountability) is applied to her."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 411

chapter: Chapter on the Ages That Children Are Commanded to Pray
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them:
Imam (a.s) (was asked) regarding when a child should begin to pray. Imam (a.s) said: "When he understands the prayer." I asked: “When does he understand the prayer and it becomes obligatory upon him?” Imam (a.s) said: "At six years old."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلصَّبِيِّ مَتَى يُصَلِّي فَقَالَ إِذَا عَقَلَ اَلصَّلاَةَ قُلْتُ مَتَى يَعْقِلُ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ تَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ لِسِتِّ سِنِينَ
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) (was asked) regarding when a child should begin to pray. Imam (a.s) said: "When he understands the prayer." I asked: “When does he understand the prayer and it becomes obligatory upon him?” Imam (a.s) said: "At six years old."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 411

chapter: Chapter on the Ages That Children Are Commanded to Pray
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Al-‘Abbas ibn Ma‘ruf, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “At what age should a child be made to observe the prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: "Between six and seven years of age." I asked: “At what age should he be made to fast?” Imam (a.s) said: "Between fourteen or fifteen years of age. And if he fasts before that, then let him be, my son so-and-so fasted before that, and I let him do so."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي كَمْ يُؤْخَذُ اَلصَّبِيُّ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ« فِيمَا بَيْنَ سَبْعِ سِنِينَ وَ سِتِّ سِنِينَ» قُلْتُ فِي كَمْ يُؤْخَذُ بِالصِّيَامِ فَقَالَ« فِيمَا بَيْنَ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ أَوْ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ وَ إِنْ صَامَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَدَعْهُ فَقَدْ صَامَ اِبْنِي فُلاَنٌ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ وَ تَرَكْتُهُ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Al-‘Abbas ibn Ma‘ruf, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “At what age should a child be made to observe the prayer?” Imam (a.s) said: "Between six and seven years of age." I asked: “At what age should he be made to fast?” Imam (a.s) said: "Between fourteen or fifteen years of age. And if he fasts before that, then let him be, my son so-and-so fasted before that, and I let him do so."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 411

chapter: Chapter on the Ages That Children Are Commanded to Pray
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Al-Fudayl, from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar:
Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "When a child reaches six years of age, prayer becomes obligatory upon him, and when he is able to fast, fasting becomes obligatory upon him."
arabicText: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُصَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا أَتَى عَلَى اَلصَّبِيِّ سِتُّ سِنِينَ وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْهِ اَلصَّلاَةُ وَ إِذَا أَطَاقَ اَلصَّوْمَ وَجَبَ عَلَيْهِ اَلصِّيَامُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Al-Fudayl, from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar:
thaqalaynMatn: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: "When a child reaches six years of age, prayer becomes obligatory upon him, and when he is able to fast, fasting becomes obligatory upon him."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 411

chapter: Chapter on the Additional Reports
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-‘Ayyashi, from Hamdawayh, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Sama‘ah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who is captured by the polytheists and the time for prayer comes upon him, but he fears that they will prevent him, so he gestures with signs (yumiʾu ima’an) in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "He should gesture with signs (yumiʾu ima’an) in prayer."
arabicText: اَلْعَيَّاشِيُّ عَنْ حَمْدَوَيْهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَأْخُذُهُ اَلْمُشْرِكُونَ فَتَحْضُرُهُ اَلصَّلاَةُ فَيَخَافُ مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يَمْنَعُوهُ فَيُومِئُ إِيمَاءً قَالَ« يُومِئُ إِيمَاءً»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-‘Ayyashi, from Hamdawayh, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Sama‘ah, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who is captured by the polytheists and the time for prayer comes upon him, but he fears that they will prevent him, so he gestures with signs (yumiʾu ima’an) in prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "He should gesture with signs (yumiʾu ima’an) in prayer."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 412

chapter: Chapter on the Additional Reports
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, he said: Hamdawayh narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub, from Isma‘il ibn Jabir, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, and a man asked Imam (a.s) about a person who is overtaken by the time of prayer while he is wading through water and is unable to reach dry ground. Imam (a.s) said: "If he is in battle or on a path of Allah (swt) cause, then let him gesture in prayer. But if he is engaged in trade, then it was not proper for him to wade into the water until he had prayed." I asked: “And what should he do?” Imam (a.s) said: "He should make up the prayer when he comes out of the water, and he has indeed neglected it."
arabicText: عَنْهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمْدَوَيْهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ وَ سَأَلَهُ إِنْسَانٌ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ تُدْرِكُهُ اَلصَّلاَةُ وَهُوَ فِي مَاءٍ يَخُوضُهُ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ قَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ فِي حَرْبٍ أَوْ فِي سَبِيلٍ مِنْ سُبُلِ اَللَّهِ فَلْيُومِ إِيمَاءً وَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي تِجَارَةٍ فَلَمْ يَكُ يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يَخُوضَ اَلْمَاءَ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ» قَالَ قُلْتُ وَ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ« يَقْضِيهَا إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنَ اَلْمَاءِ وَ قَدْ ضَيَّعَ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, he said: Hamdawayh narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Ayyub, from Isma‘il ibn Jabir, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, and a man asked Imam (a.s) about a person who is overtaken by the time of prayer while he is wading through water and is unable to reach dry ground. Imam (a.s) said: "If he is in battle or on a path of Allah (swt) cause, then let him gesture in prayer. But if he is engaged in trade, then it was not proper for him to wade into the water until he had prayed." I asked: “And what should he do?” Imam (a.s) said: "He should make up the prayer when he comes out of the water, and he has indeed neglected it."

chapter: Chapter on the Additional Reports
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Hamdawayh, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abd Al-‘Aziz, from Abdullah ibn Abi Ya‘fur, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who stands for an obligatory prayer and prays one rak‘ah while intending it as a recommended (nafilah) prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "It is according to what you stood up for and intended." And Imam (a.s) said: "If you stand intending an obligatory prayer and doubt enters you afterward, then you are in the obligatory prayer based on the intention you stood with. But if you entered it intending a recommended prayer, and then afterward changed the intention to an obligatory prayer, then you are still in the recommended prayer. Only that part of the prayer is counted for the servant which he began with the original intention."
arabicText: عنه عن حمدويه عن محمد بن الحسين عن الحسن بن محبوب عن عبد العزيز عن عبد الله بن أبي يعفور عن أبى عبد الله عليه السلام قال سألته عن رجل قام في صلاة فريضة فصلى ركعة وهو ينوي أنها نافلة قال هي التي قمت فيها ولها وقال إذا قمت وأنت تنو الفريضة فدخلك الشك بعد فانت في الفريضة على الذي قمت له وان كنت دخلت فيها تنوي نافلة ثم انك تنويها بعد فريضة فانت في النافلة وإنما يحسب للعبد من صلاته التي ابتدأ في أول صلاته
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Hamdawayh, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abd Al-‘Aziz, from Abdullah ibn Abi Ya‘fur, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I asked Imam (a.s) about a man who stands for an obligatory prayer and prays one rak‘ah while intending it as a recommended (nafilah) prayer. Imam (a.s) said: "It is according to what you stood up for and intended." And Imam (a.s) said: "If you stand intending an obligatory prayer and doubt enters you afterward, then you are in the obligatory prayer based on the intention you stood with. But if you entered it intending a recommended prayer, and then afterward changed the intention to an obligatory prayer, then you are still in the recommended prayer. Only that part of the prayer is counted for the servant which he began with the original intention."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 412

chapter: Chapter on the Additional Reports
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Nasir, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ja‘far ibn Bashir, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam (a.s) say: "When the imam (of prayer) finishes the prayer, no one should pray in his place until he has turned away from that spot."
arabicText: عنه عن محمد بن نصير عن محمد بن الحسين عن جعفر بن بشير عن هشام بن سالم عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام قال سمعته يقول إذا انصرف الامام فلا يصلى في مقامه حتى ينحرف عن مقامه ذلك
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Nasir, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ja‘far ibn Bashir, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Imam (a.s) say: "When the imam (of prayer) finishes the prayer, no one should pray in his place until he has turned away from that spot."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 412

chapter: Chapter on the Additional Reports
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
Al-Tatari, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
I heard Imam (a.s) say: "Do not perform the obligatory prayer inside the Ka‘bah, for the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, never entered it during Hajj or ‘Umrah, but He (saws) entered it during the Conquest of Mecca and prayed two rak‘ahs inside it between the two pillars, and with Him (saws) was Usamah."
arabicText: اَلطَّاطَرِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:« لاَ تُصَلِّ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةَ فِي جَوْفِ اَلْكَعْبَةِ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لَمْ يَدْخُلْهَا فِي حَجٍّ وَ لاَ عُمْرَةٍ وَ لَكِنْ دَخَلَهَا فِي فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ فَصَلَّى فِيهَا رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَيْنَ اَلْعَمُودَيْنِ وَ مَعَهُ أُسَامَةُ»
thaqalaynSanad: Al-Tatari, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said:
thaqalaynMatn: I heard Imam (a.s) say: "Do not perform the obligatory prayer inside the Ka‘bah, for the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, never entered it during Hajj or ‘Umrah, but He (saws) entered it during the Conquest of Mecca and prayed two rak‘ahs inside it between the two pillars, and with Him (saws) was Usamah."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 413

chapter: Chapter on the Additional Reports
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Abu Jamilah, from ‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them:
Imam (a.s) said: "The obligatory prayer is not valid inside the Ka‘bah."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ عَلاَءٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ تَصْلُحُ صَلاَةُ اَلْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَوْفِ اَلْكَعْبَةِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Abu Jamilah, from ‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams (a.s)), peace be upon them:
thaqalaynMatn: Imam (a.s) said: "The obligatory prayer is not valid inside the Ka‘bah."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 413

chapter: Chapter on the Additional Reports
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṭūsī
englishText:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
A man asked Imam (a.s), saying: "I prayed ‘Asr on top of Abu Qubays (Mount which overlooks the Kaʿbah), does that suffice, while the Ka‘bah was lower (than) me?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes. Indeed, it is a qiblah from its location up to the sky."
arabicText: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ قَالَ صَلَّيْتُ فَوْقَ أَبِي قُبَيْسٍ اَلْعَصْرَ فَهَلْ يُجْزِي ذَلِكَ وَ اَلْكَعْبَةُ تَحْتِي قَالَ« نَعَمْ إِنَّهَا قِبْلَةٌ مِنْ مَوْضِعِهَا إِلَى اَلسَّمَاءِ»
thaqalaynSanad: From him, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him:
thaqalaynMatn: A man asked Imam (a.s), saying: "I prayed ‘Asr on top of Abu Qubays (Mount which overlooks the Kaʿbah), does that suffice, while the Ka‘bah was lower (than) me?" Imam (a.s) said: "Yes. Indeed, it is a qiblah from its location up to the sky."

gradingsFull.reference_en: Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām fī Sharḥ al-Muqniʿah, vol. 2, p. 413
